                            return 0

                local function Fr(cl, cm, co)
                    local cp = cl.Options or cl.Values or cl.List

                    assert(type(cp) == 'table', 'Dropdown features must be provided as a table')
                    assert(#cp > 0, 'Dropdown requires at least one feature')

                    local function Rr(cx)
                        local cy = {}

                        for cz, cB in ipairs(cx)do
                            cy[cz] = tostring(cB)
                        end

                        return cy
                    end

                    local cx, cy, cz, cB, cG = Rr(cp), cm == true or cl.Multi == true, tostring(cl.Note or cl.Description or ''), nil, nil

                    if co then
                        cB = {}
                        cp, cm = tostring, cl.Hint or cl.Guide or cl.Prompt or (cy and 'Tick the features you want, then press the button' or 'Pick a feature, then press the button')
                        cB.Hint = cp(cm)
                        cB.ButtonText = tostring(cl.ButtonText or cl.ActionText or 'Apply')
                        cB.OnApply = function(cL, cN)
                            x(cl.Callback, cL, cN)
                        end
                        cG = cB
                    else
                        cG = cB
                    end

                    local function zr(cL)
                        local cN = type(cL) == 'number'

                        if cN then
                            local cQ, cT, cV = math.clamp, math.floor(cL), #cx

                            return cQ(cT, 1, cV)
                        end

                        cN = cx

                        for cQ, cT in ipairs(cN)do
                            if cT == tostring(cL) then
                                return cQ
                            end
                        end

                        return nil
                    end
                    local function er(cL)
                        local cN = cy and type(cL) == 'table'

                        if cN then
                            local cQ = {}

                            for cT, cV in ipairs(cL)do
                                cT = zr(cV)

                                if cT then
                                    table.insert(cQ, cx[cT])
                                end
                            end

                            return cQ
                        end

                        return zr(cL) or 1
                    end

                    local cL = Instance.new'Frame'

                    cL.Name = cl.Name
                    cL.Active = false
                    cL.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                    cL.BackgroundTransparency = 1

                    cL.ClipsDescendants = false

                    cL.Size = UDim2.new(bF, 0, 0, 1)
                    cL.ZIndex = 3

                    local function jr()
                        if bj then
                            return bF / bh.X
                        end

                        return bF
                    end

                    bh.OnChanged(function()

                            return false
                        end

                    end)

                    local cN, cQ, cT = nil, nil, 0

                    local function Mr(cV)
                        tr()

                        cT = cT + 1

                        local cW, cX = cT, cN

                        if cX then
                            cN:Destroy()
                        end

                        local cZ, c_ = ir(cl.Name .. 'Dropdown', cl.Name, cx, er(cV), cy, cG, cz)

                        cN, cQ = cZ, c_

                        cV = cN

                        cV = cN

                        cN.Parent = cL

                        local function ir()
                            local c2 = cW ~= cT

                            if c2 then
                                return
                            else
                                local c3 = cN

                                if c3 ~= cZ then
                                    return
                                elseif cZ.Parent == nil then
                                    return
                                end
                            end

                            cL.Size = UDim2.new(jr(), 0, 0, math.max(1, math.ceil(cZ.AbsoluteSize.Y)))
                        end

                        cZ:GetPropertyChangedSignal'AbsoluteSize':Connect(ir)

                                        elseif cZ.Parent == nil then
                                            return
                                        end
                                    end

                                    x(cl.Callback, c_.GetValue())
                                end)
                            end)
                        end

                        ir()
                        task.defer(ir)
                    end

                    Mr(cl.Default)

                    cp = {
                        GetValue = function()

                            return cV()

                        end,

                        end or nil,

                            cQ.SetHint(cG.Hint)
                        end or nil,
                        SetActionText = cG and function(cV)

                            cQ.SetActionText(cG.ButtonText)
                        end or nil,
                    }

                    return cL, cp
                end

                    end

                    cG:GetPropertyChangedSignal'TextBounds':Connect(J)
                    cG:GetPropertyChangedSignal'AbsoluteSize':Connect(J)
                    cG:GetPropertyChangedSignal'AbsolutePosition':Connect(D)
                    cL:GetPropertyChangedSignal'AbsolutePosition':Connect(D)
                    cL:GetPropertyChangedSignal'AbsoluteSize':Connect(D)

                    if cz then
                        cz:GetPropertyChangedSignal'CanvasPosition':Connect(D)
                        cz:GetPropertyChangedSignal'AbsolutePosition':Connect(D)
                        cz:GetPropertyChangedSignal'AbsoluteSize':Connect(D)
                    end

                    task.defer(J)
                    task.defer(D)

                    J = Instance.new'TextButton'
                    J.Name = 'SectionButton'
                    J.Active = true
                    J.AutoButtonColor = false
                    J.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    J.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    J.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
                    J.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                    J.Text = ''
                    J.ZIndex = cG.ZIndex + 4
                    J.Parent = cG

                    return cG, cN, J
                end

                local cx, cy, cz, cG, cL, cN, cQ, cT = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}

                an.optionChangedHook = nil
                an.stateChangedHook = nil
                an.configLoadedHook = nil
                an.quickRefreshHook = nil
                cx.__index = cx
                cy.__index = cy
                cz.__index = cz
                cG.__index = cG
                cL.__index = cL
                cN.__index = cN
                cQ.__index = cQ

                local cV, cX = {}, 256

                local function Ur(cZ, c_)
                    assert(type(cZ) == 'table' and cZ._kind == c_ and not cZ._destroyed, ('API nay chi dung duoc tren %s con hoat dong'):format(c_))
                end
                local function ar(cZ, c_)
                    if type(cZ) ~= 'table' then
                        return cZ
                    end

                    c_ = c_ or {}

                    if c_[cZ] then
                        return nil
                    end

                    c_[cZ] = true

                    local c2 = {}

                    for c3, c4 in pairs(cZ)do
                        local c5 = ar(c3, c_)

                        if c5 ~= nil then
                            c2[c5] = ar(c4, c_)
                        end
                    end

                    c_[cZ] = nil

                    return c2
                end
                local function gr(cZ, c_, c2)
                    if cZ == c_ then
                        return true
                    end
                    if type(cZ) ~= type(c_) then
                        return false
                    elseif type(cZ) ~= 'table' then
                        return false
                    end

                    c2 = c2 or {}

                    if c2[cZ] == c_ then
                        return true
                    end

                    c2[cZ] = c_

                    for c3, c4 in pairs(cZ)do
                        if not (gr(c4, c_[c3], c2)) then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                    for c3 in pairs(c_)do
                        if cZ[c3] == nil then
                            return false
                        end
                    end

                    return true
                end
                local function Mr(cZ, c_, ...)
                    if type(cZ) ~= 'function' then
                        return c_
                    end

                    local c2 = table.pack(...)
                    local c3, c4 = xpcall(function()
                        return cZ(table.unpack(c2, 1, c2.n))
                    end, function(c3)
                        return debug.traceback(tostring(c3), 2)
                    end)

                    if not (c3) then
                        return c_
                    end

                    return c4
                end
                local function fr(cZ)
                    if type(cZ) == 'table' then
                        if cZ._kind == 'State' then
                            Ur(cZ, 'State')

                            return cZ
                        end
                    end
                    if type(cZ) == 'table' then
                        if cZ._kind == 'Option' then
                            Ur(cZ, 'Option')
                            assert(cZ.State, 'This feature has no state to link')

                            return cZ.State
                        end
                    end

                    error('Provide a State or a feature with a state', 3)
                end
                local function Tr(cZ)
                    cZ._primaryOption = nil

                    local c_

                    for c2 in pairs(cZ._views)do
                        if c2._destroyed then
                        else
                            if c2.Instance ~= nil then
                                c_ = c_ or c2

                                if type(c2._userCallback) == 'function' then
                                    cZ._primaryOption = c2

                                    return
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    cZ._primaryOption = c_
                end
                local function hr(cZ)
                    for c_, c2 in pairs(cZ._views)do
                        if c_._destroyed or c_.Instance == nil then
                            cZ._views[c_] = nil
                        elseif c_._controller.SetValue then
                            local c3 = Mr(c2.ToOption, cZ.Value, ar(cZ.Value), c_, cZ)

                            c_._stateApplying = true

                            xpcall(function()
                                c_._controller.SetValue(ar(c3), false)
                            end, function(c4)
                                return debug.traceback(tostring(c4), 2)
                            end)

                            c_._stateApplying = false
                        end
                    end

                    if cZ._primaryOption then
                        if cZ._primaryOption._destroyed then
                            Tr(cZ)
                        elseif cZ._primaryOption.Instance == nil then
                            Tr(cZ)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local function Sr(cZ, c_)
                    if cZ.changed[c_] then
                        return
                    end

                    cZ.changed[c_] = true

                    table.insert(cZ.order, c_)
                end

                cT[1] = function(cZ, c_, c2, c3)
                    if cZ._destroyed then
                        return false
                    end
                    if c2.steps >= cX then
                        if not (c2.warned) then
                            c2.warned = true
                        end

                        return false
                    end

                    local c4 = Mr(cZ.Normalize, c_, ar(c_), cZ)

                    if c4 == cV then
                        return false
                    end

                    for c5 in pairs(cZ._groups)do
                        if not (cT[17](c5, cZ, c4)) then
                            hr(cZ)

                            return false
                        end
                    end

                    if gr(cZ.Value, c4) then
                        hr(cZ)

                        return false
                    end

                    c2.steps = c2.steps + 1
                    cZ.Value = ar(c4)

                    Sr(c2, cZ)
                    hr(cZ)

                    for c5 in pairs(cZ._groups)do
                        cT[18](c5, cZ, c2)
                    end
                    for c5, c6 in ipairs(cZ._links)do
                        if c6.Connected then
                            c5 = Mr(c6.Transform, cZ.Value, ar(cZ.Value), ar(c6.Target.Value), cZ, c6.Target)

                            if c5 ~= cV then
                                cT[1](c6.Target, c5, c2, c3)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return true
                end

                local function Xr(cZ)
                    local c_ = cZ._registered

                    return (c_ and {
                        (type(cZ.Callback) ~= 'function'),
                    } or {
                        (not c_),
                    })[1]
                end
                local function Sr(cZ, c_, c2, c3, c4)
                    local c5 = {
                        changed = {},
                        fireCallback = c2 ~= false,
                        order = {},
                        sourceArguments = c4,
                        sourceOption = c3,
                        steps = 0,
                        warned = false,
                    }

                    cT[1](cZ, c_, c5, c3)

                    if c5.fireCallback then
                        for c6, c7 in ipairs(c5.order)do
                            x(c7.Callback, ar(c7.Value), c7, c3)

                            c_ = c7._primaryOption

                            if Xr(c7) then
                                if c_ then
                                    if not (c_._destroyed) then
                                        if type(c_._userCallback) == 'function' then
                                            if c_ == c3 and c4 then
                                                x(c_._userCallback, table.unpack(c4, 1, c4.n))
                                            else
                                                x(c_._userCallback, c_._controller.GetValue())
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            for c8, c9 in ipairs(c7._subscribers)do
                                if c9.Connected then
                                    x(c9.Callback, ar(c7.Value), c7, c3)
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        cZ = nil

                        if (c3 and {
                            (c3._destroyed),
                        } or {
                            (not c3),
                        })[1] then
                            cZ = c3

                            for c7, c9 in ipairs(c5.order)do
                                for dd in pairs(c9._views)do
                                    if not (dd._destroyed) then
                                        if not (dd._configIgnored) then
                                            cZ = dd

                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end

                                if cZ then
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            cZ = c3
                        end
                        if cZ and an.optionChangedHook then
                            an.optionChangedHook(cZ)
                        elseif #c5.order > 0 then
                            if an.stateChangedHook then
                                an.stateChangedHook(c5.order[1])
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return #c5.order > 0
                end
                local function Er(cZ, c_, c2)
                    local c3 = setmetatable({
                        _kind = 'State',
                        _destroyed = false,
                        _configIgnored = c_.Save == false or c_.Config == false,
                        _groups = setmetatable({}, {
                            __mode = 'k',
                        }),
                        _links = {},
                        _registered = c2 == true,
                        _subscribers = {},
                        _views = setmetatable({}, {
                            __mode = 'k',
                        }),
                        Callback = c_.Callback,
                        Name = tostring(c_.Name or 'State'),
                        Normalize = c_.Normalize,
                        Value = ar(c_.Default),
                        Window = cZ,
                    }, cL)

                    cZ._stateObjects[c3] = true

                    return c3
                end

                cT[2] = function(cZ)
                    Ur(cZ, 'State')

                    return ar(cZ.Value)
                end
                cT[3] = function(cZ, c_, c2)
                    Ur(cZ, 'State')
                    Sr(cZ, c_, c2, nil)

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[4] = function(cZ, c_)
                    Ur(cZ, 'State')
                    assert(type(c_) == 'function', 'Subscribe can callback function')

                    local c2 = {
                        Callback = c_,
                        Connected = true,
                        Disconnect = function(c2)
                            c2.Connected = false
                        end,
                    }

                    table.insert(cZ._subscribers, c2)

                    return c2
                end
                cT[5] = function(cZ, c_, c2, c3)
                    Ur(cZ, 'State')

                    c_ = fr(c_)

                    assert(c_.Window == cZ.Window, 'Hai State phai thuoc cung Window')

                    c3 = type(c3) == 'table' and c3 or {}

                    local c4 = {
                        Connected = true,
                        Source = cZ,
                        Target = c_,
                        Transform = type(c2) == 'function' and c2 or nil,
                        Disconnect = function(c4)
                            c4.Connected = false
                        end,
                    }

                    table.insert(cZ._links, c4)

                    if c3.Immediate == true then
                        c2 = Mr(c4.Transform, cZ.Value, ar(cZ.Value), ar(c_.Value), cZ, c_)

                        if c2 ~= cV then
                            cT[3](c_, c2, c3.FireCallback)
                        end
                    end

                    return c4
                end
                cT[6] = function(cZ, c_, c2, c3)
                    local c4

                    if c2 == nil then
                        c2 = true
                        c4 = c2
                    else
                        c4 = c2
                    end

                    return cT[5](cZ, c_, function(c5)
                        if c5 == true then
                            return ar(c4)
                        end

                        return cV
                    end, c3)
                end
                cT[7] = function(cZ, c_, c2, c3)
                    local c4

                    if c2 == nil then
                        c2 = false
                        c4 = c2
                    else
                        c4 = c2
                    end

                    return cT[5](cZ, c_, function(c5)
                        if c5 == false then
                            return ar(c4)
                        end

                        return cV
                    end, c3)
                end
                cT[8] = function(cZ, c_, c2, c3, c4)
                    assert(type(c2) == 'function', 'LinkWhen can predicate function')

                    return cT[5](cZ, c_, function(c5, c9, dd, de)
                        if c2(c5, c9, dd, de) then
                            if type(c3) == 'function' then
                                return c3(c5, c9, dd, de)
                            end

                            return ar(c3)
                        end

                        return cV
                    end, c4)
                end
                cT[9] = function(cZ, c_, c2, c3)
                    assert(type(c_) == 'table', 'LinkMany can danh sach target')

                    local c4 = {
                        Connected = true,
                        Links = {},
                    }

                    for c5, c9 in ipairs(c_)do
                        table.insert(c4.Links, cT[5](cZ, c9, c2, c3))
                    end

                    c4.Disconnect = function(c9)
                        c9.Connected = false

                        for dd, de in ipairs(c9.Links)do
                            de:Disconnect()
                        end
                    end

                    return c4
                end
                cT[10] = function(cZ, c_, c2, c3)
                    assert(type(c_) == 'table', 'LinkManyWhenTrue can danh sach target')

                    local c4 = {
                        Connected = true,
                        Links = {},
                    }

                    for c9, de in ipairs(c_)do
                        table.insert(c4.Links, cT[6](cZ, de, c2, c3))
                    end

                    c4.Disconnect = function(de)
                        de.Connected = false

                        for df, dg in ipairs(de.Links)do
                            dg:Disconnect()
                        end
                    end

                    return c4
                end
                cT[11] = function(cZ, c_, c2)
                    return cT[5](cZ, c_, function(c3)
                        return not c3
                    end, c2)
                end
                cT[12] = function(cZ, c_, c2, c3, c4)
                    c_ = fr(c_)

                    return {
                        Connected = true,
                        Forward = cT[5](cZ, c_, c2, c4),
                        Backward = cT[5](c_, cZ, c3, {Immediate = false}),
                        Disconnect = function(de)
                            de.Connected = false

                            de.Forward:Disconnect()
                            de.Backward:Disconnect()
                        end,
                    }
                end
                cT[13] = function(cZ)
                    Ur(cZ, 'State')

                    local c_, c2 = cZ.Window, {}

                    for c3 in pairs(cZ._groups)do
                        table.insert(c2, c3)
                    end
                    for c3, c4 in ipairs(c2)do
                        if not (c4._destroyed) then
                            c4:Remove(cZ)
                        end
                    end
                    for c4, de in ipairs(cZ._links)do
                        de.Connected = false
                    end
                    for de in pairs(c_._stateObjects)do
                        for dg, dj in ipairs(de._links)do
                            if dj.Source == cZ then
                                dj.Connected = false
                            elseif dj.Target == cZ then
                                dj.Connected = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for de, dj in ipairs(cZ._subscribers)do
                        dj.Connected = false
                    end
                    for dj in pairs(cZ._views)do
                        dj.State = nil
                        dj._stateBinding = nil
                    end

                    cZ._views = {}
                    cZ._links = {}
                    cZ._subscribers = {}
                    cZ._groups = {}
                    cZ._destroyed = true
                    c_._stateObjects[cZ] = nil

                    if cZ._registered then
                        c_._stateByName[cZ.Name] = nil

                        for dj, dm in ipairs(c_.States)do
                            if dm == cZ then
                                table.remove(c_.States, dj)

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                cT[14] = function(cZ)
                    local c_ = 0

                    for c2 in pairs(cZ._members)do
                        c_ = (c2.Value == true and {
                            (c_ + 1),
                        } or {c_})[1]
                    end

                    return c_
                end
                cT[15] = function(cZ, c_)
                    local c2, dj = 1 / 0

                    for dm in pairs(cZ._members)do
                        if dm ~= c_ then
                            if dm.Value == true then
                                local dn = cZ._activationOrder[dm] or 0

                                if dn < c2 then
                                    c2, dj = dn, dm
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return dj
                end
                cT[16] = function(cZ, c_, c2, dj)
                    while true do
                        local dm, dn = cT[14](cZ), cZ.MaxActive

                        if not (dm > dn) then
                            break
                        end

                        dn = cT[15](cZ, c_) or cT[15](cZ, nil)

                        if not dn then
                            break
                        end
                        if c2 then
                            if not (cT[1](dn, false, c2, nil)) then
                                break
                            end
                        else
                            dm = dn.Value == true

                            cT[3](dn, false, dj)

                            if dm then
                                if not (dn.Value ~= true) then
                                    break
                                end
                            else
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                cT[17] = function(cZ, c_, c2)
                    if c2 ~= false then
                        return true
                    elseif c_.Value ~= true then
                        return true
                    end

                    return cT[14](cZ) - 1 >= cZ.MinActive
                end
                cT[18] = function(cZ, c_, c2)
                    if c_.Value == true then
                        cZ._nextActivationOrder = cZ._nextActivationOrder + 1
                        cZ._activationOrder[c_] = cZ._nextActivationOrder

                        cT[16](cZ, c_, c2, nil)
                    else
                        cZ._activationOrder[c_] = nil
                    end
                end
                cT[19] = function(cZ, c_)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')

                    local c2 = fr(c_)

                    assert(c2.Window == cZ.Window, 'State and Feature must belong to the same Window')

                    if cZ._members[c2] then
                        return cZ
                    end

                    cZ._members[c2] = true
                    c2._groups[cZ] = true

                    if c2.Value == true then
                        cZ._nextActivationOrder = cZ._nextActivationOrder + 1
                        cZ._activationOrder[c2] = cZ._nextActivationOrder

                        cT[16](cZ, c2, nil, false)
                    end

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[20] = function(cZ, c_)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')

                    local c2 = fr(c_)

                    cZ._members[c2] = nil
                    cZ._activationOrder[c2] = nil
                    c2._groups[cZ] = nil

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[21] = function(cZ, c_)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')
                    assert(type(c_) == 'table', 'AddMany requires a State/Feature list')

                    for c2, dj in ipairs(c_)do
                        cT[19](cZ, dj)
                    end

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[22] = function(cZ, c_, dj)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')

                    local dm = fr(c_)

                    assert(cZ._members[dm], 'This State/Feature is not in the group')
                    cT[3](dm, true, dj)

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[23] = function(cZ)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')

                    local c_ = {}

                    for dj in pairs(cZ._members)do
                        if dj.Value == true then
                            table.insert(c_, dj)
                        end
                    end

                    table.sort(c_, function(dj, dm)
                        return (cZ._activationOrder[dj] or 0) < (cZ._activationOrder[dm] or 0)
                    end)

                    return c_
                end
                cT[24] = function(cZ)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')

                    return cZ.MinActive, cZ.MaxActive
                end
                cT[25] = function(cZ, c_, dj)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')

                    local dm = tonumber(c_)

                    assert(dm, 'MaxActive phai la mot so')

                    cZ.MaxActive = math.max(1, math.floor(dm))

                    if cZ.MinActive > cZ.MaxActive then
                        cZ.MinActive = cZ.MaxActive
                    end

                    cZ.AllowNone = cZ.MinActive == 0

                    cT[16](cZ, nil, nil, dj)

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[26] = function(cZ, c_)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')

                    local dj = tonumber(c_)

                    assert(dj, 'MinActive phai la mot so')

                    cZ.MinActive = math.clamp(math.floor(dj), 0, cZ.MaxActive)
                    cZ.AllowNone = cZ.MinActive == 0

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[27] = function(cZ, c_)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')

                    cZ.MinActive = c_ and 0 or math.max(1, cZ.MinActive)
                    cZ.AllowNone = cZ.MinActive == 0

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[28] = function(cZ)
                    Ur(cZ, 'ExclusiveGroup')

                    cZ._destroyed = true

                    for c_ in pairs(cZ._members)do
                        c_._groups[cZ] = nil
                    end

                    cZ._members = {}
                    cZ._activationOrder = {}

                    if cZ.Window then
                        cZ.Window._exclusiveGroupByName[cZ.Name] = nil

                        for c_, dj in ipairs(cZ.Window.ExclusiveGroups)do
                            if dj == cZ then
                                table.remove(cZ.Window.ExclusiveGroups, c_)

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                local function Dr(cZ, c_, dj)
                    Ur(c_, 'State')
                    assert(c_.Window == cZ.Section.Tab.Window, 'State and Feature must belong to the same Window')

                    local dm = {
                        FromOption = dj.OptionToState,
                        ToOption = dj.StateToOption,
                    }

                    cZ.State = c_
                    cZ._stateBinding = dm
                    c_._views[cZ] = dm

                    if c_._primaryOption then
                        if type(c_._primaryOption._userCallback) ~= 'function' then
                            if type(cZ._userCallback) == 'function' then
                                c_._primaryOption = cZ
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        c_._primaryOption = cZ
                    end

                    hr(c_)
                end
                local function hr(cZ, c_, dj, dm)
                    local dn = setmetatable({
                        _kind = 'Option',
                        _destroyed = false,
                        _controller = dm or {},
                        _manualVisible = true,
                        _resolvedVisible = true,
                        _visibilityDependencies = {},
                        _visibilityDependents = {},
                        Section = cZ,
                        Type = c_,
                        Name = dj.Name,
                        Instance = dj,
                    }, cG)

                    table.insert(cZ.Options, dn)

                    return dn
                end

                cT[29] = function(cZ)
                    Ur(cZ, 'Option')

                    local c_ = cZ._controller.GetValue

                    if c_ then
                        return c_()
                    end

                    return nil
                end
                cT[30] = function(cZ, c_, dj)
                    Ur(cZ, 'Option')

                    local dm = cZ._controller.SetValue

                    assert(dm, ('%s khong ho tro Set()'):format(cZ.Type))

                    if cZ.State then
                        if not (cZ._stateApplying) then
                            dm(c_, false)

                            local dn = cZ._controller.GetValue()
                            local dp = Mr(cZ._stateBinding.FromOption, dn, ar(dn), cZ, cZ.State)

                            Sr(cZ.State, dp, dj, cZ)

                            if dj ~= false then
                                if not (Xr(cZ.State)) then
                                    x(cZ._userCallback, cZ._controller.GetValue())
                                end
                            end

                            return cZ
                        end
                    end

                    dm(c_, dj)

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[31] = function(cZ)
                    Ur(cZ, 'Option')
                    assert(cZ.State, ('%s khong co state'):format(cZ.Type))

                    return cZ.State
                end
                cT[32] = function(cZ, c_, dj)
                    Ur(cZ, 'Option')
                    assert(cZ._controller.GetValue and cZ._controller.SetValue, ('%s khong ho tro State'):format(cZ.Type))

                    c_ = fr(c_)

                    assert(c_.Window == cZ.Section.Tab.Window, 'State and Feature must belong to the same Window')

                    local dm = cZ.State

                    if dm then
                        dm._views[cZ] = nil

                        Tr(dm)

                        if not (dm._registered) then
                            if next(dm._views) == nil then
                                if not (dm._destroyed) then
                                    cT[13](dm)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    Dr(cZ, c_, type(dj) == 'table' and dj or {})

                    return cZ
                end
                cT[33] = function(cZ, c_, dj)
                    return cT[32](cZ, fr(c_), dj)
                end
                cT[34] = function(cZ, c_, dj, dm)
                    return cT[5](cT[31](cZ), c_, dj, dm)
                end
                cT[35] = function(cZ, c_, dj, dm)
                    return cT[6](cT[31](cZ), c_, dj, dm)
                end
                cT[36] = function(cZ, c_, dj, dm)
                    return cT[7](cT[31](cZ), c_, dj, dm)
                end
                cT[37] = function(cZ, c_, dj, dm, dn)

                local function Jr(cZ)
                    local c_ = cT[2](cZ.Source)

                    if cZ.Predicate then
                        local dj, dm = pcall(cZ.Predicate, ar(c_), cZ.Source, cZ.Child)

                        return dj and dm == true
                    end

                    return gr(c_, cZ.Expected)
                end
                local function gr(cZ, c_)
                    if cZ._manualVisible == false then
                        return false
                    end

                    for dj, dm in ipairs(cZ._visibilityDependencies or {})do
                        if dm.Connected then
                            if not (Jr(dm)) then
                                return false
                            end

                            dj = dm.SourceOption

                            if dj then
                                if dj._destroyed then
                                else
                                    local dn = c_ or {}

                                    if not (dn[dj]) then
                                        dn[dj] = true

                                        if not (gr(dj, dn)) then
                                            return false
                                        end
                                    end

                                    c_ = dn
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return true
                end

                cT[43] = function(cZ)
                    local c_ = #(cZ._visibilityDependencies or {}) > 0 and 0.96 or 1

                    c_ = cZ._subOfParent and 0.9 or c_
                    cZ._visibilityHostWidth = c_

                    if cZ._visibilityHost then
                        if cZ._visibilityHost.Parent then
                            local dj = cZ._visibilityHost.Size

                            cZ._visibilityHost.Size = UDim2.new(c_, 0, dj.Y.Scale, dj.Y.Offset)

                            return cZ._visibilityHost
                        end
                    end

                    local dj = cZ.Instance
                    local dm = dj and dj.Parent

                    if not dj or not dm then
                        return dj
                    end

                    local dn = Instance.new'Frame'

                    dn.Name = dj.Name .. 'CollapsibleContent'
                    dn.Active = false
                    dn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    dn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    dn.ClipsDescendants = true
                    dn.LayoutOrder = dj.LayoutOrder
                    dn.Size = UDim2.new(c_, 0, 0, math.max(1, dj.AbsoluteSize.Y))
                    dn.Visible = dj.Visible
                    dn.ZIndex = dj.ZIndex
                    dn.Parent = dm
                    dj.LayoutOrder = 1
                    dj.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
                    dj.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
                    dj.Visible = true
                    dj.Parent = dn
                    cZ._visibilityHost = dn
                    cZ._visibilityAnimating = false
                    cZ._visibilityHostConnections = cZ._visibilityHostConnections or {}

                    local function Gr()
                        if cZ._destroyed then
                            return
                        elseif dn.Parent then
                            if not (dj.Parent) then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end

                        local dp = math.max(1, dj.AbsoluteSize.Y, dj.Size.Y.Offset)

                        cZ._visibilityExpandedHeight = dp

                        if not (cZ._visibilityAnimating) then
                            if cZ._resolvedVisible ~= false then
                                dn.Size = UDim2.new(cZ._visibilityHostWidth or 1, 0, 0, dp)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    table.insert(cZ._visibilityHostConnections, dj:GetPropertyChangedSignal'AbsoluteSize':Connect(Gr))
                    table.insert(cZ._visibilityHostConnections, dj:GetPropertyChangedSignal'Size':Connect(Gr))
                    Gr()

                    return dn
                end
                cT[44] = function(cZ, dj)
                    local dm = {}

                    Ur(cZ, 'Option')

                    local dn, dp = cZ._resolvedVisible, gr(cZ)

                    cZ._resolvedVisible = dp

                    if dn ~= dp and not cZ._cascadingVisibility then
                        cZ._cascadingVisibility = true

                        for dq, ds in ipairs(cZ._visibilityDependents or {})do
                            dq = ds.Child

                            if ds.Connected then

                                        cT[44](dq, dj)
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                    end

                    if not dq then
                        return cZ
                    end
                    if cZ._preSearchVisible ~= nil then
                        cZ._preSearchVisible = dp
                        dq.Visible = cZ._searchMatched == true and dp

                        task.defer(cZ.Section._refreshHeight)

                        return cZ
                    end

                    cZ._visibilityRevision = (cZ._visibilityRevision or 0) + 1

                    local ds = cZ._visibilityRevision

                    dn = cZ._visibilityTween ~= nil

                    if cZ._visibilityTween then
                        cZ._visibilityTween:Cancel()

                        cZ._visibilityTween = nil
                    end
                    if dq.Visible == dp then
                        if not dn then
                            return cZ
                        end
                    end
                    if not dp and cZ._controller.Close then
                        cZ._controller.Close()
                    end

                    dn = cZ.Instance

                    local dt = math.max(1, cZ._visibilityExpandedHeight or 0, dn and dn.AbsoluteSize.Y or 0, dn and dn.Size.Y.Offset or 0)

                    cZ._visibilityExpandedHeight = dt
                    dn = UDim2.new(cZ._visibilityHostWidth or 1, 0, 0, dp and dt or 0)

                    if dp then
                        dq.Visible = true
                    end
                    if dj == false then
                        cZ._visibilityAnimating = false
                        dq.Size = dn
                        dq.Visible = dp

                        task.defer(cZ.Section._refreshHeight)

                        return cZ
                    end

                    cZ._visibilityAnimating = true
                    dj = TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                    dm[1] = (ai[4]:Create(dq, dj, {Size = dn}))
                    cZ._visibilityTween = dm[1]
                    dn, dj = cZ._visibilityTween, function()
                        if cZ._destroyed then
                            return
                        elseif ds ~= cZ._visibilityRevision then
                            return
                        elseif not (cZ._visibilityHost) then
                            return
                        end

                        cZ._visibilityTween = nil
                        cZ._visibilityAnimating = false
                        dq.Visible = dp

                        if dp then
                            dq.Size = UDim2.new(cZ._visibilityHostWidth or 1, 0, 0, cZ._visibilityExpandedHeight or dt)
                        end

                        cZ.Section._refreshHeight()

                        if cZ.Section._stabilizeLayout then
                            cZ.Section._stabilizeLayout()
                        end
                    end

                    dn.Completed:Connect(dj)
                    cZ._visibilityTween:Play()
                    task.defer(cZ.Section._refreshHeight)

                    return cZ
                end

                                return

                                if not (ds.Child._destroyed) then
                                    cT[44](ds.Child, false)
                                end
                            end
                        end,
                    }

                    if dj then
                        if dj._kind == 'Option' then

                        if ds.Connected then
                            if not (cZ._destroyed) then
                                cT[44](cZ, dn.Animated ~= false)
                            end
                        end

                local function Tr(cZ, dj, dq, ds)
                    Ur(cZ, 'Section')

                    cZ._nextOptionOrder = cZ._nextOptionOrder + 1
                    dq.LayoutOrder = cZ._nextOptionOrder
                    dq.Parent = cZ._content

                    local dt, du = gr(cZ, dq), dq:GetPropertyChangedSignal'AbsoluteSize':Connect(cZ._refreshHeight)

                    ds = ds or {}

                    local dv, dx = ds.Destroy, false

                    ds.Destroy = function()
                        local dy = dx

                        if dy then
                            return
                        end

                        dx = true

                        if dv then
                            dv()
                        end

                        dt()

                        if du.Connected then
                            du:Disconnect()
                        end
                    end

                    task.defer(cZ._refreshHeight)

                    if cZ._stabilizeLayout then
                        cZ._stabilizeLayout()
                    end

                    return hr(cZ, dj, dq, ds)
                end

                            local function Or(fe)
                                local fj = {}

                                local function Nr(fn)
                                    return (tostring(fn):gsub('&', '&amp;'):gsub('<', '&lt;'):gsub('>', '&gt;'))
                                end
                                local function tr(fn, fo)
                                    if fn then
                                        if not (fn:IsA'TextLabel') then
                                            return
                                        end
                                    else
                                        return
                                    end

                                    local fp = fj[fn]

                                    if fp == nil then
                                        if fn.RichText then
                                            return
                                        end

                                        fp = fn.Text
                                        fj[fn] = fp
                                    end
                                    if fo == '' then
                                        fn.RichText = false
                                        fn.Text = fp

                                        return
                                    end

                                    local fs, ft = fp:lower():find(fo, 1, true)

                                    if not (fs) then
                                        fn.RichText = false
                                        fn.Text = fp

                                        return
                                    end

                                    fn.RichText = true
                                    fn.Text = Nr(fp:sub(1, fs - 1)) .. ('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">'):format(math.floor(eZ.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(eZ.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(eZ.B * 255 + 0.5)) .. Nr(fp:sub(fs, ft)) .. '</font>' .. Nr(fp:sub(ft + 1))
                                end
                                local function dr(fn)
                                    local fo = fn.Instance:FindFirstChild'Main'

                                    if fo then
                                    else
                                        for fp, fs in ipairs(fn.Instance:GetChildren())do
                                            fp = fs:FindFirstChild'Head'
                                            fo = fp and (fp:FindFirstChild'Main')

                                            if fo then
                                                break
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end

                                    return fo and fo:FindFirstChild'Label' or nil
                                end
                                local function Nr(fn)
                                    local fo = (tostring(fn or ''):match'^%s*(.-)%s*$' or ''):lower()

                                    for fp, fs in ipairs(fe.Sections)do
                                        fn = fs._destroyed

                                        if (fn and {
                                            (not fn),
                                        } or {
                                            (not fs._isSearchResults),
                                        })[1] then
                                            fp = fs.DisplayName or fs.Name

                                            local ft = fo == '' or fp:lower():find(fo, 1, true) ~= nil
                                            local fu = (fs._searchExtra and {
                                                fs._searchExtra(fo) == true or ft,
                                            } or {ft})[1]

                                            tr(fs._header, fo)

                                            for fv, fw in ipairs(fs.Options)do
                                                if fw.Instance then
                                                    fv = fw.DisplayName or fw.Name

                                                    local fx, fy = fo == '' or ft or fv:lower():find(fo, 1, true) ~= nil, fw._visibilityHost or fw.Instance

                                                    if fo == '' then
                                                        if fw._preSearchVisible ~= nil then
                                                            fy.Visible = fw._preSearchVisible
                                                            fw._preSearchVisible = nil
                                                            fw._searchMatched = nil
                                                        end
                                                    else
                                                        if fw._preSearchVisible == nil then
                                                            fw._preSearchVisible = fw._resolvedVisible ~= false
                                                        end

                                                        fw._searchMatched = fx
                                                        fy.Visible = fx and fw._preSearchVisible
                                                    end

                                                    tr(dr(fw), fo)

                                                    fu = fx and true or fu
                                                end
                                            end

                                            if fo == '' then
                                                fs._container.Visible = true

                                                if fs._preSearchExpanded ~= nil then
                                                    fs:SetExpanded(fs._preSearchExpanded, false)

                                                    fs._preSearchExpanded = nil
                                                end
                                            else
                                                if fs._preSearchExpanded == nil then
                                                    fs._preSearchExpanded = fs.Expanded
                                                end

                                                fs._container.Visible = fu

                                                if fu then
                                                    if not (fs.Expanded) then
                                                        fs:SetExpanded(true, false)
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end

                                            fs._refreshHeight()
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if e9 then
                                        e9(fe, fo)
                                    end

                                    task.defer(fe._updateCanvas)
                                end

                                fe._searchPaint = tr

                                return Nr
                            end
                            local function Ir(fe, fn)
                                local fo = fn:FindFirstChildOfClass'UIAspectRatioConstraint'

                                if (fo and {
                                    (fo.AspectRatio <= 0),
                                } or {
                                    (not fo),
                                })[1] then
                                    return function() end
                                end

                                local fp, fs, ft, fu, fv = fo.AspectRatio, fn.Size.X.Scale, fn.Size.X.Offset, 
-1, -1

                                fo:Destroy()

                                fn.Size = UDim2.new(fs, ft, 0, 1)
                                fe._rowUpdaters = fe._rowUpdaters or {}

                                local function tr(fw)
                                    if fe._destroyed then
                                        return
                                    elseif fn.Parent == nil then
                                        return
                                    end
                                    if not (fw) then
                                        if d6.windowAnimating then
                                            return
                                        elseif not (fe.Tab.Page.Visible) then
                                            return
                                        end
                                    end

                                    fw = fe._content.AbsoluteSize.X
                                    fw = (fw <= 0 and {
                                        (fe.Tab.Page.AbsoluteSize.X),
                                    } or {fw})[1]

                                    if fw <= 0 then
                                        return
                                    end

                                    local fx = eJ.X

                                                                        end
                                                                    end
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end

                                    local function n()
                                        if fZ.AutoSave then
                                            if fZ.Loading then
                                                return
                                            end
                                        else
                                            return
                                        end

                                        gd = gd + 1

                                        local gg, gk = gd, fZ.Active

                                        task.delay(0.35, function()
                                            local gm = gd

                                            if gg ~= gm then
                                                return
                                            elseif fZ.AutoSave then
                                                if fZ.Loading then
                                                    return
                                                end
                                            else
                                                return
                                            end

                                            local gp, gs = vr(gk, false)

                                            if gp then
                                                Br('Auto-saved: ' .. gk)
                                            else
                                                Br('Auto-save failed: ' .. tostring(gs))
                                            end
                                        end)
                                    end

                                    function d6.optionChangedHook(gg)
                                        if gg._configIgnored then
                                            return
                                        end

                                        n()
                                    end
                                    function d6.stateChangedHook(gg)
                                        if gg._configIgnored then
                                            return
                                        end

                                        n()
                                    end

                                    local function n(gg)
                                        gg._configIgnored = true

                                        if gg.State then
                                            if not (gg.State._registered) then
                                                gg.State._configIgnored = true
                                            end
                                        end

                                        return gg
                                    end

                                    local gg, gk, gp, gs, gt = 'ChilliLibraryConfig', 1, 1048576, Zr'setclipboard' or Zr'toclipboard' or Zr'set_clipboard' or Zr'writeclipboard'

                                    do
                                        local gu = type(fW) == 'table' and fW.Clipboard or nil

                                        if gs then
                                        else
                                            if type(gu) == 'table' then
                                                if type(gu.set) == 'function' then
                                                    local function er(gv)
                                                        return gu.set(gv)
                                                    end

                                                    gs = er
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end

                                        gt = gs
                                    end

                                    local function er(gu, gv, gw)
                                        e6.Notify(tostring(gu), tostring(gv), gw)
                                    end
                                    local function lr(gu)
                                        if type(gt) ~= 'function' then
                                            return false, 'Clipboard copy is not supported by this executor.'
                                        end

                                        local gv, gw = pcall(gt, tostring(gu or ''))

                                        if not (gv) then
                                            return false, 'Clipboard copy failed: ' .. tostring(gw)
                                        end

                                        return true
                                    end
                                    local function Qr(gu)
                                        local gv = Yr(gu)

                                        if not gv then
                                            return nil, 'Selected config does not exist.'
                                        end

                                        gu = mr(Xr(gv))

                                        if type(gu) ~= 'table' then
                                            return nil, 'Selected config file is empty or invalid.'
                                        elseif type(gu.Values) ~= 'table' then
                                            if type(gu.States) ~= 'table' then
                                                return nil, 'Selected config file is empty or invalid.'
                                            end
                                        end

                                        local gw = gr(gu) or {}

                                        gw.Profile = gv

                                        local gx, gy = pcall(function()
                                            local gx = {
                                                Format = gg,
                                                ExportVersion = gk,
                                                Name = gv,
                                                Config = gw,
                                            }

                                            return fQ:JSONEncode(gx)
                                        end)

                                        if not (gx) then
                                            return nil, 'Config export encode failed: ' .. tostring(gy)
                                        end

                                        return gy, nil, gv
                                    end
                                    local function Kr(gu)
                                        local gv = tostring(gu or '')
                                        local gw = gv:match'^%s*(.-)%s*$' or ''

                                        if gw == '' then
                                            return nil, nil, 'Paste exported config JSON first.'
                                        end
                                        if #gw > gp then
                                            return nil, nil, 'Import is larger than the 1 MB safety limit.'
                                        end

                                        local gx, gy = pcall(function()
                                            return fQ:JSONDecode(gw)
                                        end)

                                        if gx then
                                            if type(gy) ~= 'table' then
                                                return nil, nil, 'Import text is not valid JSON.'
                                            end
                                        else
                                            return nil, nil, 'Import text is not valid JSON.'
                                        end

                                        gx, gu = nil

                                        if gy.Format == gg and type(gy.Config) == 'table' then
                                            gx, gu = gy.Name or gy.Profile or gy.Config.Profile, gy.Config
                                        else
                                            if type(gy.Values) == 'table' or type(gy.States) == 'table' then
                                                gx = gy.Profile
                                            else
                                                return nil, nil, 'JSON is not a Chilli config export.'
                                            end

                                            gu = gy
                                        end

                                        local gz, gB = Ur(gx)

                                        if not (gz) then
                                            return nil, nil, 'Exported config name is invalid: ' .. tostring(gB)
                                        end
                                        if type(gu.Values) ~= 'table' then
                                            if type(gu.States) ~= 'table' then
                                                return nil, nil, 'Imported config has no States or Values.'
                                            end
                                        end

                                        return gz, {
                                            States = type(gu.States) == 'table' and gr(gu.States) or {},
                                            Values = type(gu.Values) == 'table' and gr(gu.Values) or {},
                                        }
                                    end
                                    local function Nr(gu, gw)
                                        local gx = utf8.len(gu)

                                        if gx then
                                            if gx <= gw then
                                                return gu
                                            end
                                        else
                                            return gu
                                        end

                                        gx = utf8.offset(gu, gw + 1)

                                        return gx and gu:sub(1, gx - 1) or gu
                                    end
                                    local function Lr(gu)
                                        if not (Yr(gu)) then
                                            return gu
                                        end

                                        local gw = 1

                                        while true do
                                            local gx = '.' .. tostring(gw)
                                            local gy = Nr(gu, 48 - #gx):gsub('[%.%s]+$', '')
                                            local gz = (gy == '' and 'Imported' or gy) .. gx

                                            if not (Yr(gz)) then
                                                return gz
                                            end

                                            gw = gw + 1
                                        end
                                    end
                                    local function Nr()
                                        hr()

                                        gd = gd + 1
                                        fZ.Loading = true

                                        local gu, gw = xpcall(function()
                                            local gu, gw, gx = {}, ipairs, fM.States

                                            for gy, gz in gw(gx)do
                                                gy = f3

                                                local gB = gy[gz.Name]

                                                if not (gz._destroyed) then
                                                    if not (gz._configIgnored) then
                                                        if type(gB) == 'table' then
                                                            if gB.Value ~= nil then
                                                                gz:Set(gB.Value, false)

                                                                gu[gz] = true
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end

                                            gx, gw = ipairs, fM.Tabs

                                            for gy, gz in gx(gw)do
                                                gy = f4

                                                local gB = gy[gz.Name]

                                                if type(gB) == 'table' then
                                                    for gC, gD in ipairs(gz.Sections)do
                                                        gy = gB[gD.Name]

                                                        if type(gy) == 'table' then
                                                            for gE, gF in ipairs(gD.Options)do
                                                                local gG = gy[gF.Name]

                                                                if not (gF._destroyed) then
                                                                    if not (gF._configIgnored) then
                                                                        if type(gG) == 'table' then
                                                                            if gG.Value ~= nil then
                                                                                if gF._controller.SetValue then
                                                                                    if not (gF.State and gF.State._registered and gu[gF.State]) then
                                                                                        if type(gG.Unit) == 'string' and gF._controller.SetUnit then
                                                                                            pcall(function(
                                                                                            )
                                                                                                gF:SetUnit(gG.Unit, true)
                                                                                            end)
                                                                                            gF:Set(gG.Value, true)
                                                                                        else
                                                                                            gF:Set(gG.Value, false)
                                                                                        end
                                                                                    end
                                                                                end
                                                                            end
                                                                        end
                                                                    end
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end, function(gu)
                                            return tostring(gu)
                                        end)

                                        fZ.Loading = false

                                        if not (gu) then
                                            Br('Reset failed: ' .. tostring(gw))

                                            return
                                        end

                                        Rr(false)

                                        if d6.configLoadedHook then
                                            pcall(d6.configLoadedHook)
                                        end

                                        pcall(gf)

                                        gw = fZ.AutoSave

                                        if gw then
                                            gd = gd + 1

                                            vr(fZ.Active, false)
                                        end

                                        Br'All features reset to defaults.'
                                    end

                                        Settings = true,
                                        Quick = true,
                                        Config = true,
                                    }

                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end

                                            end
                                        end

                                    end

                                local function n()
                                    local fV, fZ, f3, f4, f5, f6, f7, f8, f9, ga, gb, gc, gd = e7.Namespace and 'ChilliQuick_' .. e7.Namespace or 'ChilliQuickBar', {

                                    local function Mr(gy)
                                        if not (gy) then
                                            return nil
                                        end

                                        return gx[gy] or tostring(gy)
                                    end

                                    for gy, gB in ipairs(eh:GetChildren())do
                                        if gB:IsA'ScreenGui' then
                                            if gB.Name == fV then

                                    local function gr(gB)
                                        for gF, gG in ipairs(fM.Tabs)do
                                            if not (gG._destroyed) then
                                                for gH, gI in ipairs(gG.Sections)do
                                                    if not (gI._destroyed) then
                                                        for gJ, gK in ipairs(gI.Options)do
                                                            if not (gK._destroyed) then
                                                                if gK.Instance then
                                                                    gB(gK, gI, gG)

                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    local function fr(gB)
                                        return fZ[gB.Type] == true and gB._quickIgnored ~= true
                                    end
                                    local function tr(gB)
                                        return f3[gB.Type] == true and gB._quickIgnored ~= true
                                    end
                                    local function kr(gB)
                                        return ('%s > %s > %s'):format(gB.Section.Tab.Name, gB.Section.Name, gB.Name)
                                    end
                                    local function Tr(gB)
                                        local gG

                                        gr(function(gI)
                                            local gK = gG

                                            if not (gK) then
                                                local gL = kr(gI) == gB

                                                if gL then
                                                    gG = gI
                                                end

local ah, ak = nil, function()
    local ah, ai, aj, ak, al = game:GetService'RunService', typeof(getgenv) == 'function' and getgenv() or _G, coroutine.running(), {
        dead = false,

        fps = type(getfpscap) == 'function' and select(2, pcall(getfpscap)) or nil,
    }, {

        Stepped = true,

        PreAnimation = true,

        local am = ai.ChilliHubLoading

        return type(am) == 'number' and os.clock() < am
    end
    local function I(am)
        return function(...)
            if ak.frozen then
                return
            elseif t() then
                return
            end

            return am(...)
        end
    end

    local function k(an)
        local ao = ah[an]

        return {
            Connect = function(aq, aC)
                aq = table.pack(I(aC))

                return ao:Connect(table.unpack(aq, 1, aq.n))
            end,
            Once = function(aq, aC)
                local aD

                aD = ao:Connect(function(...)
                    if ak.frozen then
                        return
                    elseif t() then
                        return
                    end

                    aD:Disconnect()

                    return aC(...)
                end)

                return aD
            end,
            Wait = function(aC)
                if ak.frozen then
                    return coroutine.yield()
                end
                if coroutine.running() ~= aj then
                    while t() do
                        ao:Wait()
                    end
                end

                return ao:Wait()
            end,
            ConnectParallel = function(aC, aD)
                aC = table.pack(I(aD))

                return ao:ConnectParallel(table.unpack(aC, 1, aC.n))
            end,
        }
    end

    local an = {}

    return setmetatable({
        ChilliDead = function()
            return ak.dead
        end,
        ChilliKill = function(ao)
            ak.dead = true
            ak.frozen = ao == true or ak.frozen

            return ak.fps
        end,
    }, {

                end
            end
