        local function F(o0, o3, ...)
            local pb = a(o3)

            if not (pb) then
                on.MachineError = 'machine not found'

                return false
            end
            if on.AtStation ~= o3 then
                local pg = r(pb, 15)

                if pg then
                else
                    if type(on.TripStopped) == 'function' then
                        if on.TripStopped() then
                        else
                            on.Status = 'Trying the tree again'

                            if not (t()) then
                                q(on.TripStopped)
                            end

                            pg = t() and r(pb, 15)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not (pg) then
                    on.MachineError = t() and 'could not reach the machine' or 'left the tree'

                    return false
                end

                on.AtStation = o3
            end

            for pg = 1, 3, 1 do
                o3, pg = o(o0, ...)

                if o3 == true then
                    return true
                end

                on.MachineError = tostring(pg or 'no answer')

                if not (string.find(string.lower(on.MachineError), 'closer', 1, true)) then
                    return false
                end
                if not (r(pb, 8)) then
                    return false
                end
            end

            return false
        end
        local function o(o0)
            local o3, pb, pg, ph, pi, pj = on.Recipe, on.TradeCost, o0.Green or 0, o0.Blue or 0, o0.Purple or 0, o0.Golden or 0

            for pk = 60, 1, -1 do
                o0 = math.max(0, pk * o3.Golden - pj)

                local pl = math.max(0, pk * o3.Purple + (pb.Purple or 50) * o0 - pi)
                local pm = math.max(0, pk * o3.Blue + (pb.Blue or 10) * pl - ph)

                if pg >= pk * o3.Green + (pb.Green or 10) * pm then
                    return {
                        Essence = pk,
                        Green = pm,
                        Blue = pl,
                        Purple = o0,
                    }
                end
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function t()
            local o0 = eg
            local o3 = o0.Toggle(on.TradeHandle, false)

            o0 = nil

            if o3 then
                local pb = eg

                o0 = pb.Toggle(on.SmartHandle, false)
            else
                o0 = o3
            end

            return o0
        end
        local function a(o0)
            local o3 = eg
            local pb, pg = o3.Toggle(on.TradeHandle, false), eg

            o3 = pg.Toggle(on.CraftHandle, false)

            if pb then
            elseif o3 then
            else
                return
            end

            pg = aG

            if pg:GetAttribute'EnchantedTreeUnlocked' ~= true then
                on.MachineNote = 'Trade and craft need the Enchanted Tree open (finish the Wisp quest)'

                return
            end

            on.AtStation = nil
            on.MachineError = nil

            local function v()
                local ph, pi = o0 ~= on.TripToken

                if ph then
                    pi = ph
                else
                    local pj = eg

                    pi = pj.ButterflyYield() ~= nil
                end

                local pj, pk = pi or j() and L()

                if pj then
                    pk = pj
                else
                    ph = eg
                    pi = ph.Toggle(on.TradeHandle, false)

                    local pl

                    if pi then
                        pl = pi
                    else
                        local pm = eg

                        pl = pm.Toggle(on.CraftHandle, false)
                    end

                    pk = not pl
                end

                return pk
            end

            on.TripStopped = v

            pcall(function()
                local ph = eg
                local pi, pj = ph.Treadmill

                if pi then
                    ph = eg
                    pj = ph.Treadmill.Riding
                else
                    pj = pi
                end

                pi = nil

                if pj then
                    pi = pj
                else
                    local pk, pl = eg, type(eg.OnBelt) == 'function'

                    if pl then
                        ph = eg
                        pi = ph.OnBelt()
                    else
                        pi = pl
                    end
                end
                if pi then
                    on.Status = 'Leaving the treadmill first'
                    ph = eg

                    ph.ExitBelt()
                end
            end)

            if not (q(v)) then
                on.MachineNote = 'Could not get into the Enchanted Tree' .. (on.MachineError and ' (' .. on.MachineError .. ')' or '')

                return
            end

            local ph, pi = 0, 0

            if pb and (t()) then
                pg = o(f())

                if pg then
                    local pj, pl = ipairs, {
                        {
                            From = 'Green',
                            Count = pg.Green,
                        },
                        {
                            From = 'Blue',
                            Count = pg.Blue,
                        },
                        {
                            From = 'Purple',
                            Count = pg.Purple,
                        },
                    }

                    for pm, po in pj(pl)do
                        for pp = 1, po.Count, 1 do
                            if v() then
                                break
                            end

                            on.Status = 'Smart trade for Enchanted Essence'

                            if not (F('RF/Butterflies/AskTradeUp', 'ButterflyMachine', po.From)) then
                                break
                            end

                            ph = ph + 1

                            task.wait(0.15)
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                if pb then
                    for pj, pl in ipairs(ol)do
                        if on.Trades[pl.Label] then
                            local po, pp = on.TradeCost[pl.From] or 10, o3 and (on.Recipe[pl.From] or 0) or 0

                            for pq = 1, 400, 1 do
                                if v() then
                                    break
                                end
                                if (f()[pl.From] or 0) - pp < po then
                                    break
                                end

                                on.Status = 'Trading ' .. pl.Label .. ' at the machine'

                                if not (F('RF/Butterflies/AskTradeUp', 'ButterflyMachine', pl.From)) then
                                    break
                                end

                                ph = ph + 1

                                task.wait(0.15)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if o3 then
                for pl = 1, 50, 1 do
                    if v() then
                        break
                    end

                    pg, pb = f(), true

                    for po, pp in pairs(on.Recipe)do
                        pb = ((pg[po] or 0) < pp and {false} or {pb})[1]
                    end

                    if not pb then
                        break
                    end

                    on.Status = 'Crafting Enchanted Essence at the shrine'

                    if not (F('RF/Butterflies/AskCraftEssence', 'MutationShrine')) then
                        break
                    end

                    pi = pi + 1

                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end

            on.MachineNote = string.format('Last visit: %d trade%s, %d essence', ph, ph == 1 and '' or 's', pi)

            if on.MachineError then
                if ph == 0 then
                    if pi == 0 then
                        on.MachineNote = on.MachineNote .. ' (' .. on.MachineError .. ')'
                    end
                end
            end

            f()
        end
        local function F()
            local o0 = aG

            if o0:GetAttribute'EnchantedTreeUnlocked' ~= true then
                return false
            end

            o0 = eg

            local o3, pb = o0.Toggle(on.TradeHandle, false), eg
            local pg, ph = pb.Toggle(on.CraftHandle, false), on.Counts or {}

            if t() then
                o0 = o(ph)

                if not o0 then
                    return false
                end

                return pg or o0.Green + o0.Blue + o0.Purple > 0
            end
            if pg then
                pb = true

                for pi, pl in pairs(on.Recipe)do
                    pb = ((ph[pi] or 0) < pl and {false} or {pb})[1]
                end

                if pb then
                    return true
                end
            end
            if o3 then
                for pi, pl in ipairs(ol)do
                    if on.Trades[pl.Label] then
                        o0 = pg and (on.Recipe[pl.From] or 0) or 0

                        if (ph[pl.From] or 0) - o0 >= (on.TradeCost[pl.From] or 10) then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return false
        end
        local function o()
            on.Busy = true
            on.Generation = on.Generation + 1

            local o0 = on.Generation

            local function f()
                return o0 == on.Generation and L() and j()
            end

            on.Wants = true
            on.RagdollTries = 0

            local o3 = eg

            o3.Shield(og, true)
            pcall(function()
                local pb = eg
                local pg, ph = pb.Treadmill

                if pg then
                    pb = eg
                    ph = pb.Treadmill.Riding
                else
                    ph = pg
                end
                if ph then
                    pb = eg

                    pb.ExitBelt()
                else
                    local pl, po = eg, type(eg.OnBelt) == 'function'

                    if po then
                        pg = eg

                        local pp = pg.OnBelt()

                        if pp then
                            local pq = eg

                            pq.ExitBelt()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local pb = eg
                local pg = pb.SafeCarry

                if type(pg.V2_InZone) == 'function' then
                    if pg.V2_InZone() then
                        on.Status = 'Leaving the fuse area first'

                        pg.V2_LeaveZone()
                    end
                end
            end)

            o3 = eg

            o3.BeginFlight()

            if not (on.NetClaimed) then
                if f() then
                    P(o0)
                end
            end

            while f() do
                o3 = ah

                local pb, pg = o3.Heartbeat:Wait(), eg
                local ph = pg.ButterflyYield()

                if ph then
                    on.Status = ph

                    break
                end

                ph = on.NetClaimed
                pg = (ph and {
                    (not ph),
                } or {
                    (not d()),
                })[1]

                if pg then
                    if not (P(o0)) then
                        on.Status = 'Could not claim the net yet, retrying'

                        task.wait(2)
                    end
                else
                    if V(o0) == 'wait' then
                        J()

                        break
                    end

                    m()

                    ph = eg

                    local po = ph.Root()

                    if po then
                        local pp = g()

                        if on.Mode == 'Stand Still' or on.Mode == 'Patrol' or on.Mode == 'Circle' then
                            local pq, ps = po.Position, {}

                            for pt, pu in ipairs(pp)do
                                if (pu.Position - pq).Magnitude <= on.Reach - 2 then
                                    table.insert(ps, pu)
                                end
                            end

                            local pu, pv, pw = M(ps, pq), h(on.Mode == 'Patrol' and E() or on.Mode == 'Circle' and D() or S()), T()

                            if (pv - po.Position).Magnitude > 8 then
                                G(pv, pb)
                                pcall(function()
                                    po.CFrame = CFrame.new(po.Position) * pw
                                    po.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                end)

                                on.Status = 'Going to the middle of the bloom'
                            else
                                pcall(function()
                                    po.CFrame = CFrame.new(pv) * pw
                                    po.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                    po.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                end)

                                if pu then
                                    on.Status = string.format('Standing, catching a %s butterfly  |  %d flying', ({
                                        Green = 'Emerald',
                                        Blue = 'Sapphire',
                                        Purple = 'Amethyst',
                                        Golden = 'Radiant',
                                    })[pu.Tier] or pu.Tier, #pp)
                                else
                                    on.Status = string.format('Standing in the bloom  |  %d flying', #pp)
                                end
                            end

                            continue
                        end

                        local ps, pu = nil, on.ChaseLock

                        if pu then
                            if os.clock() < pu.Until then
                                local pv = ps

                                for pw, px in ipairs(pp)do
                                    if px.Id == pu.Id then
                                        pv = px

                                        break
                                    end
                                end

                                ps = pv
                            end
                        end
                        if ps then
                        else
                            ps = M(pp, po.Position)

                            if ps then
                                on.ChaseLock = {
                                    Id = ps.Id,
                                    Until = os.clock() + 1,
                                }
                            end
                        end
                        if ps then
                            local pv = Vector3.zero

                            pu = op and type(op.VelocityAt) == 'function' and type(ps.Flight) == 'table'

                            if pu then
                                local px, py = pcall(op.VelocityAt, ps.Flight, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())

                                if px and typeof(py) == 'Vector3' then
                                    pv = py
                                end
                            end

                            local px, py = po.Position, T()
                            local pz, pA = (ps.Position - px).Magnitude, ps.Position

                            if (pA - px).Magnitude <= 40 then
                                pcall(function()
                                    po.CFrame = CFrame.new(pA) * py
                                    po.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(pv.X, 0, pv.Z)
                                    po.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                end)
                            else
                                G(pA, pb)
                                pcall(function()
                                    po.CFrame = CFrame.new(po.Position) * py
                                    po.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                end)
                            end

                            on.Status = string.format('Catching a %s butterfly, %d studs  |  %d flying', ({
                                Green = 'Emerald',
                                Blue = 'Sapphire',
                                Purple = 'Amethyst',
                                Golden = 'Radiant',
                            })[ps.Tier] or ps.Tier, math.floor(pz + 0.5), #pp)
                            px = pz <= on.Reach - 2
                        else
                            G(h(S()), pb)

                            on.Status = 'Waiting for butterflies in the bloom'
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            on.Wants = false
            o3 = eg

            local pb, pg = o3.InvisButterfly

            if pb then
                o3 = j()
                pg = (o3 and {
                    (not L()),
                } or {
                    (not o3),
                })[1]
            else
                pg = pb
            end
            if pg then
                o3 = eg
                o3.InvisButterfly = false
                f = eg
                pb = f.InvisibilityHandle

                local ph = pb ~= nil

                if ph then
                    local po = eg
                    local pp = po.Toggle(pb, false)

                    if pp then
                        po = eg

                        po.Notify('Invisibility', 'Butterfly catching is done, Invisibility is back on.')
                    end
                end
            end

            J()
            pcall(eg.EndFlight)

            pb = eg

            pb.Shield(og, false)

            pb = eg

            pb.ReleaseMovement(og)

            on.Busy = false
            pb = cL

            pb.Wake()
        end

                ps = pg

                po = ps

                pg = eg

                on.Claiming = false

                    return true

                po = pg

                ps = eg
                po = ps.WallSealed()

                ps = eg

                        on.Claiming = false

                        return true
                    end

                on.Claiming = false
                on.Status = 'Another task is moving, trying the butterflies again soon'

            ps = pg.InvisButterfly

                    on.ClaimWaitSince = nil
                    on.ClaimBackoffUntil = os.clock() + 20

                    pcall(eg.EndFlight)
                    pcall(eg.Shield, og, false)

                    px = eg

                    px.ReleaseMovement(og)

                    on.Busy = false
                end
            end)

            return true
        end)

    eg.EssenceBoot = function(ob)
        if not (ob) then
            return
        end

        local og, ol, on, oo, op, o0, o3 = 'essence', 'RF/BossMastery/AskUseMutationConsumable', 6, {
            'Highest Value',
            'Best Rarity',
            'Biggest Size',
        }, {
            {
                Id = 'Boss',
                Label = 'Fractured',
            },
            {
                Id = 'Scrambled',
                Label = 'Scrambled',
            },
            {
                Id = 'Enchanted',
                Label = 'Enchanted',
            },
            {
                Id = 'Nitro',
                Label = 'Nitro',
            },
        }, {}, {}

        for pb, po in ipairs(op)do
            table.insert(o0, po.Label)

            o3[po.Label] = po.Id
        end

        local po, ps = {
            Handle = nil,
            Row = nil,
            Shown = nil,
            Loop = 0,
            MinRarity = 0,
            Priority = oo[1],
            Use = {
                Boss = true,
                Scrambled = true,
                Enchanted = true,
                Nitro = true,
            },
            Delay = 1,
            Status = 'Off',
            Detail = '',
            Cooldown = 0,
            Left = 0,
            Bag = '',
            Tries = 0,
            Hits = 0,
            Missed = 0,
            Locked = nil,
            Refused = {},
            Fails = 0,
            Paused = false,
            MinIncome = 0,
            Targets = {},
            EggOptions = {},
            EggCategory = {},
        }, eg

        ps.EssenceState = po
        ps = bh

        local pu, pv = ps.Assets

        if pu then
            ps = bh
            pv = ps.Assets.Directory
        else
            pv = pu
        end

        pu = {}

        if type(pv) == 'table' then
            for px, py in pairs(pv)do
                ps = type(py) == 'table' and py.Rarity or nil

                local pz = type(ps) == 'table' and tonumber(ps.RarityNumber or ps.Rank) or nil

                if pz then
                    table.insert(pu, {
                        Category = tostring(px),
                        Name = tostring(py.DisplayName or px),
                        Rarity = pz,
                        RarityName = tostring(ps.DisplayName or ps._id or pz),
                    })
                end
            end
        end

        table.sort(pu, function(px, py)
            if px.Rarity ~= py.Rarity then
                return px.Rarity > py.Rarity
            end

            return px.Name < py.Name
        end)

        for px, py in ipairs(pu)do
            pv = string.format('%s [%s]', py.Name, py.RarityName)
            pv = (po.EggCategory[pv] and {
                (string.format('%s [%s] (%s)', py.Name, py.RarityName, py.Category)),
            } or {pv})[1]

            table.insert(po.EggOptions, pv)

            po.EggCategory[pv] = py.Category
        end

        local function f()
            local py = eg

            return py.Toggle(po.Handle, false) == true
        end
        local function T(py)
            local pz = bh
            local pA, pB = pz.Assets

            if pA then
                pz = bh
                pB = pz.Assets.Directory
            else
                pB = pA
            end

            return type(pB) == 'table' and pB[tostring(py)] or nil
        end
        local function h(py)
            local pz = T(py.AssetCategory)

            py = type(pz) == 'table' and pz.Rarity or nil

            return type(py) == 'table' and tonumber(py.RarityNumber or py.Rank) or 0
        end
        local function S(py)
            local pz = T(py.AssetCategory)
            local pA, pB = type(pz) == 'table' and tonumber(pz.EarningRate) or 0, tonumber(py.AssetScale) or 0

            if pA <= 0 then
                return 0
            elseif pB <= 0 then
                return 0
            end

            local pC, pD, pE = pB > 5 and (pB / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or pB ^ 1.85, 1, bh

            pB = pE.Mutations

            if type(pB) == 'table' then
                if type(pB.EarningsFor) == 'function' then
                    pE, pz = pcall(pB.EarningsFor, type(py.Mutations) == 'table' and py.Mutations or {})
                    pD = (pE and {
                        (type(pz) == 'number' and {
                            (pz > 0 and {pz} or {pD})[1],
                        } or {pD})[1],
                    } or {pD})[1]
                end
            end

            return pA * pC * pD
        end
        local function E(py)
            local pz, pA = {}, py.BaseMutation

            if type(pA) == 'string' then
                if pA ~= '' then
                    if pA ~= 'Normal' then
                        pz[pA] = true
                    end
                end
            end

            pA = py.Mutations

            if type(pA) == 'table' then
                for pB, pC in pairs(pA)do
                    if type(pC) == 'string' and pC ~= '' then
                        pz[pC] = true
                    elseif type(pB) == 'string' then
                        if pC ~= false then
                            pz[pB] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif type(pA) == 'string' then
                for pB in string.gmatch(pA, '[^,]+')do
                    pB = string.gsub(pB, '^%s+', '')
                    pB = string.gsub(pB, '%s+$', '')

                    if pB ~= '' then
                        pz[pB] = true
                    end
                end
            end

            pz.Normal = nil

            return pz
        end
        local function D()
            local py = bh
            local pz = py.EggState

            if type(pz) ~= 'table' then
                return {}
            elseif type(pz.ReadOwnerEggs) ~= 'function' then
                return {}
            end

            local pA, pB, pC = aG, pcall(pz.ReadOwnerEggs, aG.UserId)

            if pB then
                if type(pC) ~= 'table' then
                    return {}
                end
            else
                return {}
            end

            pz = {}

            for pD, pE in pairs(pC)do
                if type(pE) == 'table' then
                    if pE.Placement ~= nil then
                        pE.Uid = pE.Uid or pD
                        pz[#pz + 1] = pE
                    end
                end
            end

            return pz
        end
        local function J(pz)
            for pB, pC in ipairs(D())do
                if pC.Uid == pz then
                    return pC
                end
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function G(pz)
            local pC = pz and pz.Uid

            if pC then
                pz = workspace:FindFirstChild'AreaEggSlotsClient'

                local pD = pz and (pz:FindFirstChild(pC))

                if pD then
                    local pE, pF = pcall(function()
                        return pD:GetPivot().Position
                    end)

                    if pE then
                        if typeof(pF) == 'Vector3' then
                            return pF
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            pC, pz = eg, type(eg.PenAnchor) == 'function'

            if pz then
                local pD, pE, pF = eg, pcall(eg.PenAnchor)

                if pE then
                    if typeof(pF) == 'Vector3' then
                        return pF
                    end
                end
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function V(pz)
            if pz then
                if not (pz:IsA'Tool') then
                    return nil
                end
            else
                return nil
            end
            if tostring(pz:GetAttribute'ItemType') ~= 'MutationConsumable' then
                return nil
            end

            return tostring(pz:GetAttribute'MutationId' or pz:GetAttribute'MutationTemplate' or 'Boss')
        end
        local function P()
            local pz, pC, pE, pF, pG = {}, ipairs, {}, aG, aG;

            (function(pH, pI, ...)
                local pJ = table.pack(...)

                table.move(pJ, 1, pJ.n, pI + 1, pH)
            end)(pE, 0, pF.Character, pG:FindFirstChildOfClass'Backpack')

            for pH, pI in pC(pE)do
                if pI then
                    for pJ, pK in ipairs(pI:GetChildren())do
                        pH = V(pK)

                        if pH then
                            pJ = tonumber(pK:GetAttribute'Uses') or tonumber(string.match(pK.Name, '%[X(%d+)%]')) or 1

                            if pJ > 0 then
                                pG = pz[pH]

                                if pG then
                                    pG.Uses = pG.Uses + pJ
                                else
                                    pz[pH] = {
                                        Tool = pK,
                                        Uses = pJ,
                                    }
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return pz
        end
        local function F(pz)
            local pC, pE = {}, 0

            for pF, pG in ipairs(op)do
                pF = pz[pG.Id] and pz[pG.Id].Uses or 0

                if po.Use[pG.Id] then
                    pE = pE + pF

                    table.insert(pC, string.format('%s %d', pG.Label, pF))
                else
                    if pF > 0 then
                        table.insert(pC, string.format('%s %d (not picked)', pG.Label, pF))
                    end
                end
            end

            return table.concat(pC, '  '), pE
        end

        po.Count = function()
            local pz, pC = F(P())

            return pC
        end

        local function V(pC)
            local pE, pF, pG, pH = os.clock(), -1

            for pI, pJ in ipairs(D())do
                local pK, pL = E(pJ), h(pJ) < po.MinRarity and true or false
                local pM, pN = pL or ((po.MinIncome > 0 and {
                    S(pJ) < po.MinIncome and true or pL,
                } or {pL})[1])

                if pM or ((next(po.Targets) ~= nil and {
                    po.Targets[tostring(pJ.AssetCategory)] ~= true and true or pM,
                } or {pM})[1]) then
                else
                    for pO, pP in ipairs(op)do
                        if po.Use[pP.Id] then
                            if pC[pP.Id] then
                                if pK[pP.Id] ~= true then
                                    if (po.Refused[tostring(pJ.Uid) .. ':' .. pP.Id] or 0) <= pE then
                                        pN = pP

                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if pN then
                    pM = (po.Priority == oo[2] and {
                        (h(pJ) * 1000 + (tonumber(pJ.AssetScale) or 0)),
                    } or {
                        (po.Priority == oo[3] and {
                            tonumber(pJ.AssetScale) or 0,
                        } or {
                            (S(pJ)),
                        })[1],
                    })[1]

                    if pM > pF then
                        pF, pG, pH = pM, pJ, pN
                    else
                        if pM == pF then
                            if pJ.Uid == po.Locked then
                                pF, pG, pH = pM, pJ, pN
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return pG, pH
        end
        local function h(pC)
            local pE = T(pC.AssetCategory)
            local pF = type(pE) == 'table' and tostring(pE.DisplayName or pC.AssetCategory) or tostring(pC.AssetCategory)

            return string.format('%s %.2f kg', pF, tonumber(pC.AssetScale) or 0)
        end
        local function T()
            local pC = eg
            local pE, pF = pC.Priority, eg
            local pG, pH = pF.Movement, eg
            local pJ, pK, pL = pH.Steal or {}, pE.Rank.Essence or 99, eg

            if pL.StealDawn(pK) then
                return 'Auto Steal goes first after the night'
            end

            pL, pC = eg, type(eg.CaptureBusy) == 'function'

            if pC then
                pF = eg

                if pF.CaptureBusy() then
                    return 'Capture The Egg goes first'
                end
            end
            if pG.PlaceWanted == true then
                if pE.Above('Place', 'Essence') then
                    return 'Auto Place goes first'
                end
            end
            if pJ.Carrying == true then
                return 'Auto Steal goes first'
            elseif pJ.Wanted == true then
                if (pJ.WantedRank or 0) < pK then
                    return 'Auto Steal goes first'
                end
            end

            pF, pG = eg, type(eg.ButterflyOver) == 'function'

            if pG then
                pK = eg

                if pK.ButterflyOver(og) then
                    return 'Butterfly Bloom goes first'
                end
            end
            if pE.TreadmillOver'Essence' then
                return 'Treadmill goes first'
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function S(pC)
            return pC ~= po.Loop or not f() or T() ~= nil
        end
        local function D()
            local pC = po.Paused

            if not (pC) then
                po.Paused = true

                local pE = eg
                local pF = pE.InvisMutate

                if not (pF) then
                    pE = eg
                    pE.InvisMutate = true

                    local pG = eg
                    local pH = pG.InvisibilityHandle

                    pG = pH ~= nil

                    if pG then
                        local pJ = eg
                        local pK = pJ.Toggle(pH, false)

                        if pK then
                            pJ = eg

                            pJ.Notify('Invisibility', 'Invisibility is paused while Auto Mutation runs and comes back after it.')
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            pC = aG

            local pE = pC.Character

            return not (pE and pE:GetAttribute'InvisApplied' == true)
        end
        local function p()
            local pC = po.Paused

            if pC then
                po.Paused = false

                local pE = eg
                local pF = pE.InvisMutate

                if pF then
                    pE = eg
                    pE.InvisMutate = false

                    local pG = eg
                    local pH = pG.InvisibilityHandle

                    pG = pH ~= nil

                    if pG then
                        local pJ = eg
                        local pK = pJ.Toggle(pH, false)

                        if pK then
                            pJ = eg

                            pJ.Notify('Invisibility', 'Auto Mutation is done, Invisibility is back on.')
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function s(pC, pE)
            local pF = G(pC)

            pC = pF == nil

            if pC then
                return true
            else
                local pG = eg

                if pG.DistanceTo(pF) <= on then
                    return true
                end
            end

            pC = eg

            local pG = pC.Treadmill.Riding

            if pG then
                pC = eg

                pC.ExitBelt()
            else
                local pH = eg
                local pJ = pH.OnBelt()

                if pJ then
                    pH = eg

                    pH.ExitBelt()
                end
            end

            pG = eg

            pG.HoldBelt()

            local pH, pJ, pK = eg, pcall(eg.FlyTo, pF + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), function(
            )
                return S(pE)
            end, og)

            pG = eg

            pG.ReleaseBelt()

            pG = eg

            pG.LeaveBelt()

            pG, pC = pJ and pK

            if pG then
                pK = eg
                pC = pK.DistanceTo(pF) <= on + 4
            else
                pC = pG
            end

            return pC
        end
        local function m(pC)
            local pE = aG
            local pF = pE.Character
            local pG = pF and (pF:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid')

            if not pF or not pG then
                return false
            elseif not pC then
                return false
            elseif pC.Parent == nil then
                return false
            end
            if pC.Parent ~= pF then
                pcall(function()
                    pG:EquipTool(pC)
                end)

                if pC.Parent ~= pF then
                    pcall(function()
                        pC.Parent = pF
                    end)
                end

                task.wait(0.3)
            end

            return pC.Parent == pF
        end
        local function o(pC, pF, pG)
            local pJ = os.clock() + pC

            while os.clock() < pJ do
                if S(pF) then
                    return
                elseif pG then
                    if pG() then
                        return
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        end
        local function G(pC, pF, pG, pJ)
            if not (m(pG)) then
                po.Status = 'Could not hold ' .. pF.Label
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2

                return false
            end

            pG = aH

            local pK = pG:FindFirstChild(ol)

            if (pK and {
                (not pK:IsA'RemoteFunction'),
            } or {
                (not pK),
            })[1] then
                po.Status = 'Mutation remote is missing'
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 10

                return false
            end

            po.Status = 'Applying'
            po.Tries = po.Tries + 1

            local pL, pM, pN = os.clock(), pcall(pK.InvokeServer, pK, pC.Uid)

            if (pM and {
                (type(pN) ~= 'table'),
            } or {
                (not pM),
            })[1] then
                po.Status = 'No answer from the server'
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 10

                return false
            end

            po.Locked = nil

            if pN.Success == true then
                po.Fails = 0

                if pN.Mutated == true then
                    po.Hits = po.Hits + 1
                    po.Status = 'Applied'

                    o(3, pJ, function()
                        local pP = J(pC.Uid)

                        return pP == nil or E(pP)[pF.Id] == true
                    end)
                else
                    po.Missed = po.Missed + 1
                    po.Status = 'Roll failed'
                end

                o(po.Delay - (os.clock() - pL), pJ)

                return true
            end

            pM = tostring(pN.Message or '')
            po.Status = pM ~= '' and pM or 'The server refused it'
            po.Refused[tostring(pC.Uid) .. ':' .. pF.Id] = os.clock() + 120
            po.Fails = po.Fails + 1

            if po.Fails >= 3 then
                po.Fails = 0
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 15

                return false
            end

            o(1, pJ)

            return true
        end
        local function o()
            local pC = os.clock() + 3

            while true do
                local pF, pG = os.clock() < pC

                if pF then
                    local pJ = eg

                    pG = not pJ.Grounded()
                else
                    pG = pF
                end
                if not pG then
                    break
                end

                pG = ah

                pG.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end
        local function t(pC)
            local pF = pC.Nitro

            if pF then
                return false
            else
                pC = os.clock() < (po.BuyAt or 0)

                if pC then
                    return false
                else
                    local pG = eg

                    if not (pG.Toggle(po.BuyHandle, false)) then
                        return false

            po.BuyAt = os.clock() + 2

            local pG, pJ, pK = pF and type(pC) == 'table' and pC.Shop and pC.Shop.MutationToken or nil, pcall(function(
            )
                local pG = bh

                return pG.Save.Get()
            end)

            pF = pJ and type(pK) == 'table' and type(pK.RaceRally) == 'table' and tonumber(pK.RaceRally.Tokens) or 0

            if pG then
                if pF < (tonumber(pG.Price) or 1 / 0) then
                    return false
                end
            else
                return false
            end

            pJ = aH
            pG = pJ:FindFirstChild'RF/RaceRally/AskBuy'

            if pG then
                if not (pG:IsA'RemoteFunction') then
                    return false
                end
            else
                return false
            end

            pJ, pC = pcall(pG.InvokeServer, pG, 'MutationToken')

            if pJ and pC then
                po.BuyAt = 0
                pF = os.clock() + 1.5

                while os.clock() < pF and not P().Nitro do
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end

                return true
            end

            return false
        end
        local function d(pC)
            local pF = eg

            if os.clock() < (pF.ConfigSettleUntil or 0) then
                po.Status = 'Waiting for your config to load'

                return
            end
            if os.clock() < po.Cooldown then
                return
            end

            pF = P()
            pF = (t(pF) and {
                (P()),
            } or {pF})[1]

            local pG, pJ = F(pF)

            po.Bag = pG
            po.Left = pJ

            if next(po.Use) == nil then
                p()

                po.Status = 'Pick at least one mutation in Mutations To Use'
                po.Detail = ''
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 5

                return
            end
            if pJ <= 0 then
                p()

                po.Status = 'No consumables in your bag'
                po.Detail = ''
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 5

                return
            end

            pJ = V(pF)

            if (pJ and {
                (not pJ.Uid),
            } or {
                (not pJ),
            })[1] then
                p()

                po.Status = 'Waiting'
                po.Detail = 'No egg to mutate'
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 5

                return
            end

            po.Detail = h(pJ)
            pF = T()

            if pF then
                po.Status = pF
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2

                return
            end
            if not (D()) then
                po.Status = 'Leaving Invisibility to hold the consumable'
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 0.5

                return
            end

            pJ = eg
            pG = pJ.ClaimMovement(og)

            if not pG then
                pF = nil
                pF, po.Status = eg, 'Waiting for ' .. tostring(eg.Movement.Owner or 'movement')
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2

                return
            end

            pJ = eg
            pJ.Movement.EssenceWanted = true
            pG, pF = pcall(function()
                while not S(pC) do
                    local pK = P()

                    pK = (t(pK) and {
                        (P()),
                    } or {pK})[1]
                    po.Bag, po.Left = F(pK)

                    local pL, pM = V(pK)

                    if ((pL and {
                        (not pL.Uid),
                    } or {
                        (not pL),
                    })[1]) or not pM then
                        po.Status = 'Waiting'
                        po.Detail = po.Left > 0 and 'No egg to mutate' or 'Out of consumables'

                        break
                    end

                    po.Locked = pL.Uid
                    po.Detail = pM.Label .. ' -> ' .. h(pL)

                    if not (s(pL, pC)) then
                        po.Status = 'Could not reach the egg'
                        po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 3

                        break
                    end
                    if S(pC) then
                        break
                    elseif not (G(pL, pM, pK[pM.Id].Tool, pC)) then
                        break
                    end
                end
            end)

            if not pG then
                po.Status = 'Stopped: ' .. tostring(pF)
                po.Cooldown = os.clock() + 3
            end

            o()

            pG = eg
            pG.Movement.EssenceWanted = false
            pF = eg

            pF.ReleaseMovement(og)
            task.delay(5, function()
                local pK = eg

                if pK.Movement.Owner ~= og then
                    p()
                end
            end)
        end

        local function R(o0)

        local function L(po, ps)

        local function X(po, ps, pC)
            local pN, pP = eg, type(eg.EggIncome)

        local po = {
            At = 0,
            Species = nil,
            Uids = {},
            Pets = {},
        }

        local function a()
            if os.clock() - po.At < 2 then
                return po
            end

            po.At = os.clock()
            po.Species = nil
            po.Uids = {}
            po.Pets = {}

            local ps, pC = W()
            local pR = ps and m() or nil

            if ps then
                if not (pR) then
                    return po
                end
            else
                return po
            end

            local pS, pT = type(pR.Inventory) == 'table' and pR.Inventory or {}, {}

            for pU, pV in pairs(L(pR, pC))do
                ps = {}

                for pW, pX in ipairs(pV)do
                    local pY, pZ, p_ = pS[pX], table.insert, {Uid = pX}

                    p_.Value = X(pU, pY and pY.Scale, pY and pY.Mutations)

                    pZ(ps, p_)
                end

                table.sort(ps, function(pX, pY)
                    return pX.Value < pY.Value
                end)

                pT[pU] = ps
            end

            local pU, pV, pX = {}, {}, {}

            pcall(function()
                local pY = bh
                local pZ, p_, p0, p1 = aG, pY.EggState.ReadOwnerEggs(aG.UserId), pcall(function(
                )
                    local pZ = al

                    return require(pZ.Shared.Util.EggRecords)
                end)

                for p2, p3 in pairs(type(p_) == 'table' and p_ or {})do
                    pY = type(p3) == 'table' and tostring(p3.AssetCategory)

                    if pY then
                        if pC[pY] then
                            if p3.Placement ~= nil then
                                pU[pY] = (pU[pY] or 0) + 1
                            else
                                pV[pY] = pV[pY] or {}

                                local p4, p5, p6 = table.insert, pV[pY], {Uid = p2}

                                p6.Value = X(pY, p3.AssetScale, p3.Mutations)

                                p4(p5, p6)
                            end
                            if p0 then
                                if type(p1.GrowthDuration) == 'function' then
                                    local p4, p5 = pcall(p1.GrowthDuration, p3)

                                    if p4 then
                                        if type(p5) == 'number' then
                                            pX[pY] = math.min(pX[pY] or 1 / 0, p5)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            pS, ps, pR = 1 / 0, 1 / 0

            for pY in pairs(pC)do
                local p_, p0 = pT[pY] and #pT[pY] or 0, pV[pY] or {}

                table.sort(p0, function(p1, p2)
                    return p1.Value < p2.Value
                end)

                if p_ + (pU[pY] or 0) + #p0 >= 3 then
                    local p1, p2, p3 = p_ >= 3 and 0 or (pX[pY] or 1 / 0), 0, 0

                    for p4, p5 in ipairs(pT[pY] or {})do
                        if p2 < 3 then
                            p3 = p3 + p5.Value
                            p2 = p2 + 1
                        end
                    end
                    for p5, p6 in ipairs(p0)do
                        if p2 < 3 then
                            p3 = p3 + p6.Value
                            p2 = p2 + 1
                        end
                    end

                    if p1 < pS then
                        pS, ps, pR = p1, p3, pY
                    else
                        if p1 == pS then
                            if p3 < ps then
                                pS, ps, pR = p1, p3, pY
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            po.Species = pR

            if pR then
                po.Pets = pT[pR] or {}

                for pY = 1, math.max(0, 3 - #po.Pets - (pU[pR] or 0)), 1 do
                    pS = (pV[pR] or {})[pY]

                    if pS then
                        po.Uids[pS.Uid] = true
                    end
                end
            end

            return po
        end

        local ps = eg

        local function I(pS, pT)

        local function L()
            local pS, pT = W()
            local pU = m()

            if pS then
                if not (pU) then
                    return nil
                end
            else
                return nil
            end
            if pU.FusionLocked == true then
                if type(pU.FusionEggReward) == 'table' then
                    I'RF/Fusery/FinishReveal'
                end

                return 'Fusing, waiting for the result'
            end

            local pV, pX

            pS = a()

            if pS.Species then
                if #pS.Pets >= 3 then
                    local pY, p_ = pS.Species, {}

                    for p0 = 1, 3, 1 do
                        table.insert(p_, pS.Pets[p0].Uid)
                    end

                    pV, pX = pY, p_
                end
            end
            if not (pV) then
                if j(pU, pT) >= 3 then
                    return 'Hatching Enchanted Forest eggs for the fuse'
                end

                return 'Stealing Enchanted Forest eggs for the fuse'
            end

            pT, pS = type(pU.FusionSlots) == 'table' and pU.FusionSlots or {}, {}

            for pY = 1, 3, 1 do
                pS[pX[pY] ] = true
            end
            for pY = 1, 3, 1 do
                local p_ = pT[pY]

                if p_ ~= nil then
                    if not (pS[p_]) then
                        I('RF/Fusery/EjectPet', p_)
                        task.wait(0.35)
                    end
                end
            end

            if pU.FusionInfoAcknowledged == false then
                I'RF/Fusery/ConfirmBriefing'
                task.wait(0.35)
            end

            pU = {}

            for pY = 1, 3, 1 do
                if pT[pY] ~= nil then
                    pU[pT[pY] ] = true
                end
            end
            for pY = 1, 3, 1 do
                pT = pX[pY]

                if not (pU[pT]) then
                    pY, pS = I('RF/Fusery/LoadPet', pT)

                    if pY then
                        if pS == false then
                            return 'Could not load the pets into the Fuse Machine'
                        end
                    else
                        return 'Could not load the pets into the Fuse Machine'
                    end

                    task.wait(0.35)
                end
            end

            pU, pT = I'RF/Fusery/BeginFuse'

            if pU then
                if pT == false then
                    return 'Fuse Machine refused (money or slots)'
                end
            else
                return 'Fuse Machine refused (money or slots)'
            end

        end

        local pS = {

            Value = 0,

        ol.Need = function(pT)

        local function W(pV)

        local function X()
            local pV = ol.State

            if type(pV) ~= 'table' then
                ol.Status = 'Reading your Wisp'

                return
            end

                ol.Status = 'Done, the Enchanted Tree is open'

                return
            end

            pcall(function()

                if p0 then

                            I'RF/Fusery/FinishReveal'

                    return

                        'Build',

            if p1 then
                if not (Z(p1)) then
                    if e(p1) >= (tonumber(p1.Target) or 1) then
                        ol.Status = 'Claiming ' .. tostring(p1.Title)

                        local p3, p6 = R('Claim', p1.Id)

                        if not (p3) then
                            ol.Status = 'Claim: ' .. tostring(p6 or 'no answer')
                        end

                        return
                    end
                end
            end
            if p0 >= ol.StageCount then
                j(function()
                    ol.Status = 'Taking the Wisp back to the Enchanted Tree'

                    if not (pV.Returning) then

                    end

                        'Build',
                        'EnchantedForestZone',
                        'Zone13Props',
                        'EnchantedTree',
                        'WispAnchor',
                    })) then

                        return
                    end

                end)

                if p1.Event == 'PetFused' then
                    local p6, p7 = pcall(L)

                    p3 = p6 and p7 and '  |  ' .. p7 or ''
                else
                    p3 = (p1.Event == 'EggSecured' and {
                        (type(p1.Match) == 'table' and {
                            p1.Match.Rarity ~= nil and '  |  waiting for an Eternal egg in this server' or p3,
                        } or {p3})[1],
                    } or {p3})[1]
                end

                ol.Status = string.format('Stage %d/%d  |  %s %d/%d%s', p0, ol.StageCount, tostring(p1.Title), e(p1), tonumber(p1.Target) or 1, p3)
            end
        end

        ol.Row = ob:CreateText{
            Name = 'Wisp Status',
            Text = 'Off',
        }
        ol.BuiltAt = os.clock()
        ol.Handle = ob:CreateToggle{
            Name = 'Auto Wisp',
            Default = false,
            Callback = function(pV)
                local p0 = pV == true and os.clock() - (ol.BuiltAt or 0) > 4

                if p0 then
                    local p1, p3, p6 = 0, false, false

                        p1 = tonumber(p8.SpeedPower) or 0
                        p3 = type(p8.WispCompanion) == 'table' and p8.WispCompanion.Accepted == true
                        p6 = type(p8.WispCompanion) == 'table' and p8.WispCompanion.Unlocked == true

                        if p7 then

                            p8.Notify('Auto Wisp', string.format('Needs %.0fB Speed Power to meet the Wisp (you have %.2fB). It stays on and starts by itself once you reach %.0fB.', ol.Required / 1000000000, p1 / 1000000000, ol.Required / 1000000000))
                        end
                    end
                end

                ol.NextTry = 0
                p0 = cL

                p0.Wake()
            end,
        }
        ob = cL

        ob.Add(function()
            local pV = d()

            if pV then
                local p0 = ol.Busy

                if not (p0) then
                    local p1 = ol.Stepping

                    if not (p1) then
                        local p3 = os.clock() >= ol.NextTry

                        if p3 then
                            ol.NextTry = os.clock() + 3
                            ol.Stepping = true

                                pcall(X)

                                ol.Stepping = false

                                local p6 = cL

                                p6.Wake()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local p0, p1 = d() and ol.Status or 'Off', eg
            local p3 = p1.Banjo

            pV = aG
            p1 = pV:GetAttribute'EnchantedTreeUnlocked' == true

            if p1 then
                pV = type(p3) == 'table'

                if pV then
                    local p6 = eg

                    p0 = (p6.Toggle(p3.Handle, false) and {
                        ('Banjo Cricket: ' .. tostring(p3.Status)),
                    } or {p0})[1]
                end
            end

            pV = ol.Row

            if pV then
                ol.Shown = p0
                p1 = eg

                p1.ShowRow(ol.Row, p0)
            end

            return true
        end)

        ob = bE

        ob(function()
            ol.Generation = ol.Generation + 1

            pcall(eg.ReleaseMovement, og)
        end)
    end

    eg.WispBoot(bh.WispSection)
end

                return 'Capture The Egg goes first'
            end
        end

        pV = eg
        p6 = pV.Butterfly
        pV = type(p6) == 'table'

            p0 = p6.Busy == true

            if p0 then
                return 'Butterfly Bloom goes first'
            else
                local p7 = p6.Claiming == true

                if p7 then
                    return 'Butterfly Bloom goes first'
                else
                    local p8 = eg

                    if p8.Toggle(p6.Handle, false) then
                        if workspace:GetAttribute'Event_ButterflyBloom' == true then
                            return 'Butterfly Bloom goes first'
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        p0, p6 = os.clock(), eg

        for p7, p8 in pairs(p6.MovementWaiting)do
            if p7 ~= i7 then
                if p0 - p8 < 6 then
                    return 'Waiting for ' .. tostring(p7)
                end
            end
        end

        return nil
    end
    local function M(pV)

    end
    local function f()

    local function S()

        l9.Ghost = p6.Stepped:Connect(function()
            for p9, qa in ipairs(p1)do

    end

                l9.Ghost:Disconnect()

            l9.Ghost = nil

            for p1, p6 in ipairs(l9.GhostParts or {})do

    local function D(p6, p7, qa, qb, qc)
        local qd = p7 - p6.Position
        local qe, qf = qd.Magnitude, qc and Vector3.new(qc.X - p6.Position.X, 0, qc.Z - p6.Position.Z) or Vector3.new(qd.X, 0, qd.Z)

        pcall(function()
            if qe < 0.5 then
                p6.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            else
                p6.AssemblyLinearVelocity = qd.Unit * math.min(qa, qe / math.max(qb, 0.016666666666666666))
            end

            p6.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

            if qf.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                p6.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(p6.Position, p6.Position + qf.Unit)
            end
        end)

        return qe
    end
    local function V(p6, p7, qa, qb)
        local qc = eg
        local qd = qc.Root()

        if qd then
            if not p6 then
                return false
            end
        else
            return false
        end

        G()

        local qe, qf = (p6 - qd.Position).Magnitude / math.max(p7, 1) + 3
        local qg = 0

        qc = ah
        qd = qc.Heartbeat:Connect(function(qh)
            local qi = qf

            if qi ~= nil then
                return
            end

            qg = qg + qh
            qi = eg

            local qj = qi.Root()

            if qj then
                qi = qg > qe

                if qi then
                    qf = false

                    return
                elseif qa then
                    local qk = qa()

                    if qk then
                        qf = false

                        return
                    end
                end
            else
                qf = false

                return
            end

            qi = D(qj, p6, p7, qh, qb) <= 0.75

            if qi then
                qf = true
            end
        end)

        while true do
            qc = qf == nil

            if not qc then
                break
            end

            local qh = ah

            qh.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end

        qd:Disconnect()

        qd = eg

        local qh = qd.Root()

        if qh then
            pcall(function()
                qh.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end)
        end

        return qf
    end

    local function G(p6, p7)

        l9.Notes = nil

                    if qc > 12 then
                        l9.Status = 'The mushrooms do not answer'

                    task.wait(0.05)
                else
                    l9.Notes = nil

                            qg = S(qh, qi, 1.6)

                            end
                        end

                        if qg ~= 'ok' then
                            l9.Status = 'Missed a note, starting over'

                        end
                    end

                    l9.LastAt = os.clock()

                end

    local function F()

            return true

    end

            return true
        end

    local function N(p6, p7)
        local qa = 0

        while qa < 5 and not M(p6) do
            qa = qa + task.wait(0.25)
        end

        local qc = o'RF/BanjoCricket/AskClaim'

        if not qc then
            l9.Status = 'Claim remote is missing'

            return false
        end

        local function o()
            return M(p6) or not p7.InTree()
        end

        for qe = 1, 3, 1 do
            if o() then
                return false
            end

            local qf, qg = Z(), eg

            qe = qg.DistanceTo(qf) > 9

            if qe then
                l9.Status = 'Flying to Jitterbug'
                qg = Vector3.new(kM.X - qf.X, 0, kM.Z - qf.Z)

                local qh = e(qf + (qg.Magnitude > 0.01 and qg.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 
-1)) * 6)

                P({
                    e(km),
                    e(kM),
                    qh,
                }, k1, o)
                J()

                qh = eg

                local qi = qh.Root()

                if qi then
                    pcall(function()
                        qi.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(qi.Position, Vector3.new(qf.X, qi.Position.Y, qf.Z))
                    end)
                end
            end

            l9.Status = "Claiming Cricket's Banjo"

            local qh, qi, qj = pcall(function()
                return qc:InvokeServer()
            end)

            if qh and qi == true then
                return true
            elseif T().Claimed == true then
                return true
            end

            qe, qg = tostring, qh and (qj or qi)
            l9.Status = 'Claim: ' .. qe(qg or qi or 'no answer')

            task.wait(1)
        end

        return T().Claimed == true
    end
    local function o(p6)
        if T().Claimed == true then
            l9.Done = true
            l9.Status = "Done, Cricket's Banjo is yours"

            return
        end

        local p7 = aG

        if p7:GetAttribute'EnchantedTreeUnlocked' ~= true then
            l9.Status = 'Needs the Enchanted Tree open (finish the Wisp quest)'
            l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 10

            return
        end

        p7 = eg

        local qc = p7.TreeTrip

        if type(qc) ~= 'table' then
            l9.Status = 'Tree trip is not ready'
            l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 10

            return
        end

        p7 = eg

        if not (p7.FindBat()) then
            l9.Status = 'Needs a bat in your bag'
            l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 10

            return
        end

        p7 = R()

        if p7 then
            l9.Status = p7
            l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 2

            return
        end
        if not (f()) then
            l9.Status = 'Leaving Invisibility first'
            l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 0.5

            return
        end

        p7 = eg

        local qe = p7.ClaimMovement(i7)

        if not (qe) then
            p7 = nil
            p7, l9.Status = eg, 'Waiting for ' .. tostring(eg.Movement.Owner or 'movement')
            l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 1

            return
        end

        l9.Busy = true
        qe = eg

        local qf = qe.Butterfly

        if type(qf) == 'table' then
            qf.TripSay = function(qg)
                l9.Status = qg
            end
        end

        qe = eg
        p7 = qe.Treadmill.Riding

        if p7 then
            qe = eg

            qe.ExitBelt()
        else
            local qg = eg
            local qh = qg.OnBelt()

            if qh then
                qg = eg

                qg.ExitBelt()
            end
        end

        qe = eg

        qe.HoldBelt()

        qe, p7 = pcall(function()
            local function j()
                return M(p6)
            end

            if not (qc.Enter(j)) then
                if not (M(p6)) then
                    l9.Status = 'Could not get into the Enchanted Tree' .. (type(qf) == 'table' and qf.MachineError and ' (' .. tostring(qf.MachineError) .. ')' or '')
                    l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 10
                end

                return
            end
            if not (L(p6, qc)) then
                if not (M(p6)) then
                    l9.Status = 'Could not take the Secret Leap'
                    l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 15
                end

                return
            end

            j = T().Solved ~= true

            if j then
                W(4, p6)

                if not (G(p6, qc)) then
                    return
                end

                local qg = eg

                qg.Notify('Banjo Cricket', 'Mushroom puzzle solved.')
            end

            j = N(p6, qc)

            if j then
                l9.Done = true
                l9.Status = "Done, Cricket's Banjo is yours"

                local qg = eg

                qg.Notify('Banjo Cricket', "Cricket's Banjo claimed.")
            elseif not (M(p6)) then
                l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 10
            end
        end)

        if not qe then
            l9.Status = 'Stopped: ' .. tostring(p7)
            l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 5
        end

        pcall(J)
        E()

        if qc.InTree() then
            p7 = l9.Status

            if type(qf) == 'table' then
                qf.TripSay = nil
            end

            l9.Status = 'Leaving the Banjo Secret Room'

            pcall(F, qc)

            l9.Status = 'Leaving the Enchanted Tree'

            pcall(qc.Leave)

            l9.Status = p7
        end
        if type(qf) == 'table' then
            qf.TripSay = nil
        end

        p7 = eg

        p7.ReleaseBelt()

        p7 = eg

        p7.LeaveBelt()

        l9.Busy = false
        p7 = eg

        p7.ReleaseMovement(i7)

        if l9.NextTry < os.clock() + 3 then
            l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 3
        end

        task.delay(3, function()
            local qg = l9.Busy

            if not (qg) then
                local qh = eg

                if qh.Movement.Owner ~= i7 then
                    h()
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    l9.Handle = i5:CreateToggle{
        Name = 'Auto Banjo Cricket',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(p6)
            l9.Loop = l9.Loop + 1
            l9.NextTry = 0

            if p6 ~= true then
                if not (l9.Busy) then
                    h()
                end

                return
            end

            p6 = os.clock() - l9.BuiltAt > 4

            if p6 then
                local p7 = aG
                local qc = p7:GetAttribute'EnchantedTreeUnlocked' ~= true

                if qc then
                    p7 = eg

                    p7.Notify('Auto Banjo Cricket', 'Needs the Enchanted Tree open. Finish the Wisp quest first, Auto Wisp can do it.')
                end
            end

            p6 = cL

            p6.Wake()
        end,
    }
    ol = cL

    ol.Add(function()
        local p6 = d() and not l9.Busy and not l9.Stepping and not l9.Done and os.clock() >= l9.NextTry

        if p6 then
            l9.NextTry = os.clock() + 2
            l9.Stepping = true

            local p7 = l9.Loop

            task.spawn(function()
                local qc, qe = pcall(o, p7)

                if not (qc) then
                    l9.Status = 'Stopped: ' .. tostring(qe)
                    l9.Busy = false

                    pcall(eg.ReleaseMovement, i7)
                end

                l9.Stepping = false
                qc = cL

                qc.Wake()
            end)
        end
        if not (d()) then
            if l9.Paused then
                if not (l9.Busy) then
                    h()
                end
            end
        end

        local p7, qc = d() and l9.Status or 'Off', l9.Row

        if qc then
            l9.Shown = p7
            p6 = eg

            p6.ShowRow(l9.Row, p7)
        end

        return true
    end)

    m8 = bE

    m8(function()
        l9.Loop = l9.Loop + 1

        pcall(J)

        local p6 = eg
        local p7 = p6.Butterfly

        if type(p7) == 'table' then
            p7.TripSay = nil
        end

        pcall(eg.ReleaseMovement, i7)
        h()
    end)
end
