local i7 = function()
    local i5, i7, jJ, km, kM, k1, l9, m8 = 'RF/ScrambleTradeIn/AskState', 'RF/ScrambleTradeIn/AskTradeIn', 'RF/ScrambleTradeIn/AskRefresh', 'RF/ScrambleTradeIn/AskFinishReveal', 1, 1
    local ol, p6, p7, qc, qe = false, 0, 0, 0
    local qf, qg, qh = 0, '', false

    local function g(qi, qj)
        local qk = aH
        local ql = qk:FindFirstChild(qi)

        if ql then
            if not (ql:IsA'RemoteFunction') then
                return false, nil, nil
            end
        else
            return false, nil, nil
        end
        if qj == nil then
            return pcall(ql.InvokeServer, ql)
        end

        return pcall(ql.InvokeServer, ql, qj)
    end
    local function O()
        local qi = bh
        local qj = qi.Save

        if type(qj) ~= 'table' then
            return nil
        elseif type(qj.Get) ~= 'function' then
            return nil
        end

        local qk, ql = pcall(qj.Get)

        return qk and type(ql) == 'table' and ql or nil
    end
    local function M(qj)
        local qk = bh
        local ql, qm = qk.Assets

        if ql then
            qk = bh
            qm = qk.Assets.Directory
        else
            qm = ql
        end

        qk = type(qm) == 'table' and qm[tostring(qj)] or nil

        return tostring(type(qk) == 'table' and qk.DisplayName or qj)
    end
    local function f(qj)
        if not (qj) then
            local qk = type(qe) == 'table'

            if qk then
                local ql = os.clock() < qc

                if ql then
                    local qm = qe

                    return qm
                end
            end
        end

        qc = os.clock() + k1

        local qk, ql = g(i5)

        if qk then
            qj = type(ql) == 'table'

            if qj then
                qe = ql
                qf = os.clock()
            end
        end

        ql = qe

        return ql
    end
    local function F()
        local qj, qk = {}, bh
        local ql = qk.EggState

        qk = type(ql) == 'table' and type(ql.ReadOwnerEggs) == 'function'

        if qk then
            local qm, qn, qo = aG, pcall(ql.ReadOwnerEggs, aG.UserId)

            if qn and type(qo) == 'table' then
                for qp, qq in pairs(qo)do
                    if type(qq) == 'table' then
                        if qq.Placement ~= nil then
                            qj[qp] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return qj
    end
    local function T(qj, qk)
        local ql = type(qj) == 'table' and qj.Requirements or nil

        if type(ql) ~= 'table' then
            return nil, 'No active recipe', {}
        elseif #ql == 0 then
            return nil, 'No active recipe', {}
        end

        local qn, qo, qp = F(), {}, {}

        for qq, qs in ipairs(ql)do
            qo[tostring(qs)] = {}
        end
        for qs, qt in pairs(qk.EggInventory or {})do
            qj = type(qt) == 'table' and tostring(qt.AssetCategory) or nil

            local qu = qj and qo[qj]

            if qu then
                if qn[qs] then
                    qp[qj] = true
                else
                    local qv, qw, qx = qt.BaseMutation ~= nil and qt.BaseMutation ~= 'Normal' or type(qt.Mutations) == 'table' and next(qt.Mutations) ~= nil, table.insert, {Uid = qs}

                    qx.Scale, qx.Mutated = tonumber(qt.AssetScale) or 0, qv

                    qw(qu, qx)
                end
            end
        end
        for qs, qt in pairs(qo)do
            table.sort(qt, function(qu, qv)
                if qu.Mutated ~= qv.Mutated then
                    return qv.Mutated
                end

                return qu.Scale < qv.Scale
            end)
        end

        local qt, qu, qv, qw = {}, {}, {}

        for qx, qy in ipairs(ql)do
            qn = nil

            for qz, qA in ipairs(qo[tostring(qy)] or {})do
                if not (qu[qA.Uid]) then
                    qn = qA

                    break
                end
            end

            if qn then
                qu[qn.Uid] = true
                qv[qx] = qn.Uid

                table.insert(qt, qn.Uid)
            else
                qw = qw or ((qp[tostring(qy)] and {
                    ('Need a ' .. M(qy) .. ' egg, yours is placed on a nest'),
                } or {
                    ('Need a ' .. M(qy) .. ' egg'),
                })[1])
            end
        end

        if qw then
            return nil, qw, qu, qv
        end

        return qt, nil, qu, qv
    end

    local qj = {}

    local function h()
        local qk = aG
        local ql = qk:FindFirstChildOfClass'PlayerGui'

        qk = ql and (ql:FindFirstChild'DrScrambleTradeIn')

        local qn, qo = qk and (qk:FindFirstChild'DrScrambleTradeInMain'), qk and (qk:FindFirstChild('DrScrambleTradeInInventory', true))

        qk = qn and (qn:FindFirstChild'SacrificeInputs')

        if qn then
            if qo then
                if not qk then
                    return nil
                end
            else
                return nil
            end
        else
            return nil
        end

        return {
            Main = qn,
            Inventory = qo,
            Inputs = qk,
        }
    end
    local function d(qk)
        if typeof(qk) ~= 'Instance' then
            return false
        elseif not (qk:IsA'GuiButton') then
            return false
        end

        local qn, qo = pcall(getconnections, qk.Activated)

        if qn then
            if type(qo) ~= 'table' then
                return false
            elseif #qo == 0 then
                return false
            end
        else
            return false
        end

        qk = false

        for qp, qt in ipairs(qo)do
            qn, qp = pcall(function()
                return qt.Function
            end)

            local qu

            if qn then
                if type(qp) == 'function' then
                    local qv, qw = pcall(debug.getupvalues, qp)

                    if qv then
                        if type(qw) == 'table' then
                            local qx = qu

                            for qy = 1, #qw, 1 do
                                if type(qw[qy]) == 'function' then
                                    qx = qw[qy]

                                    break
                                end
                            end

                            qu = qx
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            qk = (qu and {
                pcall(qu) or qk,
            } or {
                pcall(function()
                    qt:Fire()
                end) or qk,
            })[1]
        end

        return qk
    end
    local function S(qk)
        local qn = qk and (qk:FindFirstChild'Full')

        return qn ~= nil and qn.Visible == true
    end
    local function E(qk, qn)
        for qo = 1, qn, 1 do
            if not (S(qk.Inputs:FindFirstChild('Input' .. qo))) then
                return false
            end
        end

        return qn > 0
    end
    local function D(qk, qn)
        local qo, qp = h(), type(qk) == 'table' and qk.Requirements or nil

        if qo then
            if type(qp) ~= 'table' then
                return false
            end
        else
            return false
        end

        for qt = 1, #qp, 1 do
            local qu, qv = qo.Inputs:FindFirstChild('Input' .. qt), qn[qt]

            if qu and qv and not S(qu) and (qj[qv] or 0) <= os.clock() then
                qk = qu:FindFirstChild'Empty'

                if d(qk and (qk:FindFirstChild'Add')) then
                    local qw, qx, qy = qo.Inventory:FindFirstChild'ScrollingFrame', 0

                    while qx < 2 do
                        qy = qw and qw:FindFirstChild('Egg_' .. qv)

                        if qy then
                            break
                        end

                        qx = qx + task.wait(0.1)
                    end

                    if qy then
                        d(qy)
                    end

                    qx = 0

                    while qx < 2 and not S(qu) do
                        qx = qx + task.wait(0.1)
                    end

                    if qo.Inventory.Visible then
                        if not (d(qo.Inventory:FindFirstChild'Close')) then
                            qo.Inventory.Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not (S(qu)) then
                    qj[qv] = os.clock() + 30
                end
            end
        end

        return E(qo, #qp)
    end
    local function F()
        local qk = qe

        if type(qk) ~= 'table' then
            return 'Lab status unknown'
        end
        if qk.Unlocked ~= true then
            return 'Lab is locked on this account'
        end

        local qn = {}

        for qo, qp in ipairs(qk.Requirements or {})do
            table.insert(qn, M(qp))
        end

        local qp = (tonumber(qk.SecondsUntilRotation) or 0) - (os.clock() - qf)

        qp = qp < 0 and 0 or qp

        local qt = string.format('%s  -  needs %s  -  pity %s/%s  -  free rerolls %s  -  rotates in %d:%02d', tostring(qk.BannerDisplayName or qk.BannerId or 'Lab'), #qn > 0 and table.concat(qn, ', ') or 'unknown', tostring(qk.PityCount or 0), tostring(qk.PityThreshold or 0), tostring(qk.FreeRefreshesRemaining or 0), math.floor(qp / 60), math.floor(qp % 60))

        qt = (qg ~= '' and {
            (qt .. '  -  ' .. qg),
        } or {qt})[1]

        return qt
    end
    local function M(qk)
        local qn = f(true)

        if type(qn) ~= 'table' then
            return
        elseif qn.Unlocked ~= true then
            return
        end

        local qp = qn.PendingReward ~= nil

        if qp then
            local qt = qn.PendingReward ~= false

            if qt then
                local qu, qv = g(km)

                qg, qc = qu and qv ~= false and 'Reward claimed' or 'Reward claim failed', 0

                return
            end
        end

        qp = eg

        local qt = qp.Lab.BannerOk(qn.BannerId)

        if not (qt) then
            qp = eg
            qp.Lab.Reserved = {}

            local qu = eg

            qg = 'Waiting for ' .. qu.Lab.PickedText()

            return
        end

        qt = O()

        if not qt then
            return
        end

        local qu, qv, qw, qx = T(qn, qt)

        qt = eg

        local qy, qA = qt.Toggle(l9, false), eg

        qA.Lab.Reserved = qy and qw or {}
        qp = false

        if qy then
            qt = p6

            if qk == qt then
                qA, qw = pcall(D, qn, qx or {})
                qp = qA and qw == true
            end
        end
        if not (qu) then
            qg = qv or 'Recipe not ready'
            qt = qk == p6

            if qt then
                qA = eg
                qy = qA.Toggle(m8, false)

                if qy then
                    qw = tonumber(qn.FreeRefreshesRemaining)

                    if qw then
                        qx = qw > 0

                        if qx then
                            local qB, qC, qD = g(jJ)

                            qg, qc = qB and qC ~= false and 'Recipe rerolled' or tostring(qD or 'Reroll rejected'), 0
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return
        end

        qx = eg
        qt = qx.Toggle(l9, false)

        if not qt then
            qg = 'Ready to trade in'

            return
        end

        qA = p6

        if qk ~= qA then
            return
        end
        if qp then
            qt = h()

            if qt then
                qv = d(qt.Main:FindFirstChild('Sacrifice', true))

                if qv then
                    qg, qc = 'Trade-in sent', 0

                    return
                end
            end
        end

        qw, qA, qp = g(i7, qu)
        qg, qc = qw and qA ~= false and 'Trade-in sent' or tostring(qp or 'Trade rejected'), 0
    end

    local qk = eg

    qk.LabStatusText = F
    qk = bh

    local qn = qk.LabSection:CreateText{
        Name = 'Lab Status',
        Text = 'Loading Lab data...',
    }

    do
        local qp, qt, qu = {}, {}, eg

        for qv, qw in ipairs(qu.Lab.BannerList())do
            table.insert(qp, qw.Name)

            qt[qw.Name] = qw.Id
        end

        qk, qu = bH, bh

        qk(qu.LabSection:CreateMultiDropdown{
            Name = 'Lab Banners',
            Note = 'Only trade and steal for these banners (empty = all)',
            Options = qp,
            Default = {},
            Callback = function(qw)
                local qx = {}

                if type(qw) == 'table' then
                    for qy, qA in pairs(qw)do
                        local qB = qA == true and type(qy) == 'string' and qy or type(qA) == 'string' and qA

                        if qB then
                            if qt[qB] then
                                qx[qt[qB] ] = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                qw = eg
                qw.Lab.Banners = qx
                qg, p7, qc = '', 0, 0
                qw = eg
                qw.Rift.Next = 0
                qx, qw = eg, type(eg.Lab.ForceSteal) == 'function'

                if qw then
                    pcall(eg.Lab.ForceSteal)
                end

                qw = cL

                qw.Wake()
            end,
        })
    end

    qk = bh
    l9 = qk.LabSection:CreateToggle{
        Name = 'Auto Lab Trade-In',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function()
            local qp = eg
            local qt = qp.Toggle(l9, false)

            if not (qt) then
                qp = eg
                qp.Lab.Reserved = {}
            end

            p6 = p6 + 1
            qg, p7, qc = '', 0, 0
            qp = cL

            qp.Wake()
        end,
    }
    qk = bh
    m8 = qk.LabSection:CreateToggle{
        Name = 'Auto Reroll Lab Recipe',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function()
            p6 = p6 + 1
            qg, p7, qc = '', 0, 0

            local qp = cL

            qp.Wake()
        end,
    }

    local qp, qt = eg

    qt, qp.Lab.PlaceHandle = bh, bh.LabSection:CreateToggle{
        Name = 'Auto Place Lab Reward Eggs',
        Note = 'Places the reward eggs from Lab trades',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(qu)
            local qw = type(qu) ~= 'boolean'

            if qw then
                local qx, qy = eg

                qy, qu = eg, qx.Toggle(eg.Lab.PlaceHandle, false)
            end

            qw = eg
            qw.Lab.PlaceOn = qu == true

            local qx, qy = eg, type(eg.PlaceEggRefresh) == 'function'

            if qy then
                pcall(eg.PlaceEggRefresh)
            end

            qw = cL

            qw.Wake()
        end,
    }
    qp = cL

    qp.Add(function()
        local qu = eg
        local qw, qy = qu.Toggle(l9, false), eg

        qu = qy.Toggle(m8, false)
        qy = (qw or qu) and k1 or 30

        local qA = (qh and {
            (not qh),
        } or {
            qe == nil or qc == 0 or os.clock() - qf >= qy,
        })[1]

        if qA then
            qh = true

            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(f, true)

                qh = false
            end)
        end
        if qn then
            if type(qn.Set) == 'function' then
                pcall(qn.Set, qn, F())
            end
        end

        qy = ol

        if qy then
            return false
        else
            qA = qw or qu

            if qA then
                local qB, qC = os.clock(), p7

                if qB < qC then
                    return false
                end
            else
                return false
            end
        end

        ol = true
        p7 = os.clock() + kM

        local qB = p6

        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(M, qB)

            ol = false

            local qC = cL

            qC.Wake()
        end)

        return false
    end)
end

local jJ = function()
    local jJ, km = {
        Cards = {},
        Rows = nil,
        Header = nil,
    }, eg

    km.AdminStatus = jJ

    local kM, k1

    pcall(function()
        kM = Font.new('rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json', Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        k1 = Font.new('rbxassetid://12187365977', Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    end)

    k1 = k1 or kM

    local l9, m8, ol, p6, p7, qc, qe, qf, qg = 0.7, 1.9, 2.6, 2.1, 0.95, 5.6, 0.0909, 8, '#9AA3B5'

    local function m(qh)
        if typeof(qh) ~= 'Instance' then
            return false
        else
            local qn = game

            if not (qh:IsDescendantOf(qn)) then
                return false
            end
        end

        local qn = qh

        while qn do
            if qn:IsA'GuiObject' then
                if not (qn.Visible) then
                    return false
                end
            end
            if qn:IsA'LayerCollector' then
                return qn.Enabled
            end

            qn = qn.Parent
        end

        return false
    end
    local function L(qh)
        if not qh or qh.DiffWrapped then
            return qh
        end

        local qn = qh.Set

        qh.DiffWrapped = true
        qh.Set = function(qp)
            if type(qp) ~= 'table' then
                return qn(qp)
            end

            local qt, qu = qh.Spec

            for qw, qy in pairs(qp)do
                if qt[qw] ~= qy then
                    qu = qu or {}
                    qu[qw] = qy
                end
            end

            if qu then
                qn(qu)
            end

            return qh
        end

        return qh
    end
    local function j(qh)
        pcall(function()
            local qn = qh.Get()

            if qn then
                if qn:IsA'TextLabel' then
                    qn.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function X(qh)
        qh = tostring(qh or '')
        qh = string.gsub(qh, '&', '&amp;')
        qh = string.gsub(qh, '<', '&lt;')

        return (string.gsub(qh, '>', '&gt;'))
    end
    local function U(qh, qn, qp)
        if qh then
            if type(qh.CreateCanvas) ~= 'function' then
                return
            end
        else
            return
        end

        local qt = {
            Key = qn,
            Header = qp,
            Rows = {},
            UnitsWide = 0,
            Count = -1,
            Width = -1,
            Surface = nil,
        }

        local function T(qu)
            if qt.Surface then
                if qt.UnitsWide <= 0 then
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end

            local qw, qy = qp and m8 or 0.2, math.max(1, qt.UnitsWide - l9 - 0.5)

            if qp then
                local qA, qB, qC = math.min(5, qy * 0.35), qt.Title.Set, {
                    X = l9,
                    Y = 0.35,
                }

                qC.Width, qC.Height = math.max(1, qy - qA - 0.3), 1.2

                qB(qC)

                qB, qC = qt.Right.Set, {}
                qC.X, qC.Y, qC.Width, qC.Height = l9 + qy - qA, 0.45, qA, 1

                qB(qC)
                qt.Divider.Set{
                    X = l9,
                    Y = m8 - 0.15,
                    Width = qy,
                    Height = 0.06,
                    Visible = qu > 0,
                }
            end

            qy = l9 + p6 + 0.5

            local qA = math.max(1, qt.UnitsWide - qy - 0.5)

            for qB, qC in ipairs(qt.Rows)do
                local qD, qE = qB <= qu, qw + (qB - 1) * ol

                qC.Icon.Set{
                    Visible = qD,
                    X = l9,
                    Y = qE + 0.25,
                    Width = p6,
                    Height = p6,
                }

                local qF, qG = qC.Name.Set, {
                    Visible = qD,
                    X = qy,
                    Y = qE + 0.3,
                }

                qG.Width, qG.Height = math.max(1, qA - qc - 0.3), 1.1

                qF(qG)
                qC.Chip.Set{
                    Visible = qD,
                    X = qy + qA - qc,
                    Y = qE + 0.35,
                    Width = qc,
                    Height = p7,
                }
                qC.ChipText.Set{
                    X = 0,
                    Y = 0,
                    Width = qc,
                    Height = p7,
                }

                qF, qG = qD and qC.HintShown == true, 1.35
                qB = qF and math.max(1, qA - qG - 0.3) or qA

                qC.Detail.Set{
                    Visible = qD,
                    X = qy,
                    Y = qE + 1.4,
                    Width = qB,
                    Height = 1,
                }

                qD = nil

                if qF then
                    local qH, qI = qt.Width / math.max(qt.UnitsWide, 1), qC.Detail.Get()
                    local qJ = qI and qI.TextBounds.X or 0

                    qD = qy + math.min(qB, qJ / math.max(qH, 1)) + 0.25
                else
                    qD = qy
                end

                local qH, qI = qC.Hint.Set, {
                    Visible = qF,
                    X = qD,
                }

                qI.Y, qI.Width, qI.Height = qE + 1.4 + -0.17500000000000004, qG, qG

                qH(qI)
            end

            qy = qw + qu * ol + 0.15

            qt.Frame.Set{
                X = 0,
                Y = 0,
                Width = qt.UnitsWide,
                Height = qy,
            }
            qt.Accent.Set{
                X = 0,
                Y = 0,
                Width = 0.22,
                Height = qy,
            }

            if math.abs(qy - (qt.Content or -1)) > 0.01 then
                qt.Content = qy

                qt.Surface:SetContentLines(qy)
            end
        end
        local function Y()
            local qu = type(jJ.Rows) == 'function' and jJ.Rows(qn) or {}
            local qw, qy = math.min(#qu, qf), qu[1] and qu[1].Color or qg

            for qA = 1, qw, 1 do
                if qu[qA].Color == '#4DFF7A' then
                    qy = qu[qA].Color

                    break
                end
            end

            if qp then
                local qA = type(jJ.Header) == 'function' and jJ.Header() or {
                    Text = 'READING ADMIN EVENTS',
                    Color = qg,
                    Right = '',
                }

                qy = qA.Color

                local qB, qC = qt.Title.Set, {
                    Text = X(qA.Text),
                }

                qC.Color = Color3.fromHex(qA.Color)

                qB(qC)

                qC, qB = qt.Right.Set, {}
                qB.Text = qA.Right or ''

                qC(qB)
            end

            qt.Accent.Set{Background = qy}

            for qA, qB in ipairs(qt.Rows)do
                local qC = qu[qA]

                if qC then
                    qB.Icon.Set{
                        Image = qC.Image or '',
                        StrokeColor = qC.Color,
                    }

                    local qD, qE = qB.Name.Set, {}

                    qE.Text = '<b>' .. X(qC.Name) .. '</b>'

                    qD(qE)
                    qB.Chip.Set{
                        StrokeColor = qC.Color,
                    }

                    qD, qE = qB.ChipText.Set, {
                        Text = X(qC.Chip),
                    }
                    qE.Color = Color3.fromHex(qC.Color)

                    qD(qE)

                    qA, qD = qB.Detail.Set, {}
                    qD.Text = '<font color="' .. qg .. '">' .. X(qC.Detail) .. '</font>'

                    qA(qD)

                    qE = type(qC.Hint) == 'string' and qC.Hint ~= ''

                    if qE then
                        qB.Hint.Set{
                            Image = qC.Hint,
                        }
                    end
                    if qB.HintShown ~= qE then
                        qB.HintShown = qE
                        qt.PlaceWanted = true
                    elseif qE then
                        qB.HintShown = qE
                        qt.PlaceWanted = true
                    end
                end
            end

            if qw ~= qt.Count then
                qt.Count = qw
                qt.PlaceWanted = true
            end

    local function F(qN)

        while not t() do

                (not qT),
            } or {
                (not qS),
            })[1]

            if qU then
                local qV = eg

                qV.Movement.CaptureUntil = 0
                qV = qA.Controlling

                if qV then
                    s()

                qV.Movement.CaptureUntil = os.clock() + qw

                if not (pcall(o, qS, qT, t)) then
                    qA.Mode = nil
                    qA.Status = 'Retrying'

                    task.wait(0.3)
                end

                task.wait(0.05)
            end

            qT = qA.Woken ~= qA.Status

            if qT then
                qA.Woken = qA.Status
                qU = cL

                qU.Wake()
            end
        end

        t = eg
        t.Movement.CaptureUntil = 0
        t = qN == qA.Generation

        if t then
            s()
        else
            local qS = eg

            if not (qS.Toggle(qA.Handle, false)) then
                s()
            end
        end

        t = eg
        qA.Status = t.Toggle(qA.Handle, false) and qA.Status or 'Off'
        t = cL

        t.Wake()
    end

            local rh, rj = os.clock() < rc and not q6()

            if rh then
                q9 = aG
                rj = q9.Character == rd
            else
                rj = rh
            end
            if not rj then
                break
            end

            rh = ah

            local rl, rm = rh.Heartbeat:Wait(), eg
            local rn = rm.Root()

            rj = q5()

            if not rn or not rj then
                break
            end

            rh = Vector3.new(rj.X - rn.Position.X, 0, rj.Z - rn.Position.Z).Magnitude

            if rh <= q7 then
                ra = true

                break
            end

            local ro, rp = rn.Anchored

            if ro then
                rm = nil
                rm, rp = eg, type(eg.ExitBelt) == 'function'
            else
                rp = ro
            end
            if rp then
                pcall(eg.ExitBelt)

                re = rn.Position
            end

            ro = re

            if os.clock() < rf then
                pcall(function()
                    rn.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    rn.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                end)

                re = rn.Position

                continue
            end

            rm = rg

            if (rn.Position - ro).Magnitude > 25 then
                rg = rm + 1
                rf, re = os.clock() + math.min(0.25 + 0.25 * rg, 1), rn.Position

                if q8 then
                    q8(string.format('lagged back, waiting a moment (%d)', rg))
                end

                continue
            end

            local rq, rs = hE * (rm < 2 and 1 or math.max(0.5, 0.8 ^ (rm - 1))), rj - ro

            rp = rq * rl
            re = rs.Magnitude <= rp and rj or ro + rs.Unit * rp
            rp = Vector3.new(rs.X, 0, rs.Z)

            local rt = rp.Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), rp.Unit) or rn.CFrame.Rotation

            pcall(function()
                rn.CFrame = CFrame.new(re) * rt
                rn.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                rn.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end)

            if q8 then
                q8(math.floor(rh + 0.5))
            end
        end

        return ra
    end

        local function zQ(sc)
            if _() then
                return true
            end

            local sg = R'HalloweenDimensionPortal'
            local sh = sg and (sg:FindFirstChild('Hitbox', true))

            if sh then
                if not (sh:IsA'BasePart') then
                    VQ'Halloween portal is not here'

                    return false
                end
            else
                VQ'Halloween portal is not here'

                return false
            end

            sg = (E())

            while true do
                local sl

                if sg then
                    local sm = q7

                    sl = sm.InsideBase(sg.Position)
                else
                    sl = sg
                end

                local sm

                if sl then
                    local sn = q7

                    sm = not sn.InsideBase(sh.Position)
                else
                    sm = sl
                end

                sl = nil

                if sm then
                    local sn = q7
                    local so = sn.IsNight()

                    if so then
                        sl = so
                    else
                        sn = q7
                        sl = sn.WallSealed()
                    end
                else
                    sl = sm
                end
                if not sl then
                    break
                end

                VQ'Field wall is up, waiting to go to the Halloween portal'

                if not (g(1, sc)) then
                    return false
                end

                sg = (E())
            end

            if not (n()) then
                VQ'Getting off the treadmill first'

                return false
            end

            VQ'Teleporting to the Halloween portal'

            for sl = 1, 3, 1 do
                if sl == 3 then
                    if not (b(sh.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), sc)) then
                        return false
                    end
                end

                k(CFrame.new(sh.Position))

                sg = sh.Position

                w(sh)

                if Y(_, sl < 3 and 4 or 10, sc) then
                    Y(oQ(sg), 6, sc)
                    pcall(q7.UndoSwap)
                    g(1.5, sc)

                    local sm = j'HalloweenDimension'

                    if type(sm) == 'table' then
                        if sm.TutorialSeen ~= true then
                            task.spawn(F, 'RF/HalloweenDimension/AskTutorialSeen')
                        end
                    end

                    return true
                end
            end

            VQ'The Halloween portal did not take you'

            return false
        end
        local function n(sc)
            for sg = 1, 2, 1 do
                if not (_()) then
                    return true
                end

                sg = U()

                local sh = sg and (sg:FindFirstChild('ExitPortal', true))
                local sl = sh and (sh:FindFirstChild('Hitbox', true))

                if sl then
                else
                    sh = sg and (sg:FindFirstChild('PortalHome', true))
                    sl = sh and (sh:FindFirstChild'Portal' or sh:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true))
                end
                if not (sl) then
                    break
                end

                VQ'Leaving the Halloween Dimension'
                k(CFrame.new(sl.Position))

                sh = sl.Position

                w(sl)

                if Y(function()
                    return not _()
                end, 10, sc) then
                    Y(oQ(sh), 6, sc)
                    g(1.5, sc)

                    return true
                end
            end

            return not _()
        end

        end

        local function iQ(sh, sl, sm)
            local sn = sh.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(sl)

            return math.abs(sn.X) <= sh.Size.X / 2 - (sm or 0) and math.abs(sn.Z) <= sh.Size.Z / 2 - (sm or 0)
        end
        local function aQ(sh)
            for sl = 3, 1, -1 do

                if sm then
                    if iQ(sm, sh) then
                        return sl
                    end
                end
            end

            return 0
        end
        local function IQ()
            local sh, sl = lQ'SafeZone', E()

            if sh then
                if not (sl) then
                    return nil
                end
            else
                return nil
            end

            local sm, sn, so = sh.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(sl.Position), math.max(sh.Size.X / 2 - 6, 0), math.max(sh.Size.Z / 2 - 6, 0)
            local sp = sh.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.clamp(sm.X, 
-sn, sn), sm.Y, math.clamp(sm.Z, -so, so)))

            return Vector3.new(sp.X, sl.Position.Y, sp.Z), sh
        end

        local sh = {}

        local function mQ(sl)
            local sm, sn = sl:GetAttribute'HalloweenEggUid', sl:GetAttribute'PreparedSourceName'

            rg.Known = rg.Known or {}

            if sm then
                if sn then
                    rg.Known[sm] = sn

            if so == nil then
                return sh[so] or so
            elseif sh[so] then
                return sh[so] or so
            end

            sn = pcall(function()
                local sp, sq = rc, require(rc.Data.HalloweenPets).Specs

                sh[so] = so

                if not (sq[so]) then
                    for ss, st in next, sq, nil do
                        if type(st) == 'table' then
                            if st.EggSource == so then
                                sh[so] = st.Id or ss

                                break
                            elseif st.EggModel == so then
                                sh[so] = st.Id or ss

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            return sn and sh[so] or so
        end
        local function rQ(sl)
            local sm = ra
            local sn, so = sm.Assets

                so = sm.Assets.Directory

            sm = type(so) == 'table' and so[sl]

        local function eQ(sl)
            local sm = rQ(mQ(sl))
            local sn, so, sq = sm ~= nil, sm and sm.EarningRate, sl:IsA'Model' and sl:GetScale() or 1

            sm = sq > 5 and (sq / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or sq ^ 1.85

            return (sn and tonumber(so) or 0) * sm
        end
        local function JQ(sl)
            local sm = mQ(sl)

            if next(rg.EggNames) ~= nil then
                if not (rg.EggNames[sm]) then
                    return false
                end
            end

            local sn = rg.MinValue

            if sn then
                if sn > 0 then
                    if eQ(sl) < rg.MinValue then
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end
            if next(rg.EggRarities) ~= nil then
                sn = rQ(sm)
                sl = sn and type(sn.Rarity) == 'table' and sn.Rarity._id

                return sl ~= nil and rg.EggRarities[sl] == true
            end

            return true
        end
        local function rQ()
            local sl, sm = U(), E()
            local sn = sl and (sl:FindFirstChild'WorldEggs')

            if sn then
                if not (sm) then
                    return nil
                end
            else
                return nil
            end

            for so, sq in ipairs(rg.Pick and sn:GetChildren() or {})do
                sl = sq:FindFirstChild('StealPrompt', true)

                if sq:GetAttribute'HalloweenEggUid' == rg.Pick then
                    if sl then
                        if sl.Enabled then
                            return sq, aQ(c(sq))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            rg.Pick = nil

            local sq, ss, st, su

            for sv, sw in ipairs(sn:GetChildren())do
                sv = sw:FindFirstChild('StealPrompt', true)

                if sv then
                    if sv:IsA'ProximityPrompt' then
                        if sv.Enabled then
                            if (rg.Bad[sw] or 0) < os.clock() then
                                if JQ(sw) then
                                    sl = c(sw)

                                    local sx = sl and (aQ(sl))

                                    if sx then
                                        if sx >= 1 then
                                            local sy, sz, sA = (sl - sm.Position).Magnitude, eQ(sw), (rg.OrderIndex or {})[sw:GetAttribute'HalloweenEggUid'] or 1 / 0

                                            if ((sq and {
                                                (sA < ss),
                                            } or {
                                                (not sq),
                                            })[1]) or sA == ss and (sz > st or sz == st and sy < su) then
                                                sq, ss, st, su = sw, sA, sz, sy
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return sq, sq and aQ(c(sq)) or 0
        end
        local function OQ(sl, sm)
            local sn = U()
            local sq = sn and (sn:FindFirstChild'WorldEggs')

            task.spawn(F, 'RF/HalloweenDimension/AskDropEgg')

            local ss, st = os.clock(), false

            while sm() and os.clock() - ss < 3 do
                if J'HalloweenCarrying' ~= true then
                    st = true
                else
                    if st then
                        return true
                    end
                end

                sn = nil

                for su, sv in ipairs(sq and sq:GetChildren() or {})do
                    sn = (sv:GetAttribute'HalloweenEggUid' == sl and {sv} or {sn})[1]
                end

                local sv = sn and (sn:FindFirstChild('StealPrompt', true))

                if st then
                    if sv then
                        if sv.Enabled then
                            k(CFrame.new(c(sn) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
                            L(sv)
                        end
                    end
                end

                O()
            end
        end
        local function EQ(sl, sm)
            local sn = os.clock() + 15

            while sm() and J'HalloweenCarrying' == true and os.clock() < sn do
                local sq = E()

                if not (sq) then
                    return
                end

                local ss = Vector3.new(sl.X, sq.Position.Y, sl.Z) - sq.Position

                if ss.Magnitude < 2 then
                    return true
                end

                k(CFrame.new(sq.Position + ss.Unit * math.min(ss.Magnitude, rg.Step or 40)))
                O()
            end
        end
        local function NQ(sl)
            local sm, sn, sq, ss, st, sv, sw = J'HalloweenDelivered', os.clock() + 60, {}, rg.CarryUid, SQ(rg.Instant_, true), lQ'SafeZone', E()

            VQ'Carrying the Halloween egg to safety'

            if st and ss and sv and sw and J'HalloweenCarrying' == true then
                local sx, sy, sz = sv.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(sw.Position), sv.Size.X / 2 + 10, sv.Size.Z / 2 + 10

                VQ'Carrying: instant steal'

                local sA = sv.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.clamp(sx.X, 
-sy, sy), 0, math.clamp(sx.Z, -sz, sz)))

                EQ(sA, sl)

                for sB = 1, 4, 1 do
                    sB, sz = os.clock() + 0.8, false

                    while sl() and J'HalloweenCarrying' == true and os.clock() < sB do
                        sx = E()

                        if sx and A(sx.Position - sA).Magnitude >= 100 then
                            sz = true

                            break
                        end

                        O()
                    end

                    if not sz then
                        break
                    end

                    VQ'Pulled back, stepping to the safe zone edge again'
                    EQ(sA, sl)
                end

                if OQ(ss, sl) then
                    g(0.5, sl)
                end
            end

            sv = nil

            while sl() and J'HalloweenCarrying' == true and os.clock() < sn do
                local sx, sy, sz = E(), lQ'SafeZone', rt.Character

                if sx then
                    if sy then
                        if not (sz) then
                            break
                        end
                    else
                        break
                    end
                else
                    break
                end

                sv = sv or sx.Position.Y

                for sA, sB in ipairs(sz:GetDescendants())do
                    if sB:IsA'BasePart' then
                        if sB.CanCollide then
                            sq[sB] = true
                            sB.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end

                sz, ss = sy.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(sx.Position), st and 6 or 40

                local sB, sC = math.max(sy.Size.X / 2 - ss, 0), math.max(sy.Size.Z / 2 - ss, 0)

                sw = A(sy.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.clamp(sz.X, 
-sB, sB), sz.Y, math.clamp(sz.Z, -sC, sC))) - sx.Position)
                sx.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (sw.Magnitude > 3 and sw.Unit * math.min(x() * (st and 1 or 1.5), sw.Magnitude / 0.05) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) + Vector3.new(0, (sv - sx.Position.Y) * 8, 0)

                O()
            end

            sv = E()

            if sv then
                sv.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end

            for sx in next, sq, nil do
                if sx.Parent then
                    sx.CanCollide = true
                end
            end

            if J'HalloweenCarrying' == true then
                if os.clock() >= sn then
                    F'RF/HalloweenDimension/AskDropEgg'
                end
            end

            Y(function()
                return J'HalloweenDelivered' ~= sm
            end, 0.6)

            if J'HalloweenDelivered' ~= sm then
                rg.Eggs = rg.Eggs + 1
                rg.DeliveredAt = os.clock()

                VQ'Halloween egg secured'
            end
        end

        local sl = q7

        sl.HalloweenEggs = function()
            local sm, sn, sq = U(), {}, rg.Current

            if sq then
                sq.Current = true
                sn[1] = sq
            end

            local ss = sm and (sm:FindFirstChild'WorldEggs')

            for st, sv in ipairs(ss and ss:GetChildren() or {})do
                local sw, sx, sy = sv:GetAttribute'HalloweenEggUid', sv:FindFirstChild('StealPrompt', true), c(sv)

                if sw then
                    if sy then
                        if sx then
                            if sx.Enabled then
                                if not (sq and sq.Uid == sw) then
                                    sn[#sn + 1] = {
                                        Uid = sw,
                                        Name = mQ(sv),
                                        Value = eQ(sv),
                                        Zone = aQ(sy),
                                        Scale = sv:IsA'Model' and sv:GetScale() or 1,
                                        Target = JQ(sv) and aQ(sy) >= 1,
                                        Picked = rg.Pick == sw,
                                        Order = (rg.OrderIndex or {})[sw],
                                    }
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return sn
        end

        local function JQ(sn)
            local sq, ss = rQ()

            if not sq then
                return false
            end

            local sv = sq:FindFirstChild('StealPrompt', true)

            VQ('Going to a zone ' .. ss .. ' Halloween egg')

            local function FQ()
                return sn() and sq.Parent ~= nil and sv.Enabled and J'HalloweenCarrying' ~= true
            end

            local sw = sq:GetAttribute'HalloweenEggUid'

            rg.Stealing = true
            rg.Current = {
                Uid = sw,
                Name = mQ(sq),
                Value = eQ(sq),
                Zone = ss,
                Scale = sq:IsA'Model' and sq:GetScale() or 1,
            }

            for sx = 1, 3, 1 do
                ss = c(sq)

                if ss then
                    if not (FQ()) then
                        break
                    end
                else
                    break
                end
                if SQ(rg.Instant_, true) then
                    sx = os.clock() + 3

                    while FQ() and os.clock() < sx do
                        local sy, sz = E(), c(sq)

                        if sy then
                            if not (sz) then
                                break
                            end
                        else
                            break
                        end

                        local sB = sz + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) - sy.Position

                        if sB.Magnitude < 3 then
                            break
                        end

                        k(CFrame.new(sy.Position + sB.Unit * math.min(sB.Magnitude, rg.Step or 40)))
                        O()
                    end
                end

                sx = E()

                if (sx and {
                    ((sx.Position - ss).Magnitude > 20),
                } or {
                    (not sx),
                })[1] then
                    if not (D(ss + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), FQ)) then
                        break
                    end
                end

                local sy, sz = os.clock() + 4, 0

                while FQ() and os.clock() < sy do
                    sx = c(sq)

                    if sx then
                        k(CFrame.new(sx + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
                    end
                    if os.clock() - sz > 0.1 then
                        sz = os.clock()

                        L(sv)
                    end

                    O()
                end

                if J'HalloweenCarrying' == true then
                    break
                end
            end

            if J'HalloweenCarrying' == true then
                if rg.Pick == sw then
                    rg.Pick = nil
                end

                rg.CarryUid = sw

                aQ(sn)
            elseif sq.Parent then
                rg.Bad[sq] = os.clock() + 30
            end

            rg.Current = nil
            rg.Stealing = false

            return true
        end
        local function mQ(sn)

        local function EQ(sn)
            local sq, ss = RaycastParams.new(), U()

            sq.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            sq.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                rt.Character,
                ss and ss:FindFirstChild'Monsters',
                ss and ss:FindFirstChild'Ghosts',
            }
            ss = workspace:Raycast(sn + Vector3.new(0, 25, 0), Vector3.new(0, -80, 0), sq)

            return ss and Vector3.new(sn.X, ss.Position.Y + 3, sn.Z) or sn
        end
        local function NQ()
            local sn, sq, ss, sv = next(rg.Weapons) ~= nil and rg.Weapons or rg.ToolIds, rt.Character, {}, ipairs
            local sw = {
                sq,
                rt:FindFirstChildOfClass'Backpack',
            }

            for sx, sy in sv(sw)do
                for sz, sB in ipairs(sy and sy:GetChildren() or {})do
                    sz = sB:IsA'Tool' and (sB:GetAttribute'GearName' or sB.Name)

                    if sz then
                        if sn[sz] then
                            if rg.ToolIds[sz] then
                                ss[#ss + 1] = sB
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if #ss == 0 then
                return OQ()
            end

            table.sort(ss, function(sy, sz)
                return sy.Name < sz.Name
            end)

            local function qQ(sy)
                return tonumber(sy:GetAttribute'CooldownEndTime') or 0
            end

            sw = sq and (sq:FindFirstChildOfClass'Tool')
            sn, sq = sw and table.find(ss, sw), ss[1]

            if sn then
                sv = os.clock() - (rg.WeaponAt or 0) >= 0.5 or qQ(sw) ~= rg.WeaponCooldown

                if #ss == 1 then
                    return sw
                elseif sv then
                else
                    return sw
                end

                local sy

                for sz = 1, #ss - 1, 1 do
                    local sB = ss[(sn + sz - 1) % #ss + 1]

                    sz = qQ(sB) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

                    if sz <= 0 then
                        sq = sB

                        break
                    end
                    if sy then
                        if sz < sy then
                            sq, sy = sB, sz
                        end
                    else
                        sq, sy = sB, sz
                    end
                end
            end

            rg.WeaponAt, rg.WeaponCooldown = os.clock(), qQ(sq)

            return sq
        end
        local function xQ(sn, sq)
            local ss, sv = E(), N()

            if ss then
                if not (sv) then
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end

            local sw = A(sn - ss.Position)

            rg.WalkSpeed0 = rg.WalkSpeed0 or sv.WalkSpeed

            local sy = sn.Y - ss.Position.Y
            local sz = sy > 2 and math.min(sy * 6, 40) or math.min(ss.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 8)

            if sw.Magnitude > 2 then
                sy = RaycastParams.new()
                sy.FilterType, sy.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {
                    rt.Character,
                }

                local sB, sC, sD = workspace, ss.Position + sw.Unit * math.min(sw.Magnitude, 6) + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, 
-40, 0)

                if not (sB:Raycast(sC, sD, sy)) then
                    sv:MoveTo(ss.Position)

                    ss.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(ss.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)

                    return
                end

                sv.WalkSpeed = sq

                sv:MoveTo(Vector3.new(sn.X, ss.Position.Y, sn.Z))

                ss.AssemblyLinearVelocity = sw.Unit * math.min(sq, sw.Magnitude / 0.05) + Vector3.new(0, sz, 0)
            else
                sv:MoveTo(ss.Position)

                ss.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, sz, 0)
            end
        end
        local function FQ()
            local sn, sq = N(), E()

            if sq then
                sq.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(sq.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)
            end
            if sn then
                sn:MoveTo(sq and sq.Position or sn.WalkToPoint)

                if rg.WalkSpeed0 then
                    sn.WalkSpeed = rg.WalkSpeed0
                    rg.WalkSpeed0 = nil
                end
            end
        end
        local function dQ(sn, sq, ss)
            local sv = os.clock() + 25

            while sq() and os.clock() < sv do
                local sw = E()

                if sw then
                    if A(sn - sw.Position).Magnitude < 3 then
                        if sn.Y - sw.Position.Y < 2 then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                else
                    break
                end

                xQ(sn, ss)
                O()
            end

            FQ()

            return sq()
        end

        local function JQ(sn)
            local sq, ss = OQ(), N()

            if not (sq) then
                VQ'Get a bat to fight monsters'

                return false
            end
            if ss then
                if ss.Health < ss.MaxHealth * 0.4 then
                    mQ(sn)

                    return true
                end
            end

            ss = E()

            if not ss then
                return false
            end

            local sv, sw, sy, sz, sB = lQ'SafeZone', nil, {
                Small = 12,
                Medium = 28,
                Large = 65,
            }, ipairs, rf
            local sC, sD = table.pack(sB:GetTagged'HalloweenMonster'), 1 / 0

            for sE, sF in sz(table.unpack(sC, 1, sC.n))do
                sB = sF:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and sF:GetAttribute'KilledBy' == nil and (next(rg.MonsterKinds) == nil or rg.MonsterKinds[sF.Name]) and (c(sF))
                sE = sB and (sB - ss.Position).Magnitude

                local sG = sE and (rg.MonsterOrder == 'Most Tokens' and sE - (sy[sF:GetAttribute'MonsterSize'] or 0) * 1000 or sE)

                if sG and sG < sD and not (sv and iQ(sv, sB)) then
                    sw = sF
                    sD = sG
                end
            end

            sD = sw and (c(sw) - ss.Position).Magnitude or sD

            if not sw then
                return false
            end

            VQ('Fighting a ' .. tostring(sw:GetAttribute'MonsterSize' or 'Halloween') .. ' monster')

            local function v()
                local sE = N()

                return sn() and sw.Parent ~= nil and sw:GetAttribute'KilledBy' == nil and J'HalloweenCarrying' ~= true and ((sE and {
                    (sE.Health >= sE.MaxHealth * 0.4),
                } or {
                    (not sE),
                })[1])
            end

            if sD > 30 then
                if not (dQ(EQ(c(sw)), v, rg.MonsterSpeed)) then
                    return true
                end
            end

            sy = os.clock() + 15

            while v() and os.clock() < sy do
                sC, sz = c(sw), E()

                if sC then
                    if not sz then
                        break
                    end
                else
                    break
                end

                sv = A(sz.Position - sC)

                xQ(EQ(sC + (sv.Magnitude > 0.1 and sv.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)) * 4), rg.MonsterSpeed)
                P(sC)

                sB = NQ() or sq

                G(sB)

                if not (rg.BatIds[sB:GetAttribute'GearName' or sB.Name]) then
                    if sB.Parent == rt.Character then
                        if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= (tonumber(sB:GetAttribute'CooldownEndTime') or 0) then
                            if os.clock() - (rg.TriggerAt or 0) > 0.1 then
                                if os.clock() - (rg.WeaponAt or 0) > 0.15 then
                                    rg.TriggerAt = os.clock()

                                    d('RE/ToolTrigger/Trigger', sB)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                O()
            end

            FQ()

            if sw:GetAttribute'KilledBy' == rt.UserId then
                rg.Kills = rg.Kills + 1
            end

            return true
        end
        local function v(sn)
            return C(JQ, sn)
        end
        local function lQ(sn)
            local sq = U()

            if not (sq) then
                return false
            end

            local ss = sq:FindFirstChild'Altar'

            ss = ss and (ss:FindFirstChild'PumpkinDeposit')

            if J'HalloweenPumpkinCarrying' == true then
                VQ'Bringing a pumpkin to the altar'

                if ss and ss:GetAttribute'Open' ~= false then
                    local function EQ()
                        return sn() and J'HalloweenPumpkinCarrying' == true
                    end

                    C(dQ, (c(ss:FindFirstChild'Target') or ss.Position) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), EQ, rg.PumpkinSpeed)

                    for sv = 1, 4, 1 do
                        if not (EQ()) then
                            break
                        end

                        k(CFrame.new(ss.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
                        w(ss)
                        L(ss:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ProximityPrompt', true))
                        g(0.3, EQ)
                    end
                else
                    g(0.5, sn)
                end

                return true
            end

            local sv, sw, sy, sz = sq:FindFirstChild'RunawayPumpkins', E(), 1 / 0

            for sB, sC in ipairs(sv and sv:GetChildren() or {})do
                sq = sC:IsA'Model' and sC:FindFirstChild('CatchPrompt', true)
                sB = sq and sq.Enabled and c(sC)

                local sD = sB and sw and (sB - sw.Position).Magnitude

                if sD then
                    if sD < sy then
                        sy, sz = sD, sC
                    end
                end
            end

            if not (sz) then
                VQ'Pumpkin Moon: looking for pumpkins'

                return false
            end

            VQ'Pumpkin Moon: catching a pumpkin'

            sq = os.clock() + 10
            rg.Move = true

            while sn() and sz.Parent and (sz:FindFirstChild('CatchPrompt', true)) and os.clock() < sq and J'HalloweenPumpkinCarrying' ~= true do
                sw, sv = c(sz), E()

                if sw then
                    if not sv then
                        break
                    end
                else
                    break
                end

                local sB, sC = sw - sv.Position, sz:FindFirstChild('CatchPrompt', true)

                if sC then
                    if sC:IsA'ProximityPrompt' then
                        if sB.Magnitude <= sC.MaxActivationDistance + 2 then
                            L(sC)
                        end
                    end
                end

                xQ(sw, rg.PumpkinSpeed)
                O()
            end

            rg.Move = false

            X(false)
            FQ()

            sq = E()

            if sq then
                sq.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end

            return true
        end

        local function EQ()

        local function NQ(sn, sq, sv)
            local sw, sy, sz = rc, pcall(require, rc.Data.GhostDogQuest)

            local function AQ(sB)
                local sC, sD = pcall(sz.ChaseFrame, sn, sB)

                return sC and typeof(sD) == 'CFrame' and sD or nil
            end

            if sy then
                if type(sz) == 'table' then
                    if not (AQ(0)) then
                        return false
                    end
                else
                    return false
                end
            else
                return false
            end

            rg.Chase = true

            VQ'Ghost Dog: underwater chase'

            local sB, sC = pcall(function()
                Y(function()
                    local sB, sC = E(), AQ(0)

                    return sB and sC and (sB.Position - sC.Position).Magnitude < 40
                end, 8, sv)

                local sB, sC = N(), CFrame.Angles(-1.2566, 0, 0)

                if sB then
                    sB.PlatformStand = true
                end

                sB = os.clock() + 4

                while sv() and os.clock() < sB do
                    k(AQ(0) * sC)
                    O()
                end

                local sD, sE = q('GhostDogQuestFlags', 'ChaseSpeed') or 58, os.clock()

                sB = sq * sD

                while sv() and J'GhostDogChase' ~= nil do
                    local sF = math.min((os.clock() - sE) * sD, sB)
                    local sG = AQ(sF)

                    if sG then
                        k(sG * sC)
                    end
                    if sF >= sB then
                        break
                    end

                    O()
                end

                sD = false

                for sF = 1, 8, 1 do
                    local sG, sH = F'RF/GhostDogQuest/Claim'

                    if sH == true then
                        sD = true

                        break
                    end
                    if sF == 4 then
                        sE = os.clock() + 5

                        while os.clock() < sE do
                            sH = AQ(sB)

                            if sH then
                                k(sH * sC)
                            end

                            O()
                        end
                    else
                        task.wait(0.7)
                    end
                end

                task.wait(sD and 3 or 0.5)

                for sF = 1, 3, 1 do
                    sC, sF = F'RF/GhostDogQuest/Surface'

                    if sF == true then
                        break
                    end

                    task.wait(0.5)
                end

                Y(function()
                    local sF, sH = w'ReturnSpot', E()

                    return (sF and {
                        sH and (sH.Position - sF.Position).Magnitude < 25,
                    } or {
                        (not sF),
                    })[1]
                end, 6)

                return sD
            end)

            sy = N()

            if sy then
                sy.PlatformStand = false
            end

            F'RF/GhostDogQuest/Abort'

            rg.Chase = false

            return sB and sC
        end
        local function xQ(sn)

        local function FQ(sn, sv)
            if not (E()) then
                return nil
            end

            P(sn)

            local sy, sB, sC, sD, sE = 1.2 * rg.Charge ^ 0.7142857142857143, xQ'Ui', rc, pcall(require, rc.Shared.Util.Fishing)
            local sF, sH, sI = rc, pcall(require, rc.Shared.Flags.FishingFlags)

            d'RE/Fishing/Hold'

            local sJ, sK = os.clock(), false

            while os.clock() - sJ < sy do
                if not (sv()) then
                    if sB then
                        pcall(sB.ShowCharge, false)
                    end

                    return nil
                end

                local sL = (os.clock() - sJ - sy + 0.25) / 0.2

                if sB then
                    if sD then
                        if sL >= 0 then
                            if sK then
                            else
                                pcall(sB.ShowCharge, true, sH and sI.PerfectMin:Get() or 0.8, sH and sI.PerfectMax:Get() or 0.95)

                                sK = true
                            end

                            local sM, sN, sO = sE.ChargeAt(sy) * math.min(sL, 1), rt.Character and rt.Character:FindFirstChild'Head', workspace.CurrentCamera
                            local sP = sN and sO:WorldToViewportPoint(sN.Position)

                            pcall(sB.SetCharge, sM, sE.LuckText(sE.LuckFor(sM)), sE.IsPerfect(sM), sP and Vector2.new(sP.X / sO.ViewportSize.X, sP.Y / sO.ViewportSize.Y))
                        end
                    end
                end

                O()
            end

            if sB then
                pcall(sB.ShowCharge, false)

                sv = rt.Character and rt.Character:FindFirstChild'Head'

                if sv then
                    if sD then
                        if sE.IsPerfect(sE.ChargeAt(sy)) then
                            sH = workspace.CurrentCamera
                            sJ = sH:WorldToViewportPoint(sv.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0))

                            pcall(sB.Perfect, Vector2.new(sJ.X / sH.ViewportSize.X, sJ.Y / sH.ViewportSize.Y))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            sI, sD, sE = F('RF/Fishing/Cast', sy, sn)

            if type(sD) ~= 'table' then
                VQ('Fishing: ' .. tostring(sE or 'no answer'))
            end

            return type(sD) == 'table' and sD or nil, sE
        end

        local function qQ(sn)

            VQ('Ghost Dog quest: ' .. (rq[sv + 1] or 'Done'))

            if sv == 0 then

                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if sI then
                        if U('DogSpot', sn) then
                            sH = mQ('DogSpot', 'Dog', sn)

                            Y(function()
                                return JQ() >= 2
                            end, 5, sn)

                            sE = sH
                        end
                    end
                else

                    if sH then
                        if U('FishermanSpot', sn) then
                            sE = mQ('FishermanSpot', 'Fisherman', sn)

                            if sE == 'FisherReunion' or sE == 'FisherHint' then

                                Y(function()
                                    return OQ() ~= nil
                                end, 5, sn)
                            end
                        end

                            if sI then

                                    g(0.5, sn)

                                    local sK = FQ(sI.Position, sn)

                                    if sK and sK.Mode == 'Quest' then
                                        g((tonumber(sK.Wait) or 3) + 0.45, sn)
                                        d('RE/Fishing/Cancel', sK.Id)

                                        local sM, sN = F'RF/GhostDogQuest/Cast'

                                        if type(sN) == 'number' then
                                            if jQ(sN, q('GhostDogQuestFlags', 'ChaseSeconds') or 50, sn) then
                                                local sO = q7

                                                sO.Notify('Ghost Dog', 'Phantom Express Ticket unlocked')
                                            end
                                        end
                                    elseif sK then
                                        if sK.Id then

        local function U(sn)
            local sv = RaycastParams.new()

            sv.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

            local sB = {
                rt.Character,
            }

            for sD = 1, 6, 1 do
                sv.FilterDescendantsInstances = sB
                sD = workspace:Raycast(sn + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0), Vector3.new(0, 
-180, 0), sv)

                if not sD then
                    return nil
                end

                local sE = sD.Instance

                if sD.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
                    return sD.Position
                elseif sE:GetAttribute'TerrainRole' == 'Basin' then
                    return sD.Position
                elseif sE:GetAttribute'FishingWater' then
                    return sD.Position
                else
                    local sH = rf

                    if sH:HasTag(sE, 'FishingWater') then
                        return sD.Position
                    end
                end
                if sE:IsA'BasePart' then
                    if not (sE.Transparency >= 0.95) then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end

                sB[#sB + 1] = sE
            end

            return nil
        end
