local q6 = function()
    local q6, q7, rd, rg = 'star', 25, {
        Payload = nil,
        Status = 'Off',
        Busy = false,
        Caught = 0,
        Generation = 0,
        AskAt = 0,
        Slipped = 0,
        WaitClaimSince = nil,
    }, eg

    rg.ShootingStar = rd
    rg = bh

    local rh = rg.StarSection
    local rj = rh:CreateText{
        Name = 'Shooting Star Status',
        Text = 'Off',
    }

    local function A(rm)
        rd.Status = rm

        local rn = eg

        rn.ShowRow(rj, rm)
    end

    rd.Handle = rh:CreateToggle{
        Name = 'Auto Catch Shooting Star',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function()
            rd.Generation = rd.Generation + 1

            local rm = cL

            rm.Wake()
        end,
    }

    local function I()
        local rm = eg

        return rm.Toggle(rd.Handle, false) == true
    end
    local function z(rm)
        local rn = aH

        return rn:FindFirstChild(rm)
    end
    local function o(rm, ...)
        local rn = z(rm)

        if rn and (rn:IsA'RemoteEvent') then
            local rp = table.pack(...)

            pcall(function()
                rn:FireServer(table.unpack(rp, 1, rp.n))
            end)
        end
    end
    local function e(rm)
        local rn = type(rm) == 'table'

        if rn then
            local rp = rm.Id ~= nil

            if rp then
                if rd.Payload then
                    if not (rd.Payload.Id == rm.Id) then
                        rd.Slipped = 0
                    end
                else
                    rd.Slipped = 0
                end

                rd.Payload = rm

                local rq = cL

                rq.Wake()
            end
        end
    end
    local function Z()
        rd.AskAt = os.clock() + 15

        task.spawn(function()
            local rm = z'RF/ShootingStar/AskState'

            if rm then
                if rm:IsA'RemoteFunction' then
                    local rn, rp = pcall(rm.InvokeServer, rm)

                    if rn then
                        e(rp)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local rm = {}

    local function W(rn, rp)
        local rq = z(rn)

        if rq then
            if rq:IsA'RemoteEvent' then
                table.insert(rm, rq.OnClientEvent:Connect(rp))
            end
        end
    end

    W('RE/ShootingStar/Fall', e)
    W('RE/ShootingStar/Wander', function(rn, rp, rq)
        if rd.Payload then
            if rd.Payload.Id == rn then
                if type(rp) == 'table' then
                    rd.Payload.Leg = rp
                    rd.Payload.Noticed = rq == true
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    W('RE/ShootingStar/Slipped', function(rn)
        if rd.Payload then
            if rd.Payload.Id == rn then
                rd.Slipped = rd.Slipped + 1
                rd.HoldStarted = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    W('RE/ShootingStar/Claimed', function(rn)
        if rd.Payload then
            if rd.Payload.Id == rn then
                rd.Caught = rd.Caught + 1
                rd.Payload = nil
                rd.Generation = rd.Generation + 1
            end
        end
    end)
    W('RE/ShootingStar/Expired', function(rn)
        if rd.Payload then
            if rd.Payload.Id == rn then
                rd.Payload = nil
                rd.Generation = rd.Generation + 1
            end
        end
    end)

    W = bE

    W(function()
        for rn, rp in ipairs(rm)do
            rp:Disconnect()
        end
    end)
    Z()

    local function N()
        local rp = workspace:FindFirstChild'ShootingStarClient'
        local rq = rp and (rp:FindFirstChild'Buddy')

        rp = rq and (rq:FindFirstChild'RootPart' or rq.PrimaryPart)

        return rp and rp:IsA'BasePart' and rp.Position or nil
    end
    local function e(rp)
        local rq = N()

        if rq then
            return rq, nil
        end

        local rt, rW = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), rp.Leg

        if type(rW) == 'table' then
            if typeof(rW.From) == 'Vector3' then
                if typeof(rW.To) == 'Vector3' then
                    rq = tonumber(rW.StartAt) or rt

                    local rZ = (tonumber(rW.ArriveAt) or rq) - rq
                    local r9, sg = rZ > 0 and math.clamp((rt - rq) / rZ, 0, 1) or 1, rW.To - rW.From

                    return rW.From:Lerp(rW.To, r9), r9 < 1 and sg.Magnitude > 0.5 and Vector3.new(sg.X, 0, sg.Z).Unit or nil
                end
            end
        end

        rW = rp.Landing

        if typeof(rW) == 'CFrame' then
            return rW.Position, nil
        end

        return typeof(rW) == 'Vector3' and rW or nil, nil
    end
    local function N()
        local rp = eg
        local rq = rp.AdminAbuse

        for rt = 1, 3, 1 do
            rt = eg

            local rW, rZ = rt.Root(), eg

            rt, rp = rZ.Treadmill.Riding == true

            if rt then
                rp = rt
            else
                local r9, sg = eg, type(eg.OnBelt) == 'function'

                if sg then
                    rZ = eg
                    rp = rZ.OnBelt()
                else
                    rp = sg
                end
            end
            if not rp then
                if type(rq) == 'table' then
                    if rq.OnAdmin == true then
                    elseif rW then
                        if not (rW.Anchored) then
                            return true
                        end
                    else
                        return true
                    end
                elseif rW then
                    if not (rW.Anchored) then
                        return true
                    end
                else
                    return true
                end
            end
            if type(rq) == 'table' then
                rq.OnAdmin = false
            end

            rW = eg
            rW.Treadmill.Riding = false
            rZ, rt = eg, type(eg.ExitBelt) == 'function'

            if rt then
                pcall(eg.ExitBelt)
            else
                rW = z'RF/Treadmill/AskDoff'

                if rW then
                    if rW:IsA'RemoteFunction' then
                        pcall(rW.InvokeServer, rW)
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.4)
            end
        end

        rq = eg

        local rt = rq.Root()

        return not (rt and rt.Anchored)
    end
    local function z(rp, rq)
        local rt = eg
        local rW = rt.Root()

        if not rW then
            return
        end

        rt = eg

        local rZ = rt.Flying

        if not (rZ) then
            rt = eg

            rt.BeginFlight()
        end

        local sg = rW.Position
        local sT, ta = (rp - sg) * 10

        if sT.Magnitude > 200 then
            sT = sT.Unit * 200
            ta = sT
        else
            ta = sT
        end

        local tg = rq and Vector3.new(rq.X - sg.X, 0, rq.Z - sg.Z) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

        pcall(function()
            if tg.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                rW.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(sg, sg + tg.Unit)
            end

            rW.AssemblyLinearVelocity = ta
            rW.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end)
    end
    local function R(rp, rq)
        local function j()
            return rq ~= rd.Generation or not I() or rd.Payload ~= rp
        end
        local function L()
            local rW = e(rp)

            return rW and rW + Vector3.new(0, 3, 3) or nil
        end
        local function X()
            local rW = eg
            local sg, sT = rW.Root(), L()

            return sg and sT and (sg.Position - sT).Magnitude or 1 / 0
        end

        local rW = X() > 12

        if rW then
            local sg, sT, ta = eg, type(eg.StealHome) == 'function'

            if sT then
                local tg = eg

                ta = tg.StealHome()
            else
                ta = sT
            end

            local tg, th = ta or nil, eg

            sT = th.Root()
            ta, th = tg and sT

            if ta then
                local ti = eg

                th = ti.InsideBase()
            else
                th = ta
            end

            ta = th and (sT.Position - tg).Magnitude > 6

            if ta then
                A'Leaving the base through the safe zone for the star'

                th, sT = tg + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), os.clock() + 20

                while os.clock() < sT and not j() do
                    local ti = eg
                    local tj = ti.Root()

                    if not tj then
                        return false
                    end

                    local tl = th - tj.Position

                    if tl.Magnitude <= 4 then
                        break
                    end

                    local tm, to = ah, math.min(250 * ah.Heartbeat:Wait(), tl.Magnitude)

                    pcall(function()
                        tj.CFrame = CFrame.new(tj.Position + tl.Unit * to) * tj.CFrame.Rotation
                        tj.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    end)
                end
            end

            th = eg
            tg = th.IsNight()
            ta = nil

            if tg then
                ta = tg
            else
                sT = eg
                ta = sT.WallSealed()
            end
            if ta then
                th = eg
                tg = th.InsideBase()

                if tg then
                    sT = eg

                    if not (sT.WaitFieldOpen(j, function(tj)
                        A('Star: ' .. tj)
                    end)) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end

            rd.RagdollTried = rd.RagdollTried or {}
            tg = rd.RagdollTried[rp.Id]

            if not tg then
                sT, ta = eg, type(eg.RagdollTravel) == 'function'

                if ta then
                    th = eg

                    local tj = th.IsNight()

                    if not (tj) then
                        local tl = eg
                        local to = tl.WallSealed()

                        if not (to) then
                            rd.RagdollTried[rp.Id] = true

                            A'Ragdoll TP to the star'

                            tl = aG

                            local tq, ts = tl.Character

                            if tq then
                                local tt = aG

                                ts = tt.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid'
                            else
                                ts = tq
                            end
                            if ts then
                                pcall(ts.UnequipTools, ts)
                            end

                            tq = eg
                            tq.TravelCarryUntil = os.clock() + 999

                            pcall(eg.RagdollTravel, L, j)

                            ts = eg
                            ts.TravelCarryUntil = os.clock() + 2
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if j() then
                return false
            end

            tg = X() > 40

            if tg then
                th = eg

                th.StepTo(L, j, function(tj)
                    A(type(tj) == 'string' and 'Star: ' .. tj or 'Step TP to the star, ' .. tj .. ' studs')
                end)
            end
            if j() then
                return false
            end

            ta = eg

            ta.GlideTo(L, j, 4, function(tj)
                A(type(tj) == 'string' and 'Star: ' .. tj or string.format('Flying to the star, %d studs', tj))
            end, 40)
        end
        if j() then
            return false
        elseif X() > 12 then
            return false
        end

        rW = eg

        rW.Root()

        local sT, ta, tg = aG, 0.5 + math.clamp(aG:GetNetworkPing(), 0, 1) * 2, os.clock()

        A'At the star, letting the server catch up'

        while os.clock() - tg < ta do
            if j() then
                return false
            end

            rW, X = L(), eg

            local th = X.Root()

            if rW then
                if not (th) then
                    return false
                end
            else
                return false
            end
            if (th.Position - rW).Magnitude > 8 then
                if (th.Position - rW).Magnitude > 25 then
                    A'Pulled back from the star, moving again'

                    return false
                end

                tg = os.clock()
            end

            z(rW, e(rp))

            th = ah

            th.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end

        return true
    end
    local function m(rp, rq)
        local function X()
            return rq ~= rd.Generation or not I() or rd.Payload ~= rp
        end

        local rW = aG
        local ta, tg = rW.Character, (tonumber(rp.HoldSeconds) or 1.6) + 0.3

        rd.HoldStarted = nil
        rW = nil

        local th = 0

        while true do
            local tj = X()
            local tl, to = not tj

            if tj then
                to = tl
            else
                local tq = aG

                to = tq.Character == ta
            end
            if not to then
                break
            end
            if (tonumber(rp.ExpiresAt) or 1 / 0) <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
                rd.Payload = nil

                return
            end

            to, tj = e(rp)
            tl = eg

            local tq = tl.Root()

            if to then
                if not (tq) then
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end
            if Vector3.new(to.X - tq.Position.X, 0, to.Z - tq.Position.Z).Magnitude > q7 then
                return
            end

            tl = tq.Anchored

            if tl then
                N()
            else
                local ts, tt = eg, type(eg.AdminAbuse) == 'table'

                if tt then
                    tq = eg

                    if tq.AdminAbuse.OnAdmin then
                        N()
                    end
                end
            end

            z(to + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) + (tj and tj * 2 or Vector3.new(0, 0, 3)), to)

            if rd.HoldStarted then
                if (rW and {
                    (not rW),
                } or {
                    (os.clock() - rd.HoldStarted >= tg),
                })[1] then
                    th = th + 1
                    rW = os.clock()

                    o('RE/ShootingStar/Catch', rp.Id)
                    A('Catching the star (try ' .. th .. ')')
                else
                    if rW then
                        if os.clock() - rW >= 2 then
                            rd.HoldStarted = nil

                            o('RE/ShootingStar/Hold', rp.Id, false)

                            if th % 3 == 0 then
                                Z()
                            end

                            rW = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                rd.HoldStarted = os.clock()

                o('RE/ShootingStar/Hold', rp.Id, true)
                A('Holding the star' .. (rd.Slipped > 0 and ' (slipped ' .. rd.Slipped .. ')' or ''))
            end

            tq = ah

            tq.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end

        if rd.Payload == rp then
            o('RE/ShootingStar/Hold', rp.Id, false)
        end
    end
    local function o(rp, rq)
        rd.Busy = true

        local rW = eg

        rW.Shield(q6, true)
        pcall(eg.HoldBelt)

        local ta, tg = pcall(function()
            if not (N()) then
                A'Could not get off the treadmill, retrying'

                return
            end
            if R(rp, rq) then
                m(rp, rq)
            end
        end)

        if not (ta) then
            A('Star catch error, retrying: ' .. tostring(tg))
        end

        ta = eg
        rW = ta.Flying

        if rW then
            pcall(eg.EndFlight)
        end

        pcall(eg.ReleaseBelt)

        tg = eg

        tg.Shield(q6, false)

        ta = eg

        ta.ReleaseMovement(q6)

        rd.Busy = false
        ta = cL

        ta.Wake()
    end

    W = cL

    W.Add(function()
        if not (I()) then
            rd.Wanted = false

            A'Off'

            return false
        end
        if os.clock() >= rd.AskAt then
            Z()
        end

        local rp, rq = rd.Payload, workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

        rd.Wanted = rp ~= nil and rq >= (tonumber(rp.LandAt) or rq) and (tonumber(rp.ExpiresAt) or 1 / 0) > rq

        if not (rp) then
            rd.WaitClaimSince = nil

            A('Waiting for a shooting star' .. (rd.Caught > 0 and ' (caught ' .. rd.Caught .. ')' or ''))

            return false
        end
        if (tonumber(rp.ExpiresAt) or 1 / 0) <= rq then
            rd.Payload = nil

            return false
        end

        local rW = tonumber(rp.LandAt) or rq

        if rq < rW then
            A('Star falling, lands in ' .. math.ceil(rW - rq) .. 's')

            return false
        end
        if rd.Busy then
            return true
        end

        rW = eg
        rq = rW.ClaimMovement(q6)

        if not rq then
            rd.WaitClaimSince = rd.WaitClaimSince or os.clock()
            rW = eg

            local ta, tg = rW.Steal

            if ta then
                local th = eg

                tg = th.Steal.Carrying == true
            else
                tg = ta
            end

            local th, tj, tl = eg, type(eg.InRaceNow) == 'function'

            if tj then
                ta = eg
                tl = ta.InRaceNow()
            else
                tl = tj
            end

            tj = eg

            local to, tq = tj.Movement.Owner, eg

            ta = tq.RaceRank(to)
            tj, tq = ta == nil

            if tj then
                tq = tj
            else
                to = eg
                tq = (to.Priority.Rank.Star or 99) >= ta
            end

            to = tl or tg or tq or os.clock() - rd.WaitClaimSince < 6

            if to then
                A('Star landed, waiting for ' .. tostring(eg.Movement.Owner or 'another task'))

                return false
            end

            tj = eg
            tj.Movement.Owner = q6
        end

        rd.WaitClaimSince = nil

        A'Going to the star'
        task.spawn(o, rp, rd.Generation)

        return true
    end)
end

                return false

                    end

                    return false

        end

        F = rq

            end,
        }

            vo.UiDefer(i)
        end)
    end

    local function B(xo)
        xo = tonumber(xo) or 0

        local xp = xo >= 1000 and string.format('%.0f', xo) or string.format('%.2f', xo)
        local xv, xx = string.match(xp, '^(%-?%d+)(%.%d+)$')
        local xy = xv or xp

        while true do
            xp, xv = string.gsub(xy, '^(%-?%d+)(%d%d%d)', '%1,%2')

            if xv == 0 then
                xy = xp

                break
            end

            xy = xp
        end

        return xy .. (xx or '') .. ' Kg'
    end
    local function _r(xo, xp)
        local xv, xx, xy = string.format('x%.2f', xp), 0, bh
        local xG = xy.EggRecords

        if type(xG) == 'table' then
            if type(xG.WeightKgForScale) == 'function' then
                local xH, xI = pcall(xG.WeightKgForScale, xo, xp)

                if xH then
                    if tonumber(xI) then
                        local xJ, xK = tonumber(xI), xv .. '  ' .. utf8.char(183) .. '  ' .. B(xI)

                        xv, xx = xK, xJ
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return xv, xx
    end

                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(214, 180, 255)),
                }

                yH[yJ] = yK

                return yK
            end
            if string.upper(tostring(yI.Rarity)) == 'SECRET' then
                local yK = ColorSequence.new{
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(240, 243, 250)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, Color3.fromRGB(120, 128, 146)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.52, Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 42)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.74, Color3.fromRGB(110, 118, 136)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 255)),
                }

                yH[yJ] = yK

                return yK
            end

            local yK = dr(yI)
            local yL, yM = (typeof(yK) == 'Instance' and yK:IsA'UIGradient' and {
                (yK.Color.Keypoints),
            } or {
                (typeof(yK) == 'ColorSequence' and {
                    (yK.Keypoints),
                } or {nil})[1],
            })[1], {}

            if yL then
                for yN, yO in ipairs(yL)do
                    yN = yO.Value

                    if yN.R * 0.299 + yN.G * 0.587 + yN.B * 0.114 >= 0.45 then
                        table.insert(yM, yN)
                    end
                end
            end
            if #yM == 0 then
                table.insert(yM, typeof(yI.Color) == 'Color3' and yI.Color or yf)
            end

            yI, yK = {}, math.min(#yM, 8)

            for yN = 1, yK, 1 do
                local yO = yM[math.clamp(math.floor((yN - 1) * (#yM - 1) / math.max(yK - 1, 1) + 1.5), 1, #yM)]

                table.insert(yI, yO:Lerp(yf, 0.36))
            end

            if #yI == 1 then
                table.insert(yI, yI[1])
            end

            yM = {}

            for yN, yO in ipairs(yI)do
                table.insert(yM, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((yN - 1) / (#yI - 1), yO))
            end

            yK = ColorSequence.new(yM)
            yH[yJ] = yK

            return yK
        end
        local function dr(yI, yJ)
            local yK = yI:FindFirstChild'RarityPaint'

            if yK then
                yK:Destroy()
            end

            yI.BackgroundColor3 = yf
            yK = Instance.new'UIGradient'
            yK.Name = 'RarityPaint'
            yK.Rotation = 90
            yK.Color = ir(yJ)
            yK.Parent = yI
        end
        local function tr(yI, yJ)
            local yK = yI.Keypoints

            if yJ <= yK[1].Time then
                return yK[1].Value
            end

            for yL = 2, #yK, 1 do
                local yM, yN = yK[yL - 1], yK[yL]

                if yJ <= yN.Time then
                    yI = yN.Time - yM.Time
                    yL = yI > 0 and (yJ - yM.Time) / yI or 0

                    return yM.Value:Lerp(yN.Value, yL)
                end
            end

            return yK[#yK].Value
        end
        local function ir(yI, yJ, yK)
            local yL = {
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, tr(yI, yJ)),
            }

            for yM, yN in ipairs(yI.Keypoints)do
                if yN.Time > yJ + 0.001 then
                    if yN.Time < yK - 0.001 then
                        table.insert(yL, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((yN.Time - yJ) / (yK - yJ), yN.Value))
                    end
                end
            end

            table.insert(yL, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, tr(yI, yK)))

            return ColorSequence.new(yL)
        end

        local yI = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(236, 240, 248))

        local function kr(yJ, yK, yL)
            if not (yL) then
                if string.upper(tostring(yK.Rarity)) == 'SECRET' then
                    Nr(yJ, yK, nil)

                    return
                end
            end

            local yN = yJ:FindFirstChild'RarityPaint'

            if yN then
                yN:Destroy()
            end

            yN = Instance.new'UIGradient'
            yN.Name = 'RarityPaint'

            if string.upper(tostring(yK.Rarity)) == 'SECRET' then
                yN.Rotation = 90
                yN.Color = yI
                yN.Parent = yJ

                return
            end

            local yO, yP = yK.Gradient
            local yR = 90

            if typeof(yO) == 'Instance' and yO:IsA'UIGradient' then
                yP, yR = yO.Color, yO.Rotation
            else
                yP = (typeof(yO) == 'ColorSequence' and {yO} or {yP})[1]
            end
            if yP then
            else
                yO = typeof(yK.Color) == 'Color3' and yK.Color or yf
                yP = ColorSequence.new(yO:Lerp(yf, 0.35), yO)
            end

            local yS, yT, yU = math.cos(math.rad(yR)) < -0.3 or math.sin(math.rad(yR)) < 
-0.3

            if yL then
                yT, yU = yS and 0.5 or 0, yS and 1 or 0.5
            else
                yT, yU = yS and 0 or 0.5, yS and 0.5 or 1
            end

            yN.Color = ir(yP, yT, yU)
            yN.Rotation = yR
            yN.Parent = yJ
        end
        local function Nr(yJ)
            yJ = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(yJ) or 0))

            if yJ >= 3600 then
                return string.format('%dh %02dm', math.floor(yJ / 3600), math.floor(yJ % 3600 / 60))
            end

            return string.format('%dm %02ds', math.floor(yJ / 60), yJ % 60)
        end
        local function tr(yJ, yK)
            local yL, yN = pcall(function()
                local yL = bh

                return yL.EggRecords.EggIcon(yJ)
            end)

            if yL then
                if type(yN) == 'string' then
                    if yN ~= '' then
                        return yN
                    end
                end
            end

            yL = bh

            local yP, yR = yL.Assets

            if yP then
                yL = bh
                yR = yL.Assets.Directory
            else
                yR = yP
            end

            yL = type(yR) == 'table' and yR[tostring(yJ.AssetCategory)] or nil

            if type(yL) == 'table' then
                if type(yL.Egg) == 'table' then
                    if yL.Egg.Icon then
                        return tostring(yL.Egg.Icon)
                    end
                end
            end

            return yK.Icon or ''
        end
        local function ir()
            local yJ = bh
            local yK = yJ.EggState

            if type(yK) ~= 'table' then
                return nil
            elseif type(yK.ReadOwnerEggs) ~= 'function' then
                return nil
            end

            local yL, yP, yR = aG, pcall(yK.ReadOwnerEggs, aG.UserId)

            if yP then
                if type(yR) ~= 'table' then
                    return nil
                end
            else
                return nil
            end

            yP = bh

            local yS, yT, yU, yV = yP.EggRecords, workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), {}, pairs

            for yW, yX in yV(yR)do
                yJ = type(yX) == 'table'

                if yJ then
                    yP = wS

                    local yY, yZ, y_, y0 = yP.AssetInfo(yX.AssetCategory), tonumber(yX.AssetScale) or 0, type(yX.Mutations) == 'table' and yX.Mutations or {}, 0

                    if type(yS) == 'table' then
                        if type(yS.WeightKg) == 'function' then
                            local y1, y2 = pcall(yS.WeightKg, yX)

                            y0 = (y1 and {
                                (type(y2) == 'number' and {y2} or {y0})[1],
                            } or {y0})[1]
                        end
                    end

                    local y1, y2 = {
                        Id = yW,
                        Info = yY,
                        Scale = yZ,
                        Weight = y0,
                        Mutations = y_,
                    }, wS

                    y1.Income = y2.Income(yY, yZ, y_)
                    y1.Status = 'Inventory'
                    y1.Remaining = 1 / 0
                    y1.Percent = 0
                    y1.EggIcon = tr(yX, yY)

                    if yX.Placement ~= nil then
                        y_, yY = pcall(yK.IsReadyToHatch, yW)

                        if y_ and yY then
                            y1.Status = 'Ready'
                            y1.Remaining = 0
                            y1.Percent = 100
                        elseif type(yS) == 'table' then
                            if type(yS.GrowthSecondsRemaining) == 'function' then
                                yZ = 1

                                if type(yS.GrowthSpeedMultiplier) == 'function' then
                                    local y3, y4 = pcall(yS.GrowthSpeedMultiplier, yX)

                                    yZ = (y3 and {
                                        (type(y4) == 'number' and {y4} or {yZ})[1],
                                    } or {yZ})[1]
                                end

                                local y3, y4, y5 = 0, pcall(yS.GrowthSecondsRemaining, yX, yT, yZ)

                                y2 = (y4 and {
                                    (type(y5) == 'number' and {y5} or {0})[1],
                                } or {0})[1]

                                if type(yS.GrowthDuration) == 'function' then
                                    y4, y5 = pcall(yS.GrowthDuration, yX)
                                    y3 = (y4 and {
                                        (type(y5) == 'number' and {y5} or {y3})[1],
                                    } or {y3})[1]
                                end

                                y1.Status = 'Growing'
                                y1.Remaining = y2

                                if y3 > 0 then
                                    y1.Percent = math.clamp(math.floor((1 - y2 / y3) * 100), 0, 100)
                                end
                            else
                                y1.Status = 'Growing'
                            end
                        else
                            y1.Status = 'Growing'
                        end
                    end

                    table.insert(yU, y1)
                end
            end

            return yU
        end

        local function tr(yJ)
            local yK = ym.Sort

            table.sort(yJ, function(yP, yR)
                if yK == xy[2] and yP.Info.RarityNumber ~= yR.Info.RarityNumber then
                    return yP.Info.RarityNumber > yR.Info.RarityNumber
                elseif yK == xy[3] then
                    if yP.Remaining ~= yR.Remaining then
                        return yP.Remaining < yR.Remaining
                    end
                end
                if yP.Income ~= yR.Income then
                    return yP.Income > yR.Income
                end

                return tostring(yP.Id) < tostring(yR.Id)
            end)
        end

                yP = yP .. ' ' .. string.lower(tostring(yS))
            end

            return string.find(yP, yK, 1, true) ~= nil
        end

                return '', nil
            elseif #yU == 0 then

            end

            for yX, yY in ipairs(yU)do

                    yU = yP

                    yU = ColorSequence.new(yZ[1], yZ[2])
                end

            return table.concat(yW, yV or ' + '), yU
        end

                end)
            end)
        end)
    end

        local function _()
            if type(writefile) ~= 'function' then
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                if type(isfolder) == 'function' then

                    WindowMode = z8.WindowMode,
                    Visited = Ad,
                })
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            if type(readfile) ~= 'function' then
                return
            end

                if not (isfile(z0)) then

        local function k()
            if z8.Window <= 0 then
                return 0
            end

            local Ad = B()

            if z8.Window <= Ad then
                z8.Window = 0
                z8.WindowMode = nil

                _()

                return 0
            end
            if z8.WindowMode ~= z8.Mode then
                return 0
            end

            return z8.Window - Ad
        end
        local function D()

            if Ad then
                if Ad <= B() then
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end
            if z8.Window == Ad then
                if z8.WindowMode == z8.Mode then
                    return
                end
            end

            z8.Window = Ad
            z8.WindowMode = z8.Mode

            _()
        end

        local function c(Ad)
            local Ag = bh
            local Ah, Ai = Ag.Assets

            if Ah then
                Ag = bh
                Ai = Ag.Assets.Directory
            else
                Ai = Ah
            end

            Ag = type(Ai) == 'table' and Ai[tostring(Ad)] or nil

            if type(Ag) ~= 'table' then
                return 0, 0, tostring(Ad)
            end

            Ai = type(Ag.Rarity) == 'table' and Ag.Rarity or nil

            return Ai and tonumber(Ai.RarityNumber or Ai.Rank) or 0, tonumber(Ag.EarningRate) or 0, tostring(Ag.DisplayName or Ad)
        end
        local function H(Ad)
            local Ag = bh
            local Ah = Ag.Mutations

            if type(Ah) == 'table' then
                if type(Ah.EarningsFor) == 'function' then
                    local Ai, Aj = pcall(Ah.EarningsFor, type(Ad) == 'table' and Ad or {})

                    if Ai then
                        if type(Aj) == 'number' then
                            return Aj
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return 1
        end
        local function C(Ad, Ag)
            local Ah = tonumber(Ad.AssetScale) or 1

            return Ag * (Ah > 5 and (Ah / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or Ah ^ 1.85) * H(Ad.Mutations)
        end
        local function H(Ad, Ag, Ah, Ai, Aj)
            if type(Ad) ~= 'table' then
                return false
            elseif Ad.Uid == nil then
                return false
            end
            if Ag[tostring(Ad.AreaId)] ~= true then
                return false
            end

            Ag = tostring(Ad.AssetCategory)

            local Al, Am = c(Ag)

            if Al < Ah then
                return false
            end
            if next(Ai) ~= nil then
                if Ai[Ag] ~= true then
                    return false
                end
            end
            if Aj > 0 then
                if C(Ad, Am) < Aj then
                    return false
                end
            end

            return true
        end
        local function K(Ad)
            return H(Ad, z8.Areas, z8.MinRarity, z8.Specific, z8.MinIncome)
        end
        local function w(Ad)
            local Ag, Ah, Ai, Aj = ez, eB, eC, eR

            return H(Ad, Ag, Ah, Ai, Aj)
        end
        local function H(Ad)
            local Ag

            if not (Ad) then
                local Ah = bh
                local Ai = Ah.EggState

                Ah = type(Ai) == 'table'

                if Ah then
                    local Aj = type(Ai.ReadFieldEggs) == 'function'

                    if Aj then
                        task.spawn(function()
                            local Al, Am = pcall(Ai.ReadFieldEggs)

                            if Al then
                                local An = type(Am) == 'table'

                                if An then
                                    local Ao = type(Am.Records) == 'table'

                                    if Ao then
                                        local Ap = next(Am.Records) ~= nil

                                        if Ap then
                                            Ag = Am.Records
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end

            Ad = not Ag

            if Ad then
                local Ah = aH
                local Ai = Ah:FindFirstChild(z_)

                Ah = Ai and (Ai:IsA'RemoteFunction')

                if Ah then
                    local Aj, Al = pcall(Ai.InvokeServer, Ai)
                    local Am = Aj and type(Al) == 'table' and type(Al.Records) == 'table'

                    if Am then
                        Ag = Al.Records
                    end
                end
            end

            return Ag
        end
        local function E(Ad)
            local Ag = eg
            local Ah = Ag.Steal
            local Ai, Aj, Al = Ah.Carrying == true and Ah.CarryUid ~= nil and tostring(Ah.CarryUid) or nil, {
                Free = 0,
                FreeSteal = 0,
                Carried = 0,
                Mine = false,
                Best = nil,
                Rare = false,
                Matched = {},
                Count = 0,
            }, pairs

            for Am, An in Al(Ad)do
                Ah = type(An) == 'table' and An.Uid ~= nil and An.State ~= 'Claimed'

                if Ah then
                    local Ao, Ap = tostring(An.Uid), tostring(An.AssetCategory)

                    Am, Ag = c(Ap)

                    local Aq = An.State == 'Slot' or An.State == 'Dropped' or An.State == 'Carried'

                    if Aq then
                        if Am >= z8.RareMin then
                            Aj.Rare = true
                        end
                    end

                    local As = Aq and (K(An))

                    if As then
                        local At = false

                        pcall(function()
                            local Au = eg

                            At = Au.SafeCarry.Unsafe{
                                Uid = An.Uid,
                                Category = Ap,
                            } ~= nil
                        end)

                        local Au, Av = false, Ao == Ai

                        if Av then
                            Aj.Mine = true
                            Au = true
                        else
                            local Aw, Ax = not At

                            if Aw then
                                Aq = eF
                                Ax = Aq[An.Uid] ~= true
                            else
                                Ax = Aw
                            end
                            if Ax then
                                if An.State == 'Carried' then
                                    Aj.Carried = Aj.Carried + 1
                                else
                                    Aj.Free = Aj.Free + 1

                                    if w(An) then
                                        Aj.FreeSteal = Aj.FreeSteal + 1
                                    end
                                end

                                Au = true
                            end
                        end
                        if Au then
                            Aj.Matched[Ao] = true
                            Aj.Count = Aj.Count + 1

                            local Aw, Ax = C(An, Ag), Aj.Best

                            if ((Ax and {
                                (Ao == Ai),
                            } or {
                                (not Ax),
                            })[1]) or Ax.State ~= 'Mine' and Aw > Ax.Value then
                                Aj.Best = {
                                    Uid = Ao,
                                    Category = Ap,
                                    Record = An,
                                    Value = Aw,
                                    Area = tostring(An.AreaId),
                                    State = Ao == Ai and 'Mine' or tostring(An.State),
                                }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return Aj
        end
        local function R()
            local Ad = eg
            local Ag = Ad.Steal

            return Ag.Active == true or Ag.Carrying == true
        end
        local function C()
            local Ad = eg

        local function w(Ad)

            if Ag then
                Ad = eg
                Ah = Ad.Toggle(z8.Handle, false) == true
            else

        local function l(Ad)
            local Ag = eg
            local Ah = Ag.Steal

            Ag = Ah.Carrying == true and Ah.CarryUid ~= nil

            if Ag then
                local Ai, Aj = tostring(Ah.CarryUid), z8.LastCarry
                local Al = (Aj and {
                    (Aj.Uid ~= Ai),
                } or {
                    (not Aj),
                })[1]

                if Al then
                    Aj = {Uid = Ai}

                    local Am

                    Am, Aj.Category = eg, tostring(eg.SafeCarry.Category or '')
                    Aj.Matched = false
                    z8.LastCarry = Aj
                end
                if Ad.Matched[Ai] then
                    Aj.Matched = true
                end
                if Ad.Best then
                    if Ad.Best.Uid == Ai then
                        Aj.Category = Ad.Best.Category
                    end
                end

                Aj.At = os.clock()
            elseif z8.LastCarry then
                if os.clock() - (z8.LastCarry.At or 0) > 15 then
                    z8.LastCarry = nil
                end
            end
        end

        Ab = aH
        zT = Ab:FindFirstChild'RE/EggWorld/FieldEggRedeemVerdict'

        local Ad = zT and (zT:IsA'RemoteEvent')

                local Ah, Ai = z8.LastCarry, type(Ag) == 'table' and tostring(Ag.AssetCategory or '') or ''

                if Ah then
                    if Ah.Matched then

                            z8.Delivered = true

        local function s(Ag)
            K('Checking the field one last time', 'hop')

            local Ah = H(true)

            if not (w(Ag)) then
                return
            end
            if type(Ah) ~= 'table' then
                K('Could not read the eggs, checking again', 'retry')
                task.wait(1)

                return
            end

            local Ai = E(Ah)

            z8.Survey = Ai

            if Ai.Free > 0 then
                K('A filter egg showed up, hop cancelled', 'found')

                return
            elseif Ai.Mine then
                K('A filter egg showed up, hop cancelled', 'found')

                return
            elseif Ai.Carried > 0 then
                K('A filter egg showed up, hop cancelled', 'found')

                return
            elseif R() then
                K('A filter egg showed up, hop cancelled', 'found')

                return
            end
            if q() then
                return
            end

            z8.Visited[tostring(game.JobId)] = B()

            _()
            K('Joining a less crowded server', 'joining')

            local Aj, Al, Am = 'missing', eg, type(eg.ServerHop) == 'function'

            if Am then
                local An, Ao, Ap = eg, pcall(eg.ServerHop, 'Least Players')

                Aj = Ao and tostring(Ap) or 'error'
            end
            if not (w(Ag)) then
                return
            end

            K(Aj == 'waiting' and 'Teleport is slow, trying another server' or (Aj == 'empty' and 'Every listed server is full, searching again' or (Aj == 'fetch' and 'Server list unavailable, waiting a moment' or (Aj == 'denied' and 'That server filled up on join, taking the next one' or 'Hop did not land, trying again'))), 'retry')
            task.wait(Aj == 'fetch' and 5 or 1.5)
        end
        local function _(Ag)
            z8.HopEnd = 0

            local Ai

            while w(Ag) do
                local Aj, Am = 0.5, Ai

                if q() then
                    z8.HopEnd = 0
                    z8.Delivered = false

                    P()

                    if W(1) then
                        K('Night, waiting for the egg reset', 'night')
                    else
                        K("Night, today's hop run is over", 'night')
                    end

                    task.wait(1)

                    Ai = nil

                    continue
                end

                local Ao = H(false)

                if not (w(Ag)) then
                    return
                end
                if type(Ao) ~= 'table' then
                    z8.HopEnd = 0

                    K('Reading the eggs in this server', 'scan')
                    task.wait(1)

                    Ai = nil

                    continue
                end

                local Ap = E(Ao)

                z8.Survey = Ap

                l(Ap)

                if Ap.Rare then
                    if W(3) then
                        D()
                    end
                end
                if z8.Delivered then
                    if W(2) then
                        D()
                    end
                end
                if Ap.Carried == 0 then
                    z8.CarriedSince = nil
                end

                local Aq, As, At, Au = nil, nil, false, v()
                local Av, Aw, Ax = Au and Au - B() or 1 / 0, C(), os.clock() - z8.LoadedAt < 3

                if Ax then
                    Aq, As = 'Scanning this server', 'scan'
                else
                    Au = Ap.Mine

                    if Au then
                        local Ay, Az = 'Auto Steal is taking an egg, hop waits', 'steal'

                        Aq, As = Ay, Az
                    else
                        Ao = R()

                        local Ay, Az

                        if Ao then
                            Ay, Az = 'Auto Steal is taking an egg, hop waits', 'steal'
                            Aq, As = Ay, Az
                        else
                            local AA, AB, AC = eg, type(eg.RaceRally) == 'table'

                            if AB then
                                local AD = eg

                                AC = AD.RaceRally.Wanted == true
                            else
                                AC = AB
                            end
                            if AC then
                                Ay, Az = 'Racing Event is on, hop waits', 'race'
                                Aq, As = Ay, Az
                            else
                                local AD, AE, AF = eg, type(eg.ShootingStar) == 'table'

                                if AE then
                                    AB = eg
                                    AF = AB.ShootingStar.Wanted == true
                                else
                                    AF = AE
                                end
                                if AF then
                                    Ay, Az = 'Catching a Shooting Star, hop waits', 'star'
                                    Aq, As = Ay, Az
                                else
                                    if Aw and Ap.FreeSteal > 0 then
                                        AE = Ap.Best

                                        local AG = AE and select(3, c(AE.Category)) or 'a filter egg'

                                        Az = 'found'
                                        Aq, As = Ap.FreeSteal == 1 and 'Filter egg here (' .. AG .. '), stealing it first' or string.format('%d filter eggs here, stealing them first', Ap.FreeSteal), Az
                                    else
                                        if Ap.Free > 0 and (W(1) or not Aw) then
                                            local AG = Ap.Best

                                            Ay, Az = 'Found ' .. (AG and select(3, c(AG.Category)) or 'a filter egg') .. ', staying here', 'found'
                                            Aq, As = Ay, Az
                                        else
                                            if Ap.Carried > 0 and (z8.CarriedSince == nil or os.clock() - z8.CarriedSince < z2) then
                                                z8.CarriedSince = z8.CarriedSince or os.clock()
                                                Ay, Az = 'Someone carries a filter egg, waiting in case it drops', 'steal'
                                                Aq, As = Ay, Az
                                            else
                                                if Av < z3 then
                                                    Ay, Az = 'Night is close, staying here', 'night'
                                                    Aq, As = Ay, Az
                                                else
                                                    local AG

                                                    if W(1) then
                                                        AG = true
                                                        At = AG
                                                    else
                                                        if W(2) then
                                                            if k() > 0 then
                                                                AG = true
                                                                At = AG
                                                            else
                                                                if C() then
                                                                    Ay, Az = 'Waiting for Auto Steal to bring home a filter egg', 'rare'
                                                                    Aq, As = Ay, Az
                                                                else
                                                                    Ay, Az = 'Turn on Auto Steal, hopping starts after it brings home a filter egg', 'rare'
                                                                    Aq, As = Ay, Az
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        else
                                                            if k() > 0 then
                                                                AG = true
                                                                At = AG
                                                            else
                                                                Ay, Az = 'Waiting for a ' .. z8.RareLabel .. ' egg to spawn here', 'rare'
                                                                Aq, As = Ay, Az
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if Aq then
                    z8.HopEnd = 0

                    K(Aq, As)

                    Ai = nil
                else
                    if At then
                        if Am then
                            Ai = Am
                        else
                            Ai = math.max(os.clock() + 1.5, z8.LoadedAt + z8.HopDelay)
                            z8.HopStart = os.clock()
                            z8.HopEnd = Ai
                        end

                        Au = Ai - os.clock()

                        if Au > 0 then
                            K(string.format('No filter egg here, hopping in %.1fs', Au), 'hop')

                            Aj = math.min(0.25, Au)
                        else
                            z8.HopEnd = 0

                            s(Ag)

                            Aj, Ai = 0, nil
                        end
                    else
                        Ai = Am
                    end
                end
                if Aj > 0 then
                    task.wait(Aj)
                end
            end
        end
        local function R()

        local function E()

            local AF, AG, AH, AI, AJ, AK, AL, AM, AN, AO, AP, AR = {}, 0, 0, 0.06, 
-1, -1, -1, false, 0, true, 0
            local AS, AT, AU = 0, false, false

            local function er(AV)
                if not AV or AV.DiffWrapped then
                    return AV
                end

                local AW = AV.Set

                AV.DiffWrapped = true
                AV.Set = function(AX)
                    if type(AX) ~= 'table' then
                        return AW(AX)
                    end

                    local AY, AZ = AV.Spec

                    for A_, A0 in pairs(AX)do
                        if AY[A_] ~= A0 then
                            AZ = AZ or {}
                            AZ[A_] = A0
                        end
                    end

                    if AZ then
                        AW(AZ)
                    end

                    return AV
                end

                return AV
            end
            local function Zr(AV)
                local AW = tostring(AH) .. '|' .. string.gsub(tostring(AV.Spec.Text or ''), '%d', '0')

                if AV.WidthKey == AW then
                    return AV.WidthUnits
                end

                local AX = AV.Get()

                if AX then
                    local AY = AH

                    if AY <= 0 then
                        return nil
                    elseif AX.Text ~= tostring(AV.Spec.Text or '') then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end

                local AY, AZ = AX.Size, AX.TextWrapped

                AX.TextWrapped = false
                AX.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100000, math.max(1, AY.Y.Offset))

                local A_ = AX.TextBounds.X

                AX.Size = AY
                AX.TextWrapped = AZ

                if A_ <= 0 then
                    return nil
                end

    local zU = function()

            Max = 1000,
            Default = 240,

                Ad = eg
                Ad.UserFpsCap = Am

                Am = (Ad.RenderOff == true and {
                    (math.min(Am, 40)),

                Ad = type(setfpscap) == 'function'

                if Ad then

                end

    zU()

    local z8 = function()
        local z8, Ad, Am, Ap, As = game:GetService'Lighting', 0.003, false, 0
        local Au, Av, Aw, Ax = {}, {}, setmetatable, {
            __mode = 'k',
        }
        local Ay, Az, AB = Aw({}, Ax), {}

        local function e(AF, AH, AI)
            local AJ, AK = pcall(AF)

            if not (AJ) then
                return
            end

            Av[#Av + 1] = {
                Setter = AH,
                Value = AK,
            }

            pcall(AH, AI)
        end
        local function m(AF, AH, AI)
            local AJ = Ay[AF]

            if AJ then
            else
                AJ = {}
                Ay[AF] = AJ
            end
            if AJ[AH] == nil then
                local AK, AL = pcall(function()
                    return AF[AH]
                end)

                if not (AK) then
                    return
                end

                AJ[AH] = {Value = AL}
            end

            pcall(function()
                AF[AH] = AI
            end)
        end
        local function L(AF)
            local AH = Am

            if AH then
                if not (AF.Parent) then
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end
            if AF:IsA'ParticleEmitter' then
                m(AF, 'Enabled', false)
                m(AF, 'Rate', 0)
            elseif AF:IsA'Trail' then
                m(AF, 'Enabled', false)
            elseif AF:IsA'Beam' then
                m(AF, 'Enabled', false)
            elseif AF:IsA'PointLight' or AF:IsA'SpotLight' or AF:IsA'SurfaceLight' then
                m(AF, 'Enabled', false)
                m(AF, 'Brightness', 0)
            elseif AF:IsA'Fire' or AF:IsA'Smoke' then
                m(AF, 'Enabled', false)
            elseif AF:IsA'Sparkles' then
                m(AF, 'Enabled', false)
            elseif AF:IsA'Explosion' then
                m(AF, 'Visible', false)
            elseif AF:IsA'SpecialMesh' then
                m(AF, 'TextureId', '')
            elseif AF:IsA'Decal' or AF:IsA'Texture' then
                if AF.Name == 'face' then
                    if AF.Parent then
                        if not (AF.Parent.Name == 'Head') then
                            m(AF, 'Transparency', 1)
                        end
                    else
                        m(AF, 'Transparency', 1)
                    end
                else
                    m(AF, 'Transparency', 1)
                end
            elseif AF:IsA'MeshPart' then
                m(AF, 'RenderFidelity', Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance)
                m(AF, 'TextureID', '')
                m(AF, 'CastShadow', false)
                m(AF, 'Reflectance', 0)
                m(AF, 'Material', Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            elseif AF:IsA'BasePart' then
                m(AF, 'CastShadow', false)
                m(AF, 'Reflectance', 0)
                m(AF, 'Material', Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            elseif AF:IsA'PostEffect' then
                m(AF, 'Enabled', false)
            elseif AF:IsA'Clouds' then
                m(AF, 'Cover', 0)
                m(AF, 'Density', 0)
            elseif AF:IsA'Atmosphere' then
                m(AF, 'Density', 0)
                m(AF, 'Haze', 0)
                m(AF, 'Glare', 0)
            end
        end
        local function m()
            for AF, AH in ipairs(Au)do
                if AH.Connected then
                    AH:Disconnect()
                end
            end

            table.clear(Au)

            local AH = AB

            if AH then
                pcall(function()
                    AB:Disconnect()
                end)

                AB = nil
            end
        end
        local function j()
            local AH, AI = settings().Rendering, workspace.Terrain

            local function a(AJ, AK, AL)
                e(function()
                    return AJ[AK]
                end, function(AM)
                    AJ[AK] = AM
                end, AL)
            end

            a(AH, 'QualityLevel', Enum.QualityLevel.Level01)
            a(AH, 'MeshPartDetailLevel', Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level01)
            a(AH, 'EditQualityLevel', Enum.QualityLevel.Level01)

            local AJ, AK = pcall(function()
                return UserSettings():GetService'UserGameSettings'
            end)

            if AJ then
                if AK then
                    a(AK, 'SavedQualityLevel', Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1)
                end
            end

            a(z8, 'GlobalShadows', false)
            a(z8, 'ShadowSoftness', 0)
            a(z8, 'FogEnd', 9000000000)
            a(z8, 'Technology', Enum.Technology.Legacy)
            a(z8, 'EnvironmentDiffuseScale', 0)
            a(z8, 'EnvironmentSpecularScale', 0)
            a(AI, 'Decoration', false)
            a(AI, 'WaterWaveSize', 0)
            a(AI, 'WaterWaveSpeed', 0)
            a(AI, 'WaterReflectance', 0)
            a(AI, 'WaterTransparency', 1)
        end
        local function e(AI, AJ)
            local AK, AL, AM = os.clock(), ipairs, table.pack(AI:GetDescendants())

            for AO, AP in AL(table.unpack(AM, 1, AM.n))do
                AO = Am

                if AO then
                    AI = Ap

                    if AI ~= AJ then
                        return false
                    end
                else
                    return false
                end

                L(AP)

                AO = os.clock() - AK > Ad

                if AO then
                    AP = ah

                    AP.Heartbeat:Wait()

                    AK = os.clock()
                end
            end

            return true
        end
        local function F()
            local AI = Am

            if AI then
                if #Az == 0 then
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end

            AI = os.clock()

            while#Az > 0 do
                L((table.remove(Az)))

                if os.clock() - AI > Ad then
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local function L()
            local AI, AJ = os.clock, pairs
            local AK = AI()

            for AL, AM in AJ(Ay)do
                if AL.Parent then
                    for AO, AP in pairs(AM)do
                        pcall(function()
                            AL[AO] = AP.Value
                        end)
                    end
                end

                Ay[AL] = nil
                AI = os.clock() - AK > Ad

                if AI then
                    AM = ah

                    AM.Heartbeat:Wait()

                    AK = os.clock()
                end
            end
        end
        local function N()
            local AI = Am

            if not (AI) then
                return
            end

            Am = false
            Ap = Ap + 1

            m()
            table.clear(Az)

            AI = As

            if AI then
                pcall(task.cancel, As)

                As = nil
            end

            L()

            for AJ = #Av, 1, -1 do
                AI = Av[AJ]

                pcall(AI.Setter, AI.Value)
            end

            table.clear(Av)
        end
        local function z()
            local AI = Am

            if AI then
                return
            end

            Am = true
            Ap = Ap + 1

            local AJ = Ap

            j()

            local function L(AK)
                Au[#Au + 1] = AK.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(AL)
                    local AM = Am

                    if AM then
                        local AO = Ap

                        if AO == AJ then
                            Az[#Az + 1] = AL
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            L(workspace)
            L(z8)

            AI = ah
            AB = AI.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                local AK = Am

                if AK then
                    local AL = Ap

                    if AL == AJ then
                        F()
                    end
                end
            end)
            As = task.spawn(function()
                if e(workspace, AJ) then
                    e(z8, AJ)
                end
            end)
        end

        Aw = bE

        Aw(N)

        Aw = zI

        Aw:CreateToggle{
            Name = 'Optimizer',
            Note = 'Strip shadows, textures and effects for the highest FPS',
            Default = false,
            Callback = function(AI)
                if AI then
                    z()
                else
                    task.spawn(N)
                end
            end,
        }
    end

    local Ay = function()

        local A6 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 194, 77)

        local A8, Bb = {
            '',
            'K',
            'M',
            'B',
            'T',
            'Qa',
            'Qi',
            'Sx',
            'Sp',
            'Oc',

        }, {}

        for Bc, Bd in ipairs(A8)do
            Bb[string.lower(Bd)] = 10 ^ ((Bc - 1) * 3)
        end

        local function D(Bc)
            Bc = math.abs(tonumber(Bc) or 0)

            local Bd = 1

            while Bc >= 1000 and Bd < #A8 do
                Bc, Bd = Bc / 1000, Bd + 1
            end

            if Bd == 1 then
                return tostring(math.floor(Bc + 0.5))
            elseif Bc >= 100 then
                return string.format('%.0f%s', Bc, A8[Bd])
            elseif Bc >= 10 then
                return string.format('%.1f%s', Bc, A8[Bd])
            end

            return string.format('%.2f%s', Bc, A8[Bd])
        end
        local function S(Bc)
            if type(Bc) ~= 'string' then
                return nil
            end

            local Bd = string.gsub(string.gsub(Bc, '<[^>]->', ''), '[%$,%s]', '')
            local Bg, Bj = string.match(Bd, '^([%d%.]+)(%a*)')

            Bg = tonumber(Bg)
            Bc = Bg and Bb[string.lower(Bj or '')]

            return Bc and Bg * Bc or nil
        end
        local function E(Bc)
            Bc = math.max(0, math.floor(Bc))

            return string.format('%02d:%02d:%02d', math.floor(Bc / 3600), math.floor(Bc % 3600 / 60), Bc % 60)
        end

        local Bc, Bd = {}, {}

        local function V(Bg)
            local Bj = Bc[Bg]

            if Bj then
                if Bj.Parent then
                    if Bj.Text ~= '' then
                        return Bj.Text
                    end
                end
            end

            Bc[Bg] = nil

            if os.clock() < (Bd[Bg] or 0) then
                return nil
            end

            Bd[Bg] = os.clock() + 2
            Bj = aG

            local Bk = Bj:FindFirstChild'PlayerGui'

            Bj = Bk and (Bk:FindFirstChild'HUD')

            if not Bj then
                return nil
            end

            Bk = {
                'GameHUD',
                'TradmilHud',
            }

            for Bl, Bm in ipairs(Bk)do
                Bl = Bj:FindFirstChild(Bm)
                Bm = Bl and (Bl:FindFirstChild(Bg, true))
                Bl = Bm and (Bm:FindFirstChild'Value')

                if Bl then
                    if Bl:IsA'TextLabel' then
                        if Bl.Text ~= '' then
                            Bc[Bg] = Bl
                            Bd[Bg] = nil

                            return Bl.Text
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function J(Bg)
            local Bj = aG
            local Bk = Bj:FindFirstChild'leaderstats'

            Bj = Bk and (Bk:FindFirstChild(Bg))

            return Bj and tonumber(Bj.Value) or nil
        end

        end

            if Bk then
                Bj = bh
                Bl = Bj.Assets.Directory

                Bl = Bk
            end

        end
        local function p(Bg)
            local Bj = type(Bg) == 'table' and Bg.Rarity or nil

            if type(Bj) ~= 'table' then
                return '', 0, nil
            end

            return tostring(Bj.DisplayName or Bj._id or ''), tonumber(Bj.Rank or Bj.RarityNumber) or 0, Bj
        end
        local function s(Bg)
            local Bj = type(Bg) == 'table' and Bg.Mutations or nil

            if type(Bj) ~= 'table' then
                return ''
            elseif #Bj == 0 then
                return ''
            end

            return table.concat(Bj, ' ')
        end

        local function v(Bp, Bq)

                        Bx = nil

                        Bz = BA
                    end

                    BA = Bw.CurrentNightCredit(BB, BD, BC, BE)

                    return Bw.WallSecondsRemaining(BB, BD, BC, BA)
                end)
            end)

            local Bw = not Bs or type(Bt) ~= 'number'

            if Bw then
                return nil
            end

            Bw = Bt <= 0

            if Bw then
                return 'Ready'
            end

            Bt = math.floor(Bt)
            Bw = Bt >= 3600

            if Bw then
                local BA, BB, BC = string.format, math.floor(Bt / 3600), math.floor(Bt % 3600 / 60)

                return BA('%dh %02dm', BB, BC)
            end

            local BA, BB, BC = string.format, math.floor(Bt / 60), Bt % 60

            return BA('%dm %02ds', BB, BC)
        end

        local function Q(BB, BC, BD, BE, BF, BG, BH)
            local BI, BJ = type(BG) == 'table' and #BG or 0, BB[BC]

            if BJ then
                if BJ.Record == BD then
                    if BJ.Category == BE then
                        if BJ.Scale == BF then
                            if BJ.Mutations == BG then
                                if BJ.MutationCount == BI then
                                    return BJ
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local BK = P(BE)
            local BL, BM = p(BK)

            BJ = {
                Uid = BC,
                Record = BD,
                Entry = BK,
                Rank = BM,
                Category = BE,
                Scale = BF,
                Mutations = BG,
                MutationCount = BI,
                Size = tonumber(BF) or BH,
                Rate = c(BE, BF, BG),
            }
            BB[BC] = BJ

            return BJ
        end
        local function c(BB, BC)
            if BB.Rate ~= BC.Rate then
                return BB.Rate > BC.Rate
            end

            return BB.Uid < BC.Uid
        end
        local function n(BB, BC)
            if BB.Rank ~= BC.Rank then
                return BB.Rank > BC.Rank
            end
            if BB.Size ~= BC.Size then
                return BB.Size > BC.Size
            end

            return BB.Uid < BC.Uid
        end
        local function x(BB, BC, BD)
            local BE = #BB

            if BE >= Bt then
                if not (BD(BC, BB[BE])) then
                    return
                end
            end

            local BF = BE + 1

            while BF > 1 and BD(BC, BB[BF - 1]) do
                BF = BF - 1
            end

            table.insert(BB, BF, BC)

            if #BB > Bt then
                BB[#BB] = nil
            end
        end
        local function w()
            if os.clock() - Bq.At < 3 then
                return Bq
            end

            Bq.At = os.clock()

            local BB = G()

            if not BB then
                return Bq
            end
            if os.clock() >= BA.ResetAt then
                BA.ResetAt = os.clock() + 300

                table.clear(BA.Pets)
                table.clear(BA.Eggs)
            end

            local BC = 0

            for BD in pairs(type(BB.EquippedAssets) == 'table' and BB.EquippedAssets or {})do
                BC = BC + 1
            end

            local BD, BE = {}, 0

            for BF, BG in pairs(type(BB.Inventory) == 'table' and BB.Inventory or {})do
                if type(BG) == 'table' then
                    BE = BE + 1

                    x(BD, Q(BA.Pets, BF, BG, BG.Category, BG.Scale, BG.Mutations, 1), c)
                end
            end

            local BF, BG, BH = {}, 0, 0

            for BI, BJ in pairs(type(BB.EggInventory) == 'table' and BB.EggInventory or {})do
                if type(BJ) == 'table' then
                    BG = BG + 1
                    BH = (BJ.Placement and {
                        (BH + 1),
                    } or {BH})[1]

                    x(BF, Q(BA.Eggs, BI, BJ, BJ.AssetCategory, BJ.AssetScale, BJ.Mutations, 0), n)
                end
            end

            Bq.Pets = BE
            Bq.PlacedPets = BC
            Bq.Eggs = BG
            Bq.Growing = BH
            Bq.TopPets = BD
            Bq.TopEggs = BF
            Bq.Treadmill = nil

            pcall(function()
                local BI, BJ, BK = al, require(al.Data.Treadmills), tonumber(BB.TreadmillUpgradeLevel) or 0
                local BM = BJ.GetByUpgradeLevel(BK)

                if type(BM) ~= 'table' then
                    return
                end

                local BN, BO = pcall(BJ.GetByUpgradeLevel, BK + 1)

                local function c(BP)
                    return (string.gsub(tostring(BP.DisplayName or BP._id or 'Treadmill'), '%s*Treadmill$', ''))
                end

                BJ = (BN and {
                    (type(BO) == 'table' and {
                        ('next ' .. c(BO) .. ' $' .. D(tonumber(BO.Price) or 0)),
                    } or {
                        'max treadmill',
                    })[1],
                } or {
                    'max treadmill',
                })[1]
                Bq.Treadmill = {
                    Name = c(BM),
                    Multiplier = tonumber(BM.SpeedMultiplier) or 1,
                    Icon = BM.Icon and tostring(BM.Icon) or nil,
                    Note = BJ,
                }
            end)

            Bq.Rift = type(BB.Rift) == 'table' and BB.Rift or {}

            return Bq
        end

            else

        local function l()
            local BC = eg
            local BD, BE = (BC.Movement or {}).Owner, eg
            local BF, BG = BE.Steal or {}, BD == 'steal'

            if BG then
                return Y(), BF.Carrying == true and 'Stealing  |  carrying' or 'Stealing', AW.Eggs
            else
                BE = BD == 'place'

                if BE then
                    BC = eg

                    return G(BC.PlaceStatusText) or 'Placing eggs', 'Placing Eggs', AW.Index
                else
                    local BH = BD == 'essence'

                    if BH then
                        local BJ = eg
                        local BM = BJ.EssenceState
                        local BN, BO = type(BM) == 'table' and tostring(BM.Status or '') or '', type(BM) == 'table' and tostring(BM.Detail or '') or ''

                        BN = (BO ~= '' and {
                            BN ~= '' and BN .. '  -  ' .. BO or BO,
                        } or {BN})[1]

                        return BN ~= '' and BN or 'Applying mutations', 'Auto Mutate', AW.Lab
                    elseif BD == 'treadmill' then
                        local BM = J'Speed'
                        local BN = BM and Bn.Speed and BM - Bn.Speed or 0

                        return 'Running on the treadmill', BN > 0 and 'Treadmill  |  +' .. D(B(BN)) .. ' speed/h' or 'Treadmill', AW.Speed
                    elseif BD == 'invisibility' then
                        return 'Turning invisible', 'Invisibility', AW.Night
                    elseif BD == 'combat' then
                        return 'Fighting a player', 'Combat', AW.Fights
                    elseif BD == 'predictor' then
                        return 'Checking eggs', 'Predictor', AW.Index
                    end
                end
            end
            if BF.Carrying == true or BF.Active == true then
                return Y(), BF.Carrying == true and 'Stealing  |  carrying' or 'Stealing', AW.Eggs
            end

            BD = eg
            BE = BD.Treadmill

            if BE then
                BF = eg

                if BF.Treadmill.Riding == true then
                    BD = J'Speed'
                    BG = BD and Bn.Speed and BD - Bn.Speed or 0

                    return 'Running on the treadmill', BG > 0 and 'Treadmill  |  +' .. D(B(BG)) .. ' speed/h' or 'Treadmill', AW.Speed
                end
            end
            if K() then
                return Y(), 'Stealing', AW.Eggs
            end

            return 'Nothing running', 'Idle', AW.Eggs
        end

        local function tr(Ck, Cm)
            local Cn = Cc

            if Cn then
                if not (Ck.Parent) then
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end

            Cn = Cc.AbsoluteSize

            if Cn.X <= 0 then
                return
            elseif Cn.Y <= 0 then
                return
            end

            local Co, Cp, Cq = a(), Ck.AbsolutePosition - Cc.AbsolutePosition, Ck.AbsoluteSize
            local Cs, Ct = Cm and math.floor(14 * Co) or 0, (Cp.X < 0 and {
                (-Cp.X),
            } or {
                (Cp.X + Cq.X > Cn.X and {
                    (Cn.X - Cq.X - Cp.X),
                } or {0})[1],
            })[1]

            Cm = (Cp.Y - Cs < 0 and {
                (Cs - Cp.Y),
            } or {
                (Cp.Y + Cq.Y > Cn.Y and {
                    (Cn.Y - Cq.Y - Cp.Y),
                } or {0})[1],
            })[1]

            if Ct ~= 0 or Cm ~= 0 then
                Ck.Position = Ck.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(Ct), math.floor(Cm))
            end
        end

                elseif Cx then
                else
                    return

                local Cw = Co

                    if not (Cx) then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end

                if not Cw then
                    local Cx = Cp

                    if Cx then
                        return
                    elseif not (Cu.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
                        return
                    end

                Cw = Vector2.new(Cu.Position.X, Cu.Position.Y) - Cq
                Ck.Position = UDim2.new(Cs.X.Scale, Cs.X.Offset + Cw.X, Cs.Y.Scale, Cs.Y.Offset + Cw.Y)

            end)

                local Cw = Co

                    return
                end

                Cw = Cp and Cu == Cp or ((Cp and {
                    (not Cp),
                } or {
                    (Cu.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1),

                        YScale = Ck.Position.Y.Scale,

                end
            end)
