                    end)
                end

                table.clear(Cm.Gradients)
                table.insert(Cm.Gradients, Or(Cm.Stroke, Cy, 45))
                table.insert(Cm.Gradients, Or(Cm.Glow, Cy, nil))
                table.insert(Cm.Gradients, Or(Cm.Rarity, Cy, nil))

                Cm.Image.Image = tostring(Cn.Image(Co) or '')
                Cm.Rank.Text = '#' .. tostring(Cp)
                Cm.Mutation.Text = s(Co.Record)
                Cm.Name.Text = tostring(Cu and Cu.DisplayName or Cs)
                Cm.Rarity.Text = string.upper(Cw)
            end

            Cs, Ct, Cp = Cn.Detail(Co)

            E(Cm.ValueChip, Cs)
            E(Cm.SizeChip, Ct)
            E(Cm.HatchChip, Cp)
        end

        local Cm, Cn = {}

        local function Zr(Co)
            local Cp = math.max(0, os.time() - (tonumber(Co) or os.time()))

            if Cp < 60 then
                return Cp .. 's ago'
            elseif Cp < 3600 then
                return math.floor(Cp / 60) .. 'm ago'
            elseif Cp < 86400 then
                return math.floor(Cp / 3600) .. 'h ago'
            end

            return math.floor(Cp / 86400) .. 'd ago'
        end
        local function Rr(Co, Cp)
            local Cs = y('Frame', {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 20),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = Cp,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(330, 52),
                Visible = false,
            }, Co)

            y('UICorner', {
                CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
            }, Cs)

            local Ct, Cu, Cw = y('UIStroke', {
                Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                Thickness = 2,
                ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
            }, Cs), y('ImageLabel', {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 3),
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46),
            }, Cs), kr(Cs, 3, 22, false)
            local Cy, CA, CB = Yr(Cw, 17, 122), ir(Cw, 'Size', 2, 16), kr(Cs, 27, 22, false)

            return {
                Frame = Cs,
                Stroke = Ct,
                Image = Cu,
                Name = Cy,
                Rarity = e(CB, true, 14, {
                    AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                    LayoutOrder = 1,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18),
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                }),
                SizeChip = CA,
                ValueChip = ir(CB, 'Value', 2, 16),
                When = e(Cs, true, 15, {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 20),
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                    TextColor3 = A6,
                }),
                Key = nil,
                Gradients = {},
            }
        end
        local function h()
            local Co = Cn

            if not (Co) then
                return
            end

            Cn.Frame.Visible = B0['Steal History'] == true

            local Cp, Cs = Bk.History, false

            for Ct, Cu in ipairs(Cm)do
                Co = Cp[Ct]

                if Co then
                    local Cw = Ct <= Ca + 1

                    if Cw then
                        Cu.Frame.Visible = true

                        local Cy = tostring(Co.At) .. '|' .. tostring(Co.Category) .. '|' .. tostring(Bp)
                        local CA = Cu.Key ~= Cy

                        if CA then
                            Cu.Key = Cy

                            local CB = P(Co.Category)
                            local CC, CD, CE = p(CB)

                            for CF, CG in ipairs(Cu.Gradients)do
                                pcall(function()
                                    CG:Destroy()
                                end)
                            end

                            table.clear(Cu.Gradients)
                            table.insert(Cu.Gradients, Or(Cu.Stroke, CE, 45))
                            table.insert(Cu.Gradients, Or(Cu.Rarity, CE, nil))

                            CE = Bp and CB and CB.Icon

                            if CE then
                                Cu.Image.Image = tostring(CB.Icon)
                            else
                                local CG, CH = Cu.Image, CB and type(CB.Egg) == 'table' and tostring(CB.Egg.Icon or '') or CB and tostring(CB.Icon or '')

                                CG.Image = CH or ''
                            end

                            Cu.Name.Text = tostring(Co.Name or Co.Category)
                            Cu.Rarity.Text = string.upper(tostring(Co.Rarity or ''))

                            E(Cu.ValueChip, tonumber(Co.Value) and '$' .. D(Co.Value) .. '/s' or '')
                            E(Cu.SizeChip, tonumber(Co.Scale) and string.format('x%.2f', tonumber(Co.Scale)) or '')
                        end

                        Cu.When.Text = Zr(Co.At)
                        Cs = true
                    else
                        Cu.Frame.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    Cu.Frame.Visible = false
                end
            end

            Cp = Cn.Empty

            if Cp then
                Cn.Empty.Visible = not Cs
            end
        end
        local function E()
            for Co, Cp in ipairs(Cg)do
                Co = B0

                local Cs = Co[Cp.Showcase.Id] == true

                Cp.Panel.Frame.Visible = Cs

                if Cs then

                    for Cy, CA in Cu(Cw)do
                        Co = Ct[Cy]

                        if Co then

                                Ar(CA, Cp.Showcase, Co, Cy)
                            else
                                CA.Frame.Visible = false
                            end
                        else
                            CA.Frame.Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            h()
        end

        end

        local function X()
            local Cp = Cc

            if not (Cp) then
                return
            end

            local Cs, Ct, Cu, Cw = G(), Ir(), dr(), 0

            for Cy, CA in ipairs(Ce)do
                Cw = (CA.Column == 'Center' and {
                    (CA.Frame.Visible and {
                        (math.max(Cw, CA.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X)),
                    } or {Cw})[1],
                } or {Cw})[1]
            end

            local CA, CB, CE = math.floor(Cw / 2 + 26 * Ct), {
                Left = 0,
                Right = 0,
                Center = 0,
            }, 0

            for CG, CH in ipairs(Ce)do
                if CH.Id == 'Signature' then
                    CE = CH.Frame.AbsoluteSize.Y
                    CH.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, Cu)
                end
            end

            Cp = Cu + CE + math.floor(46 * Ct)
            CB.Left = Cp
            CB.Right = Cp
            CB.Center = Cp

            for CH, CI in ipairs(Ce)do
                if CI.Id ~= 'Signature' then
                    local CJ, CK = o(CI.Id, Ct, Cu, Cs.Y), CI.Column

                    CH = CB[CK] or Cp

                    if CJ then
                        CI.Frame.Position = CJ
                    elseif CK == 'Left' then
                        CI.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -CA, 0, CH)
                    elseif CK == 'Right' then
                        CI.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, CA, 0, CH)
                    else
                        CI.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, CH)
                    end
                    if CI.Frame.Visible then
                        CB[CK] = CH + CI.Frame.AbsoluteSize.Y + math.floor(42 * Ct)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

            local Cs = Cc

            if not (Cs) then

                Cu.Heartbeat:Wait()

                Cu = Ct ~= Cp

                if Cu then
                    return
                else

                    if not (Cw) then
                        return
                    end
                end

                X()

                Cu = ah

                Cu.Heartbeat:Wait()

                Cu = Ct ~= Cp

                if Cu then
                    return
                else
                    local Cw = Cc

                    if not (Cw) then
                        return
                    end
                end

                for Cw, CA in ipairs(Ce)do
                    tr(CA.Frame, CA.Padded)
                end
            end)
        end

                local CK, CL = CA <= 0 and 1 / CJ

                if CK then

                else
                    CI = CA
                    CL = CI + (1 / CJ - CA) * (1 - math.exp(-CJ * 8))

            end)

                local CL = B7

                    return
                end

                CI = CM + AR

                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                CL = CM >= CJ or Bk.Changed

                if CL then
                    CJ = CM + 1
                    Bk.Changed = false

                    pcall(E)
                end
            end)

        local function R(CR)
            local CS = CP[CR]

            CP[CR] = nil
            CL[CR] = nil

        local function j(CR)
            local CS = CR:IsA'LayerCollector'

            if CS then
                local CU = eg

                if CR == CU.RenderBackdrop then
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end

            CS = CL[CR] == nil

            if CS then
                CL[CR] = CR.Enabled

                local CU, CV, CW = {}, CR:GetPropertyChangedSignal'Enabled', function(
                )
                    local CU = CI

                    if CU then
                        local CV = B7

                        if CV then
                            if CL[CR] == nil then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    if CR.Enabled then
                        CL[CR] = true
                        CO[CR] = (CO[CR] or 0) + 1
                        CR.Enabled = false
                    else
                        CU = CO[CR]

                        if CU then
                            if CU > 0 then
                                CO[CR] = CO[CR] - 1
                            else
                                CL[CR] = false
                            end
                        else
                            CL[CR] = false
                        end
                    end
                end
                local CX, CY = CV:Connect(CW), function()
                    R(CR)
                end

                (function(CZ, C_, ...)
                    local C0 = table.pack(...)

                    table.move(C0, 1, C0.n, C_ + 1, CZ)
                end)(CU, 0, CX, CR.Destroying:Connect(CY))

                CP[CR] = CU
            end
            if CR.Enabled then
                CO[CR] = (CO[CR] or 0) + 1
            end

            pcall(function()
                CR.Enabled = false
            end)
        end
        local function R()
            for CR, CS in pairs(CP)do
                if type(CS) == 'table' then
                    for CU, CV in ipairs(CS)do
                        pcall(function()
                            CV:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                else
                    pcall(function()
                        CS:Disconnect()
                    end)
                end
            end

            table.clear(CP)

            for CS, CV in pairs(CL)do
                pcall(function()
                    CS.Enabled = CV
                end)
            end

            table.clear(CL)
            table.clear(CO)

            local CS = CQ

            if CS then
                local CV = CQ

                for CW, CX in pairs(CV)do
                    if CX == true then
                        pcall(function()
                            Ay:SetCoreGuiEnabled(CW, true)
                        end)
                    end
                end

                CQ = nil
            end
        end

            R()

                    return
                end

                return
            end

                CP[CV] = CV.ChildAdded:Connect(function(CX)
                    local CY = CI

                    if CY then

                        if CZ then

                        end

            end

            CQ = {}
            CS, CV = ipairs, table.pack(Enum.CoreGuiType:GetEnumItems())

            for CX, CY in CS(table.unpack(CV, 1, CV.n))do
                CX = CY ~= Enum.CoreGuiType.All

                if CX then
                    local CZ, C_ = pcall(function()
                        return Ay:GetCoreGuiEnabled(CY)
                    end)

                    if CZ then
                        CQ[CY] = C_
                    end
                end
            end

            CS = CQ

            for CX, CY in pairs(CS)do
                if CY == true then
                    pcall(function()
                        Ay:SetCoreGuiEnabled(CX, false)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        task.delay(8, function()
            local CV = os.clock() + 30

            while true do
                local CY, CZ, C_ = os.clock(), eg, eg.ConfigSettleUntil

                if not (CY < (C_ or 0) + 1 and os.clock() < CV) then

                end

                task.wait(0.5)
            end

            local CY = 'ChilliLibrary/SAE_HudEvents.txt'

                return type(isfile) == 'function' and isfile(CY)
            end)

            if C_ and C0 then

            elseif type(writefile) ~= 'function' then

        local function I()
            local Da = eg
            local Db = Da.Root()

            if not (Db) then
                return nil
            end

            for Dd, De in ipairs(Db:GetJoints())do
                local Df, Dg, Dl = pcall(function()
                    if De:IsA'Constraint' then
                        return De.Attachment0 and De.Attachment0.Parent, De.Attachment1 and De.Attachment1.Parent
                    end

                    return De.Part0, De.Part1
                end)

                Dd = Df and (Dg == Db and Dl or Dg)
                Dg = Dd and (Dd:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA'Model')

                if Dg then
                    if Dg.Parent == workspace then
                        if Dg:FindFirstChild'Hitbox' then
                            return Dg
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function o(Da, Db)
            local Dd = {}

            for De, Df in ipairs(Da:GetDescendants())do
                Dd[Df] = Df.Archivable

                pcall(function()
                    Df.Archivable = true
                end)
            end

            local Df = Da.Archivable

            Da.Archivable = true

            local Dg, Dl = pcall(function()
                return Da:Clone()
            end)

            Da.Archivable = Df

            for Dm, Dn in pairs(Dd)do
                pcall(function()
                    Dm.Archivable = Dn
                end)

            if Dg then
                if not (Dl) then
                    return nil
                end
            else
                return nil

            for Dm, Dn in ipairs(Dl:GetDescendants())do
                if Dn:IsA'LuaSourceContainer' or Dn:IsA'Sound' or Dn:IsA'ForceField' or Dn:IsA'JointInstance' or Dn:IsA'Constraint' or Dn:IsA'WeldConstraint' or Dn:IsA'BodyMover' or Dn:IsA'ProximityPrompt' or Dn:IsA'BillboardGui' then
                    pcall(function()
                        Dn:Destroy()
                    end)
                elseif Dn:IsA'BasePart' then
                    Dn.Anchored = true
                    Dn.CanCollide = false
                    Dn.CanQuery = false
                    Dn.CanTouch = false
                elseif Dn:IsA'Humanoid' then
                    Dn.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                    Dn.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
                end
            end

            Dl.Parent = Db

            return Dl
        end
        local function k(Da, Db)
            local Dd = workspace.CurrentCamera

            if Da then
                if not Dd then
                    return
                elseif Ci.Disguise then
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end

            local Df, Dg = Db or (Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)), {
                Camera = Dd,
                CameraType = Dd.CameraType,
                CameraCFrame = Dd.CFrame,

                Hidden = {},

            if Dn then
                if Do then
                    Dl[#Dl + 1] = Do

                for Ds, Dt in ipairs(Dq:GetDescendants())do

                    elseif Dt:IsA'Decal' then
                        Dg.Hidden[#Dg.Hidden + 1] = Dt
                    elseif Dt:IsA'Texture' then
                        Dg.Hidden[#Dg.Hidden + 1] = Dt
                    end
                end

                for Dq, Dt in ipairs(Dg.Hidden)do

                        Dt.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                    end)

                    if Dd.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                        Dd.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
                    end

                    Dd.CFrame = Dg.CameraCFrame
                end)
            end

                local Dt = ah

                Dt:BindToRenderStep(Dg.BindName, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1, J)
            end)

                Dg.Link = Dn.RenderStepped:Connect(J)

            Do = ah
            Dg.Beat = Do.Heartbeat:Connect(J)

                Do, Dt = pcall(o, Du, Dd)

                if Do and Dt then
                    if Df.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                        for Dv, Dw in ipairs(Dt:GetDescendants())do
                            if Dw:IsA'BasePart' then
                                pcall(function()
                                    Dw.CFrame = Dw.CFrame + Df
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    Dg.Copies[#Dg.Copies + 1] = Dt
                end

        local function o()

                return

            if Da.Link then

                    Da.Link:Disconnect()

            if Da.Beat then
                pcall(function()
                    Da.Beat:Disconnect()
                end)

                    Df.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                end)

            pcall(function()
                Da.Camera.CameraType = Da.CameraType
            end)

            for Df, Dg in ipairs(Da.Copies)do
                pcall(function()
                    Dg:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end

        local function Z()
            local Db, Dn = L(), B7.Options

            if type(Dn) ~= 'table' then
                return Db
            elseif Dn.Destination == 'Safe Zone' then
                if not (Dn.Stay) then
                    return Db
                end

            local Do = {}

            for Dt, Dw in pairs(Db)do
                Do[Dt] = Dw
            end

            if Dn.Destination == 'Next To Line' then
                Do.Target = 'edge'
                Do.LineOffset = 6
                Do.Height = 0
                Do.OffsetX = 0
                Do.OffsetZ = 0
            elseif Dn.Destination == 'Saved Spot' then
                if typeof(Dn.Spot) == 'Vector3' then
                    Do.Target = 'point'
                    Do.Point = Dn.Spot
                    Do.Height = 0
                    Do.OffsetX = 0
                    Do.OffsetZ = 0
                end
            end
            if Dn.Stay and type(Db.Steps) == 'table' then
                local Dt = {}

                for Dw, Dx in ipairs(Db.Steps)do
                    if type(Dx) == 'table' then
                        if Dx.To ~= 'start' then
                            Dt[#Dt + 1] = Dx
                        end
                    end
                end

                Do.Steps = Dt
            end

            return Do
        end
        local function m(Db, Dn)
            local Do = workspace:FindFirstChild'World' or workspace:FindFirstChild'__OBJECTS'
            local Dt = Do and (Do:FindFirstChild'Areas')

            Do = Dt and (Dt:FindFirstChild'SeparationLine')

            if Do then
                if Do:IsA'BasePart' then
                    Dt = Do.CFrame

                    local Dx = Do.Size.X >= Do.Size.Z and Dt.RightVector or Dt.LookVector
                    local Dy = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0):Cross(Dx)

                    Dy = Vector3.new(Dy.X, 0, Dy.Z)

                    if Dy.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                        Dy = Dy.Unit
                        Dx = (Dn - Dt.Position):Dot(Dy) >= 0 and -Dy or Dy

                        local Dz = Dt.Position + Dx * (tonumber(Db.LineOffset) or 8)

                        return Vector3.new(Dz.X, Dn.Y + 0.5, Dz.Z)
                    end
                end
            end

            return nil
        end
        local function L(Db, Dn)
            local Do = tostring(Db.Target or 'home')

            if Do == 'sky' then
                return Dn
            end
            if Do == 'point' then
                if typeof(Db.Point) == 'Vector3' then
                    return Db.Point
                end

                return Dn
            end
            if Do == 'line' then
                local Dt = m(Db, Dn)

                if Dt then
                    return Dt
                end
            end
            if Do == 'edge' then
                local Dt = workspace:FindFirstChild'World' or workspace:FindFirstChild'__OBJECTS'
                local Dx = Dt and (Dt:FindFirstChild'Areas')

                Dt = Dx and (Dx:FindFirstChild'SeparationLine')

                if Dt then
                    if Dt:IsA'BasePart' then
                        Dx = Dt.CFrame

                        local Dy = Dt.Size.X >= Dt.Size.Z and Dx.RightVector or Dx.LookVector

                        Dy = Vector3.new(Dy.X, 0, Dy.Z)

                        local Dz = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0):Cross(Dy)

                        Dz = Vector3.new(Dz.X, 0, Dz.Z)

                        if Dz.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                            if Dy.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                                local DA, DB, DC = Dy.Unit, Dz.Unit, Dn - Dx.Position
                                local DD, DE = math.clamp(DC:Dot(DA), -Dt.Size.Magnitude / 2, Dt.Size.Magnitude / 2), DC:Dot(DB) >= 0 and DB or 
-DB

                                DB, DC = Dx.Position + DA * DD + DE * (tonumber(Db.LineOffset) or 6), Y()

                                return Vector3.new(DB.X, (DC and DC.Y or Dn.Y) + 3, DB.Z)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return Y()
        end
        local function Y(Db, Dn)

        local function L(Db)
            local Dn = math.max(tonumber(Db) or 0, 0)

        end
        local function a(Db)
            local Dn, Do, Dt, Dx, Dy, Dz = type(Db.Steps) == 'table' and Db.Steps or {}, tonumber(Db.ReleaseAt) or 0, math.max(tonumber(Db.StartAt) or 0, 0), math.max(tonumber(Db.StartRandom) or 0, 0), math.max(tonumber(Db.HopRandom) or 0, 0), math.max(tonumber(Db.HoldRandom) or 0, 0)

            if Dx <= 0 then
                if Dy <= 0 then
                    if Dz <= 0 then
                        return Dn, Do, Dt
                    end
                end
            end

            local DA, DB, DC, DD = math.max(Dt + L(Dx), 0), {}, 0, 0

            for DE, DF in ipairs(Dn)do
                if type(DF) ~= 'table' then
                    break
                end

                Db = math.max(tonumber(DF.At) or 0, 0)
                Dt, Dx = math.max(Db - DC, 0), DF.To == 'start' and Dz or Dy
                DD = math.max(DD + Dt + L(Dx), DA)
                DB[DE] = {
                    At = DD,
                    To = DF.To,
                    Glide = DF.Glide,
                }
                DC = Db
            end

            return DB, DD + math.max(Do - DC, 0), DA
        end
        local function L(Db)
            local Dn = aG
            local Do, Dt = Dn.Character, eg
            local Dx, Dy = Dt.Root(), Do and (Do:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid')

            if not Dx or not Dy or Dy.Health <= 0 then
                m()
                D(Cc.Bad, 1.6)

                return
            end

            local function G()
                local Dz = Cg and Dx.Parent ~= nil and Dy.Parent ~= nil and Dy.Health > 0

                return Dz
            end

            local Dz = Dy.PlatformStand

            Dt = Dx.CFrame

            local DA, DB = Dt.Position, Z()
            local DC, DD, DE = a(DB)
            local DF, DG, DH = DB.Freeze ~= false, tostring(DB.Facing or 'Keep'), math.max(tonumber(DB.Jitter) or 0, 0)
            local DI = DG == 'Zero' and CFrame.new() or Dt.Rotation

            local function c()
                if DG == 'Spin' then
                    return CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(0, 359)), 0)
                end

                return DI
            end
            local function _(DJ)
                if DH <= 0 then
                    return DJ
                end

                return DJ + Vector3.new((math.random() * 2 - 1) * DH, 0, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * DH)
            end

            Dn = Y(DB, DA)

            local function Y(DJ)
                while G() and os.clock() - Db < DJ do
                    local DK = ah

                    DK.Heartbeat:Wait()

                    if DF then
                        pcall(function()
                            Dx.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            Dx.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                        end)
                    end
                end

                return G()
            end
            local function g(DJ, DK)
                W(Do, Dx, DJ, DK, DF)

                local DL = ah

                DL.PreSimulation:Wait()

                if G() then
                    if (Dx.Position - DJ).Magnitude > 3 then
                        W(Do, Dx, DJ, DK, DF)
                    end
                end
            end

            pcall(function()
                Dy.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
            end)

            if DB.Disguise ~= false then
                pcall(k, Do, (Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)))
            end

            D(Cc.Work)

            if Y(DE) then
                if DB.Limp ~= false then
                    Dy.PlatformStand = true
                end
            end

            Dt, DE = ipairs, DA

            for DJ, DK in Dt(DC)do
                if type(DK) ~= 'table' then
                    break
                elseif not (Y(tonumber(DK.At) or 0)) then
                    break
                end

                local DL, DM, DN = DK.To == 'start' and DA or _(Dn), c(), type(DK.Glide) == 'table' and #DK.Glide > 0

                if DN then
                    DJ, DB = ipairs, DK.Glide

                    for DO, DP in DJ(DB)do
                        if not (G()) then
                            break
                        end

                        DO = math.clamp(tonumber(DP) or 1, 0, 1)

                        W(Do, Dx, DE:Lerp(DL, DO), DM, DF)

                        DO = ah

                        DO.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    end
                else
                    g(DL, DM)
                end

                DE = DL
            end

            Y(DD)
            pcall(function()
                Dy.PlatformStand = Dz
            end)
            o()
            m()

            if G() and Ci.Carrying then
                D(Cc.Good, 1.6)
            else
                D(Cc.Bad, 1.6)
            end
        end

        local function P(DT)
            return type(DT) == 'table' and DT or {}
        end
        local function p(DT)
            return table.find(DL, (tostring(DT or ''):gsub('^%d+ %- ', '')))
        end
        local function s(DT, DU)
            local DV = {}

            for DW, DX in ipairs(P(DT))do
                DW = DU(tostring(DX))

                if DW then
                    DV[#DV + 1] = DW
                end
            end

            return DV
        end

        local DT = O{
            'Icon',
            'Name',
            'Rarity',
            'Value',
            'Mutation',
            'Size',
            'Weight',
            'Area',
        }
        local DU = {
            r = function(DU)
                if DU == 'Any' then
                    return table.clone(DL)
                end
                if DU == 'Off' then
                    return {}
                end

                local DV = p(DU)

                return DV and {
                    table.unpack(DL, 1, DV),
                }
            end,
            x = function(DU)
                if DU == 'Off' then
                    return {}
                end

                local DV = p(DU)

                return DV and {
                    table.unpack(DL, DV),
                }
            end,
            m = function(DU)
                DU = tonumber(DU) or 0

                return DU > 0 and math.floor(10 ^ (3 + DU * 0.009) + 0.5) or 0
            end,
            e = function(DU)
                return s(DU, function(DV)
                    return (DV:gsub(' %(%d+%)$', ''):gsub(' %[[^%]]*%]$', ''))
                end)
            end,
            z = function(DU)
                return #P(DU) < 13 and P(DU) or {}
            end,
            l = function(DU)
                return #P(DU) > 0 and DU or nil
            end,
            b = function(DU)
                return s(DU, function(DV)
                    return (DV:gsub(' Butterfly$', ''))
                end)
            end,
            t = function(DU)
                return s(DU, function(DV)
                    return (DV:gsub(' To ', ' to '))
                end)
            end,
            i = function(DU)
                return s(DU, function(DV)
                    return DT[DV] and DV
                end)
            end,
        }

        local function o(DV)
            local DW, DX, DY = {}, P(DV.Values), nil

            for DZ in DS:gmatch'[^\n]+'do
                local D_, D0 = DZ:match'^@(.-)|(.+)$'

                if D_ then
                    DY = type(DX[D_]) == 'table' and DX[D_][D0] or nil
                else
                    if DY then

            end
        end
        if type(WebSocket.connect) ~= 'function' then
            if type(WebSocket.new) ~= 'function' then
                if type(WebSocket.New) ~= 'function' then
                    if type(websocket.connect) ~= 'function' then
                        if syn.WebSocket then
                            local DA = type(syn.WebSocket.new)

                            if DA ~= 'function' then
                                return nil, nil
                            end

                            return syn.WebSocket.new, 'syn.WebSocket.new'
                        end

                        return nil, nil
                    end

                    return websocket.connect, 'websocket.connect'
                end

                return WebSocket.New, 'WebSocket.New'
            end

            return WebSocket.new, 'WebSocket.new'
        end

        return WebSocket.connect, 'WebSocket.connect'
    end

    wK = function(DA, DB, DD)
        local DF = DB or 0

        if DF > 6 then
            return '<max-depth>'
        end

        local DH = typeof(DA)

        if DH == 'nil' or DH == 'boolean' or DH == 'string' then
            return DA
        elseif DH == 'number' then
            if DA ~= DA or DA == math.huge or DA == -math.huge then
                return tostring(DA)
            end

            return DA
        elseif DH == 'Instance' then
            return {
                _type = 'Instance',
                className = DA.ClassName,
                name = DA.Name,
                path = wJ(DA),
            }
        elseif DH == 'Vector3' then
            return {
                x = DA.X,
                y = DA.Y,
                z = DA.Z,
            }
        elseif DH == 'Vector2' then
            return {
                x = DA.X,
                y = DA.Y,
            }
        elseif DH == 'CFrame' then
            local DS, DT = DA.Position, DA.LookVector

            return {
                position = {
                    x = DS.X,
                    y = DS.Y,
                    z = DS.Z,
                },
                lookVector = {
                    x = DT.X,
                    y = DT.Y,
                    z = DT.Z,
                },
            }
        elseif DH == 'Color3' then
            return {
                r = math.floor(DA.R * 255 + 0.5),
                g = math.floor(DA.G * 255 + 0.5),
                b = math.floor(DA.B * 255 + 0.5),
            }
        elseif DH == 'UDim2' then
            return {
                xScale = DA.X.Scale,
                xOffset = DA.X.Offset,
                yScale = DA.Y.Scale,
                yOffset = DA.Y.Offset,
            }
        elseif DH == 'UDim' then
            return {
                scale = DA.Scale,
                offset = DA.Offset,
            }
        elseif DH == 'EnumItem' then
            return tostring(DA)
        elseif DH == 'table' then
            DD = DD or {}

            if DD[DA] then
                return '<cycle>'
            end

            DD[DA] = true

            local DS, DT = {}, 0

            for DV, DX in pairs(DA)do
                DT = DT + 1

                if DT > 200 then
                    DS['<truncated>'] = true

                    break
                end

                local DZ = (type(DV) == 'number' or type(DV) == 'string') and DV or tostring(DV)

                DS[DZ] = wK(DX, DF + 1, DD)
            end

            DD[DA] = nil

            return DS
        end

        return tostring(DA)
    end
    wL = function(DA)
        if wq and ws then
            local DB, DD = pcall(function()
                return uz:JSONEncode(wK(DA))
            end)

            if DB then
                local DF, DH, DS

                if Dt < #DD then
                    if type(DA) == 'table' and DA.type == 'rpc_result' then
                        DF = uz:JSONEncode{
                            type = 'rpc_result',
                            requestId = DA.requestId,
                            success = false,
                            error = string.format('Result is too large to send (%d KB). Return less data.', math.floor(#DD / 1024)),
                        }
                        DH, DS = pcall(function()
                            ws:Send(DF)
                        end)

                        if DH then
                            return true
                        end

                        return false, 'WebSocket send failed: ' .. tostring(DS)
                    end

                    return false, 'message too large'
                end

                DF = DD
                DH, DS = pcall(function()
                    ws:Send(DF)
                end)

                if DH then
                    return true
                end

                return false, 'WebSocket send failed: ' .. tostring(DS)
            end

            return false, tostring(DD)
        end

        return false, 'not connected'
    end

        end
        local Eu = function(Eu)
            local Ev, Ew, Ex = El(Eu.code, Eu.label), tostring(Eu.runId or uz:GenerateGUID(false)), tostring(Eu.label or 'AsyncRun')
            local Ey = {
                id = Ew,
                label = Ex,
                startedAt = os.clock(),
                pending = {},
                lineCount = 0,
            }
            local Ez = Em(function(Ez, EA)
                local EB = Ez == 'warn' and '[warn] ' or ''

                Ey.lineCount = Ey.lineCount + 1

                table.insert(Ey.pending, EB .. EA)

                if #Ey.pending >= 20 then
                    Et(Ey)
                end
            end)

            setfenv(Ev, Ez)

            Ey.thread = task.spawn(function()
                local EA = table.pack(xpcall(Ev, Ep))

                Et(Ey)

                D3[Ew] = nil

                local EB = math.floor((os.clock() - Ey.startedAt) * 1000 + 0.5)

                if EA[1] then
                    DA('exec.finished', {
                        runId = Ew,
                        label = Ex,
                        ok = true,
                        elapsedMs = EB,
                    })
                else
                    DA('exec.finished', {
                        runId = Ew,
                        label = Ex,
                        ok = false,
                        elapsedMs = EB,
                        error = tostring(EA[2]),
                    })
                end
            end)
            D3[Ew] = Ey

            return {
                runId = Ew,
                label = Ex,
                status = 'started',
            }
        end

        Es['exec.cancel'] = function(Ev)

            if Ew then
                D3[Ew.id] = nil

                pcall(task.cancel, Ew.thread)
                Et(Ew)

                local Ex = {
                    runId = Ew.id,
                    label = Ew.label,
                    ok = false,
                    cancelled = true,
                    error = 'Cancelled from the web console',
                    elapsedMs = math.floor((os.clock() - Ew.startedAt) * 1000 + 0.5),
                }

                DA('exec.finished', Ex)

                return {
                    cancelled = true,
                    runId = Ew.id,
                }
            end

            return {
                cancelled = false,
                reason = 'not running',
            }
        end
